original_sentence: My meaning simply is, that whatever I have tried to do in life, I have tried with all my heart to do well; that whatever I have devoted myself to, I have devoted myself to completely; that in great aims and in small, I have always been thoroughly in earnest.
readingExamples: My meaning simply is, that whatever I have tried to do in life, I have tried with all my heart to do well; that whatever I have devoted myself to, I have devoted myself to completely; that in great aims and in small, I have always been thoroughly in earnest.
definitionEn:
(1) phr. to give all of one's time, energy, or attention to a particular task, cause, or person
(2) phr. to dedicate oneself wholeheartedly to a pursuit believed to be worthy or important
(3) phr. to commit oneself fully to serving or supporting someone or something

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【课件】挚爱；关爱（great love, care and support for sb/sth）；奉献；忠诚（the action of spending time & effort）——常用 devotion to sb/sth
uncommonMeanings.example: 课件：His devotion to his wife and family is touching. 他对妻子和家庭的挚爱令人感动。/ His devotion to duty 他对职责的忠诚。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【课件】挚爱的；关爱的；忠实的；尽职的——a devoted father/supporter 尽职的父亲/忠实的支持者
uncommonMeanings.example: 课件：After the earthquake, volunteers devoted their spare time to helping others rebuild their homes. 那场地震后，志愿者用他们的空闲时间帮助其他人重建家园。

posExamples.sentence: After the earthquake left the village in ruins, the young teacher devoted herself to rebuilding the school, brick by brick, until the sound of children's laughter once again filled the empty classrooms. （读后续写·灾后重建）

On behalf of our club, I sincerely hope that more of us will devote ourselves to protecting the campus environment, for only through collective effort can we keep our school clean and green. （应用文·倡议书）
Those who devote themselves entirely to a single lofty goal, undistracted by fleeting pleasures, are far more likely to leave a lasting mark on the world. （议论文·奋斗与专注）
Grandpa devoted himself to teaching me chess every evening after supper, his weathered hands moving each piece with a patience I would only come to appreciate years later. （读后续写·亲情陪伴）

wordForms.other: devotee (n. 献身者，狂热爱好者)

collocations.translation: 全身心投入做某事【课件】（to 是介词，后接名词/动名词）
collocations.example: 课件原句：She devoted herself entirely/completely to writing novels. 她全身心投入写小说。

collocations.phrase: devote one's time / attention / energy / resources to sth
collocations.translation: 把时间/注意力/精力/资源奉献给……【课件】
collocations.example: 课件：We think that you can live a more powerful life when you devote some of your time and energy to something much larger than yourself. 把一些时间和精力倾注于比你自己远为宏大的事业。

collocations.translation: 献身于；致力于；专心于【课件】
collocations.example: 课件：Once you find the book that appeals to you, you must devote yourself to reading it. 一旦找到吸引你的书，你就必须专心去读。

collocations.translation: 献身于（做）某事【to 是介词，后接名词/动名词，非动词原形】
collocations.example: 课文原句：...whatever I have devoted myself to, I have devoted myself to completely...（凡我献身之事，我皆全心以赴。—— Charles Dickens）
She devoted herself to caring for the stray animals, spending every weekend at the shelter without ever asking for thanks. （读后续写·善良）
Madame Curie devoted her whole life to scientific research, sacrificing comfort and health in the relentless pursuit of truth. （议论文·科学精神）

collocations.phrase: devote time / energy / attention to sth
collocations.translation: 把时间/精力/注意力投入某事
collocations.example: If we devote more time to reading than to endless scrolling, our minds will surely grow richer by the day. （应用文·读书倡议）
He devoted himself to the cause of rural education, walking miles each day to reach the children in the remote mountains. （读后续写·支教）
The moment she stepped onto the court, she devoted herself wholeheartedly to the game, forgetting the roaring crowd and her aching legs. （读后续写·比赛）
The old dog was utterly devoted to its master, waiting faithfully at the door each evening long after the last bus had gone. （读后续写·忠诚）
I strongly suggest that the school devote more resources to the library so that every student can enjoy quiet reading. （应用文·建议信）

synonyms.example: She dedicated herself to nursing the wounded soldiers, her lamp glowing in the ward long into the freezing night. （读后续写·南丁格尔式奉献）
synonyms.usage: 与 devote oneself to 几乎同义，语气更正式、更书面，常用于崇高目标或纪念性语境（如献词、传记）

synonyms.example: The company committed itself to reducing carbon emissions within five years. （议论文·环保责任）
synonyms.usage: 强调作出郑重承诺并负责到底，含'许下诺言并信守'之意；devote 更强调投入时间精力，commit 更强调责任担当

synonyms.example: To forget her sorrow, she threw herself into her work, arriving before dawn and leaving after the streetlights came on. （读后续写·以忙碌疗伤）
synonyms.usage: 口语化、更有画面感，强调热情而突然地投入，常带情绪色彩；devote 更中性、更持久

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·分词短语作状语（Devoted to.../Devoting herself to...）
advancedExpressions.expression: 过去分词短语作状语 Devoted to sth, sb ... = 现在分词短语作状语 Devoting oneself to sth, sb ...（后者更常用）
advancedExpressions.example: 课件【高级表达】The woman devotes herself to the research, so she has little time to go home. → ① Devoted to the research, the woman has little time to go home.（过去分词作状语）② Devoting herself to the research, the woman has little time to go home.（现在分词作状语，更常用）

advancedExpressions.type: 短语群·devote 家族一起记
advancedExpressions.expression: devote oneself to / be devoted to / devote time (energy) to / with devotion
advancedExpressions.example: For thirty years she devoted herself to the orphanage; utterly devoted to the children, she poured all her time and energy into them, and worked with a quiet devotion that shamed us all. （四种形式串联：动词短语→形容词→devote...to→名词 devotion）

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·to 是介词非不定式
advancedExpressions.expression: devote oneself to + n. / doing（不可跟动词原形）
advancedExpressions.example: He devoted himself to helping (NOT help) others. 同类 to 为介词的短语：look forward to doing / be used to doing / lead to doing / object to doing. （高考语填高频陷阱）

advancedExpressions.expression: devote(v.) → devoted(adj. 忠诚的/挚爱的) → devotion(n. 奉献/挚爱) → devotee(n. 狂热爱好者)
advancedExpressions.example: His devotion to teaching turned him into a devoted mentor whom generations of devotees still remember. （同根词一句连缀）

advancedExpressions.type: 读后续写·人物精神升华
advancedExpressions.expression: having devoted himself/herself to ..., sb. finally ...
advancedExpressions.example: Having devoted herself heart and soul to the orphanage for three long decades, the old woman finally saw her first pupil return — now a doctor — to carry the torch she had kindled. （现在分词状语前置+首尾呼应，续写结尾升华）

advancedExpressions.expression: let us devote ourselves to ..., so that ...
advancedExpressions.example: Let us devote ourselves to preserving our cultural heritage, so that the wisdom of our ancestors may shine on for generations to come. （let us 呼吁句式+so that 目的状语，倡议书结尾）

advancedExpressions.expression: only those who devote themselves wholeheartedly to ... can ...
advancedExpressions.example: Only those who devote themselves wholeheartedly to their craft, indifferent to instant reward, can hope to reach the summit of true excellence. （only 引导倒装+强调专注的价值）

sentenceUpgrade.original: He worked hard on his research.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Night after night, he devoted himself to his research, the desk lamp burning low as equations marched across page after page — for he had long since decided that this, and nothing else, was the work of his life. （读后续写·科研执着）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 时间状语渲染氛围（night after night）+ 环境细节（lamp burning low）+ 破折号插入内心独白 + this, and nothing else 强调结构

sentenceUpgrade.original: We should give our time to helping others.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: It is my firm belief that if each of us were willing to devote even a fraction of our spare time to helping those in need, the small streams of individual kindness would in time swell into a mighty river of change. （应用文·倡议信）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: It is my firm belief that 正式主句 + 虚拟条件句（if...were willing）+ streams swell into a river 隐喻收束

classPractice.note: 课件原题：a devoted father/supporter；devoted adj. 尽职的/忠实的

classPractice.answer: devoted their spare time to helping others

translation: 非常认真的；诚实的，真诚的
original_sentence: My meaning simply is, that whatever I have tried to do in life, I have tried with all my heart to do well; that whatever I have devoted myself to, I have devoted myself to completely; that in great aims and in small, I have always been thoroughly in earnest.
readingExamples: My meaning simply is, that whatever I have tried to do in life, I have tried with all my heart to do well; that whatever I have devoted myself to, I have devoted myself to completely; that in great aims and in small, I have always been thoroughly in earnest.
definitionEn:
(1) adj. very serious and sincere in what one says or does; showing deep and honest conviction
(2) adj. (of an effort or intention) marked by genuine and heartfelt purpose rather than pretence
(3) n. (in the phrase 'in earnest') a state of being serious and determined, as opposed to joking or hesitating

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 认真，郑重（多用于 in earnest 结构）；预付定金，保证金（法律/商业英语）
uncommonMeanings.example: As soon as the referee's whistle blew, the friendly warm-up was over and the real match began in earnest, every muscle now taut with purpose. （读后续写·比赛正式打响）

posExamples.sentence: The little boy fixed his earnest eyes on the teacher and asked, in a voice trembling with hope, whether he too could one day become a painter. （读后续写·孩童的渴望）
I am writing to make an earnest appeal to all fellow students: please treasure every drop of water, for what we waste today our children may beg for tomorrow. （应用文·倡议书）
An earnest desire to improve, rather than mere talent, is what ultimately separates the truly accomplished from the merely gifted. （议论文·勤奋与天赋）
Seeing how earnest she was about learning the local dialect, the villagers gradually warmed to the shy foreign volunteer and welcomed her into their homes. （读后续写·跨文化融入）

idioms.translation: 认真地，郑重其事地；（某事）正式开始并全力进行
idioms.example: After weeks of half-hearted attempts, she began to train in earnest, rising before dawn to run until her lungs burned. （读后续写·下定决心）

collocations.translation: 认真地，郑重其事地【课文原句短语；in great aims and in small, I have always been thoroughly in earnest】
collocations.example: 课文原句：...in great aims and in small, I have always been thoroughly in earnest.（无论大事小事，我一向全然认真。）
It was his earnest desire to see his mother smile again that drove him through those long, sleepless nights of study. （读后续写·孝心）
On behalf of the whole class, I make an earnest appeal to the school to open the library on weekends. （应用文·建议信）
Only through earnest and sustained effort can a nation transform its dreams into reality. （议论文·奋斗）

collocations.translation: 非常认真地，一点不含糊
collocations.example: 'I am in dead earnest,' he said quietly, and for the first time she realized he truly meant to give up everything for this cause. （读后续写·郑重承诺）

collocations.translation: 认真诚恳的年轻人/学生
collocations.example: The professor took a liking to the earnest young man who lingered after every lecture to ask one more thoughtful question. （读后续写·师生）
She was so earnest about protecting the stray cats that she spent her entire allowance on their food. （读后续写·善良）
He pleaded earnestly with the crowd not to give up hope, his voice cracking yet somehow steadier with every word. （读后续写·演讲鼓舞）

synonyms.example: Please accept my sincere apology for the trouble I have caused. （应用文·道歉信）
synonyms.usage: 侧重'真心不虚假'，强调情感真实；earnest 更侧重'认真投入、态度郑重'，常带一种迫切的严肃感

synonyms.example: This is a serious matter that deserves our careful consideration. （议论文·态度）
synonyms.usage: 最普通的'认真/严肃'，语气中性；earnest 更书面、更带情感温度，暗含'诚恳而热切'

synonyms.example: She gave the project her wholehearted support from the very first day. （应用文·感谢信）
synonyms.usage: 强调毫无保留、全身心投入的程度；earnest 强调态度的诚恳与郑重，两者可搭配使用

advancedExpressions.type: 短语群·in earnest 三连（熟词僻义）
advancedExpressions.expression: in earnest（认真地）/ begin in earnest（正式开始并全力进行）/ in dead (deadly) earnest（非常认真，绝非玩笑）
advancedExpressions.example: After weeks of joking around, training began in earnest, and when he said he would quit school to help his family, I saw he was in dead earnest. （三义一句区分：状语'认真地'→'正式打响'→'当真'）

advancedExpressions.expression: earnest(adj.) → earnestly(adv. 恳切地) → earnestness(n. 认真/诚挚)
advancedExpressions.example: He argued so earnestly, with an earnestness that silenced the room, that no one doubted how earnest he really was. （形→副→名 一句连用）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·功能：形容'认真诚恳'（可替换）
advancedExpressions.expression: earnest / sincere / serious / wholehearted / whole-hearted / heartfelt
advancedExpressions.example: an earnest / a sincere / a heartfelt plea 恳切的请求；同表'认真投入'时 earnest 最书面、最带迫切的严肃感。（辨析见 synonyms）

advancedExpressions.expression: no longer ..., sb. set about ... in earnest
advancedExpressions.example: No longer content to dream idly, he set about pursuing his goal in earnest, and the very air around him seemed to sharpen with new resolve. （no longer 前置否定+in earnest 收束，续写转折段）

advancedExpressions.expression: it is my earnest hope that ...
advancedExpressions.example: It is my earnest hope that every one of us will lend a hand, however small, to make our community a warmer place. （it is my earnest hope that 恳切主句，倡议信）

advancedExpressions.expression: an earnest ... is worth more than a thousand ...
advancedExpressions.example: An earnest attempt, though it may end in failure, is worth more than a thousand idle wishes that never leave the comfort of the mind. （对比结构+让步状语，强调行动的价值）

sentenceUpgrade.original: She really wanted to help and worked seriously.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: With an earnestness that touched everyone present, she rolled up her sleeves and set to work in dead earnest, her eyes shining with a quiet, unshakeable determination. （读后续写·奉献场景）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: with an earnestness that 定语从句渲染感染力 + in dead earnest 固定短语强化 + 眼神细节（eyes shining）以形传神

sentenceUpgrade.original: I hope you will support this activity.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: It is therefore my earnest hope that you will not only lend your support to this meaningful activity, but also encourage those around you to join hands with us. （应用文·倡议信）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: It is my earnest hope that 正式主句 + not only...but also 递进 + join hands with us 意象化呼吁

classPractice.question: 无论大事小事，我一向全然认真。（用 earnest，课文原句）In great aims and in small, I have always been thoroughly ____ ____.
classPractice.note: 课文原句短语 in earnest 认真地；in 不可换 with/on

classPractice.question: After weeks of casual practice, the team finally began to train in ____ (earnest) for the coming final.
classPractice.note: 固定短语 in earnest（此处 earnest 作名词），意为'正式开始并全力进行'

classPractice.question: She listened ____ (earnest) to every word the old craftsman said, unwilling to miss a single tip.
classPractice.note: 修饰动词 listened 需用副词 earnestly 恳切地/认真地

original_sentence: Butterflies too are few and so are flowers and most things that are beautiful.
readingExamples: Butterflies too are few and so are flowers and most things that are beautiful.
definitionEn:
(1) n. a flying insect with a long thin body and four large, often brightly coloured wings
(2) n. (butterflies) a nervous, fluttering feeling in one's stomach, caused by fear or excitement
(3) n. a style of swimming (the butterfly stroke) in which both arms are lifted out of the water and moved forward together

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （have/get butterflies in one's stomach）紧张不安，心里七上八下
uncommonMeanings.example: As she waited in the wings for her name to be called, a swarm of butterflies fluttered in her stomach, and she pressed a trembling hand to her chest to steady her racing heart. （读后续写·登台前紧张）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 轻浮善变、追逐享乐的人（比喻，常作 social butterfly）
uncommonMeanings.example: Once a shy bookworm, she had somehow become the social butterfly of the party, flitting from one lively group to another with an ease that surprised even herself. （读后续写·性格转变）

posExamples.sentence: A single butterfly landed on the sleeping child's outstretched hand, its wings opening and closing as gently as a whispered lullaby, and the whole garden seemed to hold its breath. （读后续写·唯美画面）

To raise awareness of environmental protection, our club is organising a 'Butterfly Garden' project, and we warmly invite every student to plant flowers that these delicate creatures depend on. （应用文·活动通知）
The so-called butterfly effect reminds us that even the smallest action, like a single kind word, may set in motion consequences far greater than we could ever imagine. （议论文·蝴蝶效应/细节的力量）
Watching the caterpillar struggle free of its cocoon and unfurl its damp wings into a shimmering butterfly, the boy understood at last that transformation is always born of struggle. （读后续写·蜕变象征）

wordForms.other: caterpillar (n. 毛毛虫), cocoon / chrysalis (n. 茧/蛹)

idioms.translation: 感到紧张不安，心里发慌
idioms.example: Standing at the starting line of the marathon, he had butterflies in his stomach, but the moment the gun fired, all his nerves melted into pure determination. （读后续写·赛前紧张）

idioms.translation: 蝴蝶效应（微小起因导致巨大结果）
idioms.example: History is full of examples of the butterfly effect, where a single overlooked decision has altered the course of entire nations. （议论文·因果）

idioms.idiom: break a butterfly on a wheel
idioms.example: Punishing a child so harshly for such a trivial mistake is like breaking a butterfly on a wheel. （议论文·惩罚适度）

collocations.translation: 蝴蝶也很少见【课文原句词块】
collocations.example: 课文原句：Butterflies too are few and so are flowers and most things that are beautiful.（蝴蝶也少了，花朵也少了，一切美好的事物大多如此。）

collocations.translation: （考点熟词僻义）紧张不安，心里发慌
collocations.example: Waiting to give her speech, she had butterflies in her stomach, her hands cold and her heart pounding. （读后续写·登台前紧张）

collocations.phrase: a butterfly lands / settles on sth
collocations.example: A vivid blue butterfly settled on the rim of her teacup, and for a fleeting moment the ordinary morning felt touched by magic. （读后续写·细节唯美）

collocations.translation: 追蝴蝶（常喻天真烂漫或不务正业）
collocations.example: The children chased butterflies across the sunlit meadow, their laughter ringing like tiny bells in the summer air. （读后续写·童年欢乐）
She powered down the lane with a flawless butterfly stroke, her arms rising and falling like the wings of the very creature the stroke was named after. （读后续写·游泳比赛）
As they pushed open the greenhouse door, a cloud of butterflies rose into the air, filling the humid space with flickering colour. （读后续写·惊喜发现）

collocations.phrase: the life cycle of a butterfly
collocations.example: In our biology class we studied the life cycle of a butterfly, from tiny egg to crawling caterpillar and finally to graceful winged adult. （应用文·活动报告）

collocations.translation: 社交花蝴蝶，交际广泛的人
collocations.example: Unlike her quiet brother, she was a social butterfly who could strike up a warm conversation with almost anyone. （读后续写·人物性格）

synonyms.example: A moth circled the flickering lamp, drawn helplessly toward the light that might destroy it. （读后续写·飞蛾扑火象征）
synonyms.usage: 与 butterfly 同属鳞翅目但多在夜间活动、色彩暗淡；写作中常借'moth to a flame'表达难以抗拒的诱惑，butterfly 则多象征美丽与蜕变

synonyms.example: Countless insects hummed in the tall grass as the sun climbed higher. （读后续写·夏日环境描写）
synonyms.usage: 上位词，泛指昆虫；当具体描写蝴蝶的美感或象征意义时用 butterfly，泛写虫鸣环境时用 insect

advancedExpressions.expression: have butterflies in one's stomach（紧张不安）/ a social butterfly（交际花）/ the butterfly effect（蝴蝶效应）
advancedExpressions.example: The social butterfly who chatted with everyone at parties still had butterflies in her stomach before the finals — a small reminder of the butterfly effect fear can have on us all. （三大习语串联记忆）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·功能：写'紧张不安'（可替换）
advancedExpressions.expression: have butterflies in one's stomach / be on edge / be a bundle of nerves / one's heart pounds (races)
advancedExpressions.example: Before the interview I had butterflies in my stomach = I was on edge = my heart was pounding. （续写描写紧张的高级替换）

advancedExpressions.expression: caterpillar(毛毛虫) → cocoon / chrysalis(茧/蛹) → butterfly(蝴蝶)；成长/蜕变象征三部曲
advancedExpressions.example: From a crawling caterpillar, through the silent cocoon, to a winged butterfly — her growth mirrored nature's own quiet miracle. （用于续写蜕变主题）

advancedExpressions.expression: like a butterfly emerging from its cocoon, sb. ...
advancedExpressions.example: Like a butterfly emerging from its cocoon, she stepped out of her old timid self and spread wings she never knew she had. （明喻+象征，续写升华成长主题）

advancedExpressions.expression: if we ..., even the fragile butterfly may ...
advancedExpressions.example: If we plant just one more flowerbed on campus, even the fragile butterfly may find a home among us, reminding us daily of nature's quiet beauty. （条件句+以小见大，倡议书）

advancedExpressions.expression: just as the flutter of a butterfly's wings can ..., so too can ...
advancedExpressions.example: Just as the flutter of a butterfly's wings can, in theory, stir a distant storm, so too can a single act of kindness ripple outward in ways we can never foresee. （类比结构 just as...so too，论证细节的连锁效应）

sentenceUpgrade.original: A butterfly flew over the flowers.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: A lone butterfly drifted lazily above the blossoms, dipping and rising on the warm breeze as though painting invisible ribbons across the golden afternoon. （读后续写·唯美画面）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 拟人化动词（drifted, dipping, rising）+ as though 比喻 + 色彩与光线渲染（golden afternoon）营造画面感

sentenceUpgrade.original: I was nervous before the speech.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Moments before I stepped up to the podium, a whole swarm of butterflies took flight in my stomach, yet the instant my eyes met the encouraging faces of my classmates, that fluttering storm settled into calm. （读后续写·紧张转平静）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: butterflies 熟词僻义活用 + 时间状语铺垫（Moments before）+ 情绪由乱转定的对比（took flight → settled into calm）

classPractice.question: 站在起跑线上，他紧张得心里直发慌。Standing at the starting line, he ____ butterflies ____ his stomach.
classPractice.note: 习语 have butterflies in one's stomach 紧张不安；in 表'在……里'

classPractice.question: The garden was so quiet that even the fluttering of a single ____ (butterfly) wings could be heard.
classPractice.note: the fluttering of a butterfly's wings；此处需名词所有格，蝴蝶的翅膀（后接名词 wings）

classPractice.question: Unlike her shy sister, Amy is a real social ____ (butterfly / bookworm), chatting happily with everyone.
classPractice.note: a social butterfly 交际花；bookworm 书虫，语境需'善交际'

original_sentence: Read the excerpts below from two famous works of literature and discuss the following questions in pairs.
readingExamples: Read the excerpts below from two famous works of literature and discuss the following questions in pairs.
definitionEn:
(1) n. written works, especially those considered to have lasting artistic value, such as novels, poems, and plays
(2) n. all the written information available on a particular subject, especially of an academic or professional nature
(3) n. printed material, such as leaflets or brochures, used to give information or advertise something

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （某领域的）文献，研究资料
uncommonMeanings.example: Before drawing any conclusion, the young researcher spent months poring over the existing literature, determined to build her argument on solid scholarly ground. （读后续写·学术钻研）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 宣传印刷品，说明材料（如传单、小册子）
uncommonMeanings.example: The tourists were handed piles of glossy literature at the entrance, each leaflet promising an unforgettable journey through the ancient city. （读后续写·旅行场景）

posExamples.sentence: Curled up by the fireplace with a battered volume of classic literature, the old man lost himself once more in a world where every page smelt faintly of the past. （读后续写·读书温情画面）
Our school is holding a Literature Week next month, and we sincerely invite you to share your favourite books and rediscover the timeless joy of reading. （应用文·活动邀请）
Great literature does more than entertain; it holds up a mirror to human nature and quietly teaches us to feel for lives far removed from our own. （议论文·文学的价值）
It was through the literature of her own country that the homesick student rediscovered a sense of belonging, each familiar verse wrapping around her like a warm blanket from home. （读后续写·文化认同）

wordForms.noun: literature (文学/文献) / literacy (读写能力) / the literati (文人)
wordForms.adjective: literary (文学的) / literate (有读写能力的，识字的)
wordForms.other: litterateur (n. 文人，文学家); illiterate (adj. 文盲的); 辨析：literary 文学的 ≠ literate 识字的 ≠ literal 字面的（勿混）

collocations.translation: 一部文学作品【课件】（literature 不可数，量词用 a piece of）
collocations.example: 课件：It is far better than any other method because you improve your vocabulary while reading an interesting piece of literature. 它比任何其他方法都好得多，因为在阅读一部有趣的文学作品时，你可以增加词汇量。
课件：Read the excerpts below from two famous works of literature.（阅读下面两部著名文学作品的节选。）
The library houses a rare collection of great works of literature, from ancient epics to modern classics. （改写自课件搭配·文学巨著）
Reading classic literature is like conversing with the wisest minds of every age. （课件搭配·经典文学）

collocations.translation: 文学作品【课文原句词块】
collocations.example: 课文原句：Read the excerpts below from two famous works of literature and discuss the following questions in pairs.（阅读下面两部著名文学作品的节选……）
Immersing ourselves in great literature is like conversing with the wisest minds of every age. （议论文·阅读价值）
Few works of literature have moved me as deeply as this quiet little novel about an ordinary family. （读后续写·读后感）
Her lifelong passion for English literature began the day her teacher read aloud a single haunting line of poetry. （读后续写·启蒙时刻）
Those who read literature widely tend to write with greater grace and think with greater depth. （议论文·阅读与写作）
The team carefully reviewed the literature on climate change before designing their own experiment. （应用文·研究报告）
Children's literature, far from being childish, plants the first seeds of imagination and moral courage. （议论文·儿童阅读）
Over the decades a vast body of literature has accumulated on this once-neglected subject. （议论文·学术积累）

synonyms.example: The complete works of Shakespeare lined the top shelf, their spines worn soft by generations of eager hands. （读后续写·书房场景）
synonyms.usage: 指某作者或某类的具体作品集合，可数；literature 为不可数集合名词，泛指'文学'这一整体或某领域文献

synonyms.example: She preferred fiction to biography, delighting in worlds that could never quite exist. （读后续写·阅读偏好）
synonyms.usage: 特指虚构类作品（小说等），与 non-fiction 相对；literature 范围更广，含诗歌、戏剧、散文乃至学术文献

synonyms.example: His early writings, though rough, already hinted at the genius that would later astonish the world. （读后续写·成长伏笔）
synonyms.usage: 泛指某人写下的文字（含书信、随笔），较口语；literature 更正式，强调艺术价值或学术性

advancedExpressions.expression: not ... but ... 连接两个并列成分，意为“不是……而是……”，前后成分对称
advancedExpressions.example: 课件原句：What amazed the child was not a new world, but the unnoticed music of the old.（让孩子惊奇的不是一个新世界，而是旧世界里未被注意的乐音。）仿写：What surprises readers is not the characters in O. Henry's stories but the endings.（让读者感到意外的并不是欧·亨利小说的人物，而是他小说的结局。）

advancedExpressions.type: 构词法·liter- 词族一起记（易混）
advancedExpressions.expression: literature(文学) / literary(文学的) / literate(识字的) / literacy(读写能力) / literal(字面的) / illiterate(文盲的)
advancedExpressions.example: A literate person can read; a literary person loves literature; but literacy — the very ability to read — is still denied to millions of illiterate people. （一句区分四个近形词）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·功能：指'作品/著述'（可替换，含义有别）
advancedExpressions.expression: literature / works / writings / fiction
advancedExpressions.example: the complete works of Shakespeare 莎翁全集；classic literature 经典文学；her early writings 她早期的著述。（literature 不可数、泛指整体，works/writings 可数指具体作品，辨析见 synonyms）

advancedExpressions.expression: it was through literature that sb. first ...
advancedExpressions.example: It was through literature that she first learned to name the storms raging silently within her own heart. （强调句 it was...that+抽象情感具象化，续写升华）

advancedExpressions.expression: let us turn to literature, for ...
advancedExpressions.example: Let us turn to literature in this restless age, for within its pages lies a stillness that no screen can ever offer. （let us 呼吁+for 引出理由，倡议信）

advancedExpressions.expression: literature is not merely ..., but ...
advancedExpressions.example: Literature is not merely a pastime for idle hours, but a lantern that illuminates the darkest corners of the human soul. （not merely...but 递进+隐喻，论点句）

sentenceUpgrade.original: Reading literature is good for us.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: To lose oneself in literature is to wander, unhurried, through the minds of a thousand strangers, returning at last to one's own life a little wiser and a great deal kinder. （议论文·文学的价值）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 不定式主语（To lose oneself...）+ wander through the minds 隐喻 + a little...a great deal 对比收束

sentenceUpgrade.original: She liked the old books very much.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: She cherished those weathered volumes of classic literature as though they were old friends, each dog-eared page whispering a story she had returned to a hundred times. （读后续写·爱书之情）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: as though they were old friends 拟人比喻 + weathered/dog-eared 细节形容词 + whispering 拟人化动词

classPractice.question: 在阅读一部有趣的文学作品时，你可以增加词汇量。（用 literature，课件）...you improve your vocabulary while reading ____ ____ ____ ____ ____.
classPractice.note: 课件原题：an interesting piece of literature；literature 不可数，量词用 a piece of，前加冠词修饰的是 piece

classPractice.question: 请阅读下面两部著名文学作品的节选。（用 literature，课文原句）Read the excerpts below from two famous works of ____.
classPractice.note: 课文原句 works of literature；literature 不可数，前不加冠词、不加 s

classPractice.question: She has a deep love of ____ (literary) works and dreams of becoming a novelist.
classPractice.note: 修饰名词 works 用形容词 literary 文学的；勿与 literate（识字的）混淆

classPractice.question: Sadly, a large number of adults in the region are still ____ (literate / illiterate) and cannot even sign their names.
classPractice.note: 语境'连名字都签不了'，需 illiterate 文盲的；literate 是'识字的'

original_sentence: A child and a man were walking on the beach when the child found a shell and held it to his ear.
readingExamples: A child and a man were walking on the beach when the child found a shell and held it to his ear.
definitionEn:
(1) n. the hard outer covering of an egg, nut, seed, or some animals such as snails and crabs
(2) n. the empty hard case of a sea creature, often found on a beach
(3) n. the outer structure or framework of a building, vehicle, or object, especially when the inside is empty or destroyed
(4) n. a metal case filled with explosive, fired from a large gun

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 壳，外壳（蛋壳/坚果壳/贝壳/龟壳等坚硬的外层）
uncommonMeanings.example: The child cracked the shell of the boiled egg and peeled it slowly, savouring this small, ordinary ritual of a peaceful morning. （读后续写·日常温情）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （建筑/车辆等被毁后剩下的）空架子，空壳
uncommonMeanings.example: After the fire, only the blackened shell of the old theatre remained, its hollow windows staring out like empty eyes. （读后续写·灾后废墟）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 炮弹（内装炸药、由大炮发射的金属弹壳）
uncommonMeanings.example: As shells burst overhead, the villagers huddled in the cellar, praying for the roar to end. （读后续写·战争）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （比喻）失去活力/情感的空壳，形容枯槁之人
uncommonMeanings.example: Grief had hollowed him out; the once cheerful uncle who now sat by the window was but a shell of the man the children had adored. （读后续写·悲痛后的憔悴）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 剥（壳），去（壳）；炮击（用炮弹轰击）
uncommonMeanings.example: On the porch each summer evening, Grandma would shell peas into a chipped enamel bowl while telling us stories of her girlhood. （读后续写·祖孙温情）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （come out of one's shell）变得开朗健谈，不再羞怯
uncommonMeanings.example: It took months of patient encouragement, but the shy new girl finally came out of her shell and began to laugh freely with the rest of us. （读后续写·性格成长）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （shell out）（口语）掏钱，付一大笔钱
uncommonMeanings.example: Reluctantly, he shelled out his last few coins for a warm meal, then shared half of it with the shivering stray dog. （读后续写·善良）

posExamples.sentence: The child pressed the smooth pink shell to his ear, and in the hush of that seaside afternoon he swore he could hear the whole ocean whispering its ancient secrets. （读后续写·海边童趣）
During our seaside clean-up campaign, we collected not only litter but also beautiful shells, which we later displayed to remind everyone of the treasures worth protecting. （应用文·环保活动报告）
A person without genuine convictions is like a shell without a creature inside — outwardly complete, yet empty of the very thing that gives life its meaning. （议论文·信念的重要）
After the fire had burned itself out, only the blackened shell of the old theatre remained, its hollow windows staring out like the eyes of a memory. （读后续写·灾后废墟）

wordForms.other: eggshell (n. 蛋壳), seashell (n. 海贝)

idioms.example: Under the drama teacher's warm guidance, the timid boy slowly came out of his shell and even volunteered for the leading role. （读后续写·突破自我）
After the harsh criticism, she withdrew into her shell, speaking to no one for days on end. （读后续写·受挫退缩）

idioms.idiom: come / bring out of one's shell
idioms.example: A single word of praise from the coach was enough to bring the quiet girl out of her shell. （读后续写·鼓励的力量）

collocations.translation: 捡到一个贝壳【课文原句词块】
collocations.example: 课文原句：A child and a man were walking on the beach when the child found a shell and held it to his ear.（一个孩子和一个男人在海滩散步，孩子捡到一个贝壳并把它贴在耳边。）
She lined the windowsill with seashells, each one a tiny souvenir of a summer she never wanted to forget. （读后续写·珍藏回忆）
The two sisters spent the whole morning gathering shells along the tide line, their pockets soon heavy with salt and treasure. （读后续写·海边亲情）

collocations.phrase: the shell of a building / car
collocations.example: All that survived the earthquake was the trembling shell of the school, yet within a year new walls had risen from the ruins. （读后续写·重建希望）
He gently cracked the shell of the boiled egg, a small domestic ritual that somehow made the strange new house feel a little like home. （读后续写·日常温情）
Reluctantly, he shelled out his last few coins for a warm meal, then shared half of it with the shivering stray dog. （读后续写·善良）
Beneath his hard shell of indifference lay a boy desperate to be understood. （读后续写·外冷内热）
Everyone in the office was treading on eggshells around the exhausted, short-tempered manager. （读后续写·紧张氛围）

synonyms.example: The seed's tough covering protects the tender life curled up inside until spring arrives. （读后续写·生命象征）
synonyms.usage: 泛指任何覆盖/外皮，范围最广；shell 特指坚硬且常中空的外壳（蛋、贝、坚果、建筑架），更具体

synonyms.example: The farmers stripped the golden husks from the corn as the autumn sun sank low. （读后续写·丰收场景）
synonyms.usage: 特指谷物、玉米等植物干燥的外皮壳；shell 更硬（如坚果、贝），husk 多指可剥离的干壳

synonyms.example: Only the steel skeleton of the future stadium stood against the sky. （读后续写·建设中场景）
synonyms.usage: 指建筑/结构的支撑框架；当强调建筑'烧空/被毁只剩外壳'时用 shell，强调支撑结构本身时用 framework/skeleton

advancedExpressions.type: 短语群·shell 一词多用（名/动/习语）
advancedExpressions.expression: come out of one's shell（变开朗）/ retreat into one's shell（退缩沉默）/ shell out（掏钱）/ a shell of one's former self（形容枯槁）
advancedExpressions.example: After his loss he retreated into his shell, a mere shell of his former self, until a friend coaxed him out of his shell — and even got him to shell out for a trip that brought back his smile. （四个短语一段串记）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·功能：写'性格由内向变开朗'（可替换）
advancedExpressions.expression: come out of one's shell / open up / break free from one's shyness / grow more outgoing
advancedExpressions.example: Little by little he came out of his shell = he began to open up = he grew more outgoing. （续写描写性格成长的高级替换）

advancedExpressions.expression: shell → seashell(海贝) / eggshell(蛋壳) / shellfish(贝类) / nutshell(坚果壳)；in a nutshell = 简言之
advancedExpressions.example: In a nutshell, from the eggshell in the kitchen to the seashell on the shore, one small word covers them all. （复合词联想+in a nutshell 惯用语）

advancedExpressions.expression: little by little, sb. came out of his/her shell, until ...
advancedExpressions.example: Little by little, the once silent boy came out of his shell, until one day his laughter was the loudest and warmest in the whole classroom. （渐进副词 little by little+until 结果，续写成长升华）

advancedExpressions.expression: let each shell we leave behind remind us that ...
advancedExpressions.example: Let each shell we carry home from the beach remind us of a shoreline that deserves our care, not our carelessness. （let 呼吁句+象征物寄托主张，倡议书）

advancedExpressions.expression: a ... without ... is no more than an empty shell
advancedExpressions.example: A life crammed with achievements but drained of compassion is no more than an empty shell, glittering on the outside yet hollow within. （no more than 强调+隐喻，论证内在价值）

sentenceUpgrade.original: The shy boy slowly became more open.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Like a hermit crab cautiously venturing beyond its shell, the shy boy edged out of his silence week by week, until at last he stood before the class and spoke in a voice that no longer trembled. （读后续写·克服羞怯）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 寄居蟹明喻呼应 shell 双关 + 渐进时间状语（week by week）+ until at last 收束成长弧线

sentenceUpgrade.original: After the fire, the building was empty and ruined.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: When the smoke finally cleared, nothing was left of the beloved library but a charred shell, its gaping windows staring out at the crowd like the empty eyes of a dear friend who had passed away. （读后续写·灾后废墟）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 时间状语铺垫（When the smoke cleared）+ charred/gaping 感官形容词 + like the empty eyes 拟人比喻传递哀伤

classPractice.question: 孩子捡到一个贝壳，把它贴在耳边。（用 shell，课文原句）The child found a ____ and held it to his ear.
classPractice.note: 课文原句；shell 此处为可数名词'贝壳'

classPractice.question: With the drama teacher's warm encouragement, the timid boy finally came ____ ____ his shell and made many friends.
classPractice.note: 习语 come out of one's shell 变得开朗；out of 表'从……出来'

classPractice.question: Every summer evening Grandma would ____ (shell / collect) peas on the porch while telling old stories.
classPractice.note: 此处 shell 作动词'剥壳'，宾语 peas；collect 意为'收集'不合语境

translation: 即将发生（在某人身上），等待着（某人）
original_sentence: Some such experience as this lies in store for us when we begin the study of literature.
readingExamples: Some such experience as this lies in store for us when we begin the study of literature.
definitionEn:
(1) phr. (of an event or experience) about to happen to someone; waiting to be experienced, often unexpectedly
(2) phr. being prepared or kept ready for future use or for a particular person
(3) phr. (have sth in store) to have something planned or reserved, especially a surprise

posExamples.sentence: As the family packed their bags for the long-awaited journey, none of them could have guessed what wonders and what trials lay in store for them beyond the mountains. （读后续写·旅途伏笔）
We have an exciting surprise in store for every participant of our charity fair, so please mark the date and join us this Saturday afternoon. （应用文·活动通知）
No one can foresee exactly what the future holds in store, yet it is precisely this uncertainty that makes the courage to keep moving forward so admirable. （议论文·面对未知）
Little did the humble fisherman know what fortune lay in store for him the morning he cast his net one final time into the silver dawn. （读后续写·命运转折）

idioms.translation: 为某人准备着某事；某事即将降临
idioms.example: Life, it seemed, had one more test in store for her before it would grant her the peace she so richly deserved. （读后续写·命运考验）
There is a world of adventure in store for those brave enough to step off the beaten path. （议论文·勇于探索）

collocations.phrase: lie / be in store for sb
collocations.translation: 即将发生在某人身上，等待着某人【课件】（something unexpected, a surprise or problem, is about to happen）
collocations.example: 课件原句：Some such experience as this lies in store for us when we begin the study of literature. 当我们开始学习文学的时候，我们也会有如此这般的体验。

collocations.translation: 为某人准备/藏着（不可知的将来）【课件】
collocations.example: 课件：We never know what life holds in store for us. 我们永远不知道等待我们的将是什么样的生活。

collocations.phrase: there is a treat / surprise in store for sb
collocations.translation: 有好事/惊喜等着某人【课件】
collocations.example: 课件：There's a real treat in store for you this New Year! 今年新年有件很开心的事情等着你！

collocations.phrase: lie in store for sb（课文原句）
collocations.translation: 等待着某人，即将降临于某人【课文原句词块】
collocations.example: 课文原句：Some such experience as this lies in store for us when we begin the study of literature.（当我们开始研读文学时，某种如此这般的体验正等待着我们。）

collocations.phrase: lie / be in store for sb
collocations.translation: 等待着某人，即将降临某人
collocations.example: Neither of them realized what heartbreak and what joy lay in store for them at the end of that ordinary summer. （读后续写·情感伏笔）
The teacher had a wonderful surprise in store for the class that had worked so hard all term. （读后续写·师生温情）

collocations.phrase: what the future has in store
collocations.example: We cannot know what the future has in store, but we can decide how bravely we meet it. （议论文·未来与选择）
Grandmother always kept a jar of sweets in store for whenever the grandchildren came to visit. （读后续写·祖孙温情）
The dark clouds gathering on the horizon warned the sailors of the trouble in store. （读后续写·风暴预兆）
For all those who love classical music, there is a rare treat in store at this weekend's concert. （应用文·演出预告）

synonyms.example: A hero's welcome awaited the returning astronauts as the crowd erupted in cheers. （读后续写·凯旋）
synonyms.usage: 为及物动词，直接接宾语（sth awaits sb），较正式；in store 为介词短语，多用于'lie/be in store for sb'，更口语生动，常带未知或惊喜色彩

synonyms.example: Several exciting reforms are already in the pipeline for the coming school year. （应用文·计划通报）
synonyms.usage: 强调'已在计划/进行中'的项目或安排；in store 更强调'即将降临于某人身上'的经历或惊喜，情感色彩更浓

synonyms.example: A long and difficult road lay ahead, but they walked it side by side. （读后续写·并肩前行）
synonyms.usage: 副词，强调时间/空间上'在前方'，中性；in store 侧重'为某人预留/等待着'的意味，常暗含未知或命运感

advancedExpressions.type: 短语群·in store 常见搭配
advancedExpressions.expression: lie / be in store for sb（等待着某人）/ hold / have sth in store for sb（为某人备着某事）/ what the future has in store（未来如何）
advancedExpressions.example: None of us knew what the future had in store, yet fate had a strange surprise in store for us all — a joy that lay quietly in store just around the corner. （三种搭配一段串记）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·功能：写'即将发生/等待着'（可替换）
advancedExpressions.expression: lie in store for sb / await sb / be ahead / be in the pipeline / lie ahead
advancedExpressions.example: Great challenges lay in store for us = awaited us = lay ahead. （辨析见 synonyms；in store 更带未知与命运感）

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·store 前不加冠词
advancedExpressions.expression: in store（固定短语，store 前无 a/the）；主语常为 experience / surprise / trouble 等抽象事物
advancedExpressions.example: A great surprise lies in store（NOT in a store / in the store）for you. 注意与'in a store（在商店里）'区分！ （高考易错点）

advancedExpressions.expression: little did sb. know what lay in store
advancedExpressions.example: Little did the boy know, as he waved goodbye that misty morning, what extraordinary adventures lay in store for him. （little did 倒装+in store 收束，续写埋伏笔）

advancedExpressions.expression: we have ... in store for you, so ...
advancedExpressions.example: We have a whole afternoon of games, music and laughter in store for you, so do not miss this chance to unwind together. （we have...in store for you 亲切句式+呼吁参与，通知）

advancedExpressions.expression: whatever the future may have in store, ...
advancedExpressions.example: Whatever the future may have in store, those who face it with courage and an open mind will always find a way forward. （whatever 让步状语从句+in store，论证积极心态）

sentenceUpgrade.original: They did not know what would happen to them next.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: As the train pulled slowly out of the station, neither of them had the faintest idea of the fateful encounters and unforeseen wonders that lay in store for them down the winding road ahead. （读后续写·旅程伏笔）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 时间状语渲染离别（As the train pulled out）+ neither...had the faintest idea 强化未知 + lay in store 埋下续写伏笔

sentenceUpgrade.original: We have prepared a good surprise for you at the event.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: To reward your unwavering support throughout the year, we have a truly delightful surprise in store for every one of you at this Saturday's celebration. （应用文·活动通知）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 不定式目的状语前置（To reward...）+ have...in store for 亲切预告句式 + every one of you 拉近距离

classPractice.question: 明天你一定会大吃一惊的。（用 in store，课件）There's a surprise ____ ____ ____ you tomorrow.
classPractice.note: 课件原题：in store for you；have/there is a surprise in store for sb 有惊喜等着某人，store 前不加冠词

classPractice.question: 谁也不知道明天会发生什么。（用 lie ... in store，课件）No one knows what lies ____ ____ ____ ____ tomorrow.
classPractice.note: 课件原题：in store for us；what lies in store (for sb) 将要发生什么，store 前无冠词

classPractice.question: 我们永远不知道等待我们的将是什么样的生活。（用 hold ... in store，课件）We never know what life ____ in store for us.
classPractice.note: 课件原句：what life holds in store for us；hold sth in store for sb 为某人备着/藏着，主语 life 用第三人称单数 holds

classPractice.question: 当我们开始研读文学时，某种这样的体验正等待着我们。（用 in store，课文原句）Some such experience as this lies ____ ____ for us when we begin the study of literature.
classPractice.note: 课文原句短语 in store（for sb）即将降临/等待着；store 前不加冠词

classPractice.question: Little did she know what wonderful surprises lay in ____ for her on her birthday.
classPractice.note: 固定短语 in store，store 无冠词；lay 为 lie 的过去式，主谓一致 surprises...lay

classPractice.question: We have a special treat in ____ (store / a store) for every participant, so please join us on Saturday.
classPractice.note: 习语 have sth in store for sb 为某人备着某事；in a store 是'在商店里'，不合意

translation: 有吸引力；申诉；呼吁 n. 吸引力；申诉；呼吁
original_sentence: Let a little song appeal to the ear, or a great book to the heart, and we discover a new world, a world of dreams and magic.
readingExamples: Let a little song appeal to the ear, or a great book to the heart, and we discover a new world, a world of dreams and magic.
definitionEn:
(1) vi. to be attractive or interesting to someone
(2) vi. to make a serious or urgent request, especially to the public
(3) n. a quality that makes someone or something attractive or interesting
(4) n. a formal request to a higher court or authority to change a decision

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【课件】有吸引力，有感染力，引起兴趣（appeal to sb / sth）
uncommonMeanings.example: 课件原句：Let a little song appeal to the ear, or a great book to the heart, and we discover a new world.（让一首小曲愉悦我们的耳朵，或者让一部巨著触动我们的心灵……）课件：That sort of music doesn't appeal to me much.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【课件】恳请，恳求；呼吁（appeal (to sb) for sth / appeal to sb to do sth）
uncommonMeanings.example: 课件：Sophie had some difficulty solving the problem, so she appealed for help. / The police are appealing to the public for any information about the missing girl.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【课件】感染力，吸引力；（an urgent request）恳求；呼吁；上诉——have a great appeal to sb 对某人有很强的吸引力；make an appeal (to sb) 发出呼吁/提出上诉
uncommonMeanings.example: 课件：Films like that have lost their appeal to me. / The police made an appeal to the public to remain calm. 警方呼吁公众保持镇静。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【课件】appealing 有吸引力的；可怜的，希望同情的；appealingly 恳求地，吸引人地——an appealing look 一个惹人怜/满脸恳求的表情
uncommonMeanings.example: 课件：In spring, the scene on top of the hill is so appealing that it is beyond my words. / The dog looked up at her appealingly. 那狗可怜巴巴地抬头望着她。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 有吸引力，投合……的心意（appeal to sb / sth）
uncommonMeanings.example: 课文原句：Let a little song appeal to the ear, or a great book to the heart, and we discover a new world...（让一支小曲打动耳朵，让一部巨著打动心灵，我们便会发现一个新世界……）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 呼吁，恳求（appeal to sb for sth / appeal to sb to do sth）
uncommonMeanings.example: The headmaster appealed to the whole school to show a little more kindness to the new transfer student. （应用文·演讲稿）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 上诉，申诉（对判决/裁定提出异议，appeal against sth）
uncommonMeanings.example: Refusing to accept the referee's verdict, the coach vowed to appeal, convinced that a single unjust call had robbed his players of the medal. （读后续写·体育竞技·不甘）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 吸引力，魅力
uncommonMeanings.example: The enduring appeal of classic literature lies not in fashionable plots but in its power to mirror the human heart. （议论文·经典阅读）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 呼吁，恳求（an appeal for sth）
uncommonMeanings.example: The charity made an urgent appeal for warm clothing before the first snow of winter arrived. （应用文·倡议）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 上诉，申诉
uncommonMeanings.example: Her lawyer lodged an appeal within the hour, but deep down she knew no court could return the years the mistake had stolen. （读后续写·法庭·懊悔）

posExamples.sentence: The moment the old melody drifted out of the record shop, it appealed to something buried deep within her — a childhood she had long thought lost, suddenly warm and vivid again. （读后续写·怀旧·触景生情）
On behalf of our student union, I earnestly appeal to every classmate to join hands with us and donate whatever books they can spare to the mountain-village school. （应用文·倡议书）
The enduring appeal of classic literature lies not in fashionable plots but in its power to hold up a mirror to the human heart across the centuries. （议论文·经典阅读）
I am writing to express my heartfelt support for the appeal launched by the community to restore the neglected public library. （应用文·感谢信/支持信）

wordForms.other: unappealing (adj. 无吸引力的)

collocations.translation: 对……有吸引力，投合……的心意；打动【课件】
collocations.example: 课件：That sort of music doesn't appeal to me much. / The idea of starting my own business really appeals to me. 创业这个主意对我很有吸引力。

collocations.translation: （向某人）恳请/呼吁得到某物【课件】
collocations.example: 课件：The police are appealing to the public for any information about the missing girl. 警方呼吁公众提供关于失踪女孩的任何信息。

collocations.phrase: appeal to sb to do sth
collocations.translation: 呼吁/恳请某人做某事【课件】
collocations.example: 课件：Facing the shortage of water, the government is appealing to everyone to save water. 面对缺水，政府呼吁每个人节约用水。

collocations.phrase: have a great appeal to sb
collocations.translation: 对某人有很强的吸引力【课件】（n.）
collocations.example: 课件：Films like that have lost their appeal to me. 那样的电影对我已失去了吸引力。

collocations.phrase: make an appeal (to sb) to do sth
collocations.translation: （向某人）发出呼吁/提出上诉【课件】（n.）
collocations.example: 课件：The police made an appeal to the public to remain calm. 警方呼吁公众保持镇静。/ She made an appeal to her father for help.

collocations.phrase: appeal to the ear / heart（课文原句）
collocations.translation: 打动耳朵/心灵，投合……的心意【课文原句词块】
collocations.example: 课文原句：Let a little song appeal to the ear, or a great book to the heart, and we discover a new world, a world of dreams and magic.（appeal to = 打动、吸引）

collocations.translation: 对某人有吸引力；恳求某人
collocations.example: The idea of a night hike under the stars appealed to every restless teenager in the camp. （读后续写·夏令营·冒险）
The villagers appealed to the local government for clean drinking water, their patience worn thin by years of empty promises. （读后续写·社会现实）

collocations.phrase: appeal to sb to do sth
collocations.example: The headmaster appealed to the whole school to show a little more kindness to the new transfer student. （应用文·演讲稿）
After the flood, the town appealed for food, blankets and, above all, hope. （应用文·呼吁）
Determined to clear his name, he appealed against the verdict, and the long fight for justice began. （读后续写·坚持）
Volunteering abroad holds tremendous appeal for young people eager to broaden their horizons. （应用文·招募信）
A truly great song has a universal appeal that crosses every border of language and age. （议论文·艺术）
The film's popular appeal ensured that tickets sold out days before the premiere. （应用文·报道）
Once the novelty wore off, the flashy new video game quickly lost its appeal, and the console gathered dust. （读后续写·成长感悟）

collocations.phrase: make an appeal / an appeal for help
collocations.example: Her eyes, brimming with tears, were a silent appeal for help that no passer-by could ignore. （读后续写·情感描写）
Undeterred by the harsh ruling, they launched an appeal that would drag on for three long years. （读后续写·坚持）

synonyms.example: The colourful poster attracted a crowd of curious students within minutes. （应用文·活动宣传）
synonyms.usage: attract 侧重客观地把人/注意力吸引过来，宾语常是 people/attention；appeal to 侧重投合某人的兴趣或品味，主语常是事物、观点。

synonyms.example: For me, the greatest attraction of the countryside is the deep, unbroken silence at dawn. （读后续写·田园）
synonyms.usage: attraction 多指具体的吸引物或吸引这一现象；appeal(n.) 更抽象，强调能打动人心的内在魅力，常与 emotional/wide/universal 连用。

synonyms.example: She knelt and pleaded with the officer to give her son one last chance. （读后续写·亲情）
synonyms.usage: plead 感情色彩更强烈、更卑微急切，多用于面对面的哀求；appeal (for) 更正式、更公开，常用于向公众或机构发出呼吁。

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·be to do 表按计划将来（if the book is to speak）
advancedExpressions.expression: be to do sth 表示按计划/安排将要发生的事，或表示“若要……（目的/条件）”，常见于 if 从句
advancedExpressions.example: 课件原句：We must know all these, if the book is to speak its whole message.（如果要了解一本书所传递的全部信息，我们就必须了解所有这些内容。）——is to speak 是 be to do 的用法，此处 if...is to do 表“若要……”。

advancedExpressions.expression: not ... but ... 连接两个并列成分，前后对称，意为“不是……而是……”
advancedExpressions.example: 课件原句：What amazed the child was not a new world, but the unnoticed music of the old.（让孩子惊奇的不是一个新世界，而是旧世界里未被注意的乐音。）仿写：The true appeal of a book lies not in its fame but in the world it opens within us.（一本书真正的吸引力不在于名气，而在于它在我们心中开启的世界。）

advancedExpressions.type: 短语群·appeal 一词四义（介词定含义）
advancedExpressions.expression: appeal to sb（吸引/恳求某人）/ appeal to sb for sth（向某人求某物）/ appeal for sth（呼吁某物）/ appeal against sth（对……上诉）
advancedExpressions.example: The song appealed to me; the charity appealed to us for donations and appealed for volunteers; meanwhile the prisoner appealed against his sentence. （一段区分四种搭配——关键看介词 to / for / against）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·功能：写'吸引'（可替换）
advancedExpressions.expression: appeal to sb / attract sb / draw sb / hold appeal for sb
advancedExpressions.example: The idea appealed to me = attracted me = held great appeal for me. （辨析：appeal to 侧重'投合兴趣品味'，attract 侧重客观'把人吸引过来'）

advancedExpressions.expression: appeal(v./n.) → appealing(adj. 吸引人的) → appealingly(adv.) → unappealing(adj. 无吸引力的)
advancedExpressions.example: Her appealing smile appealed to everyone; even her rival found the offer far from unappealing. （同根词一句连用）

advancedExpressions.expression: something in ... appealed to a part of sb long forgotten / buried
advancedExpressions.example: Something in the stranger's gentle voice appealed to a part of him long buried beneath years of loneliness. （以抽象心理为宾语，写触动内心的瞬间）

advancedExpressions.expression: I sincerely appeal to ... to ..., for only by ... can we ...
advancedExpressions.example: I sincerely appeal to every one of you to lend a hand, for only by pulling together can we make this dream come true. （appeal to + for only 强调因果，收束呼吁段）

advancedExpressions.expression: the true appeal of ... lies not in ... but in ...
advancedExpressions.example: The true appeal of reading lies not in the escape it offers but in the wisdom it quietly plants in us. （not...but 对比结构凸显本质）

sentenceUpgrade.original: The music appealed to me.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The music did not merely please my ears; it appealed to some hidden corner of my heart, stirring memories I had thought were lost forever and drawing hot, unexpected tears to my eyes. （读后续写·心理+感官描写）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: not merely...it... 递进否定 + 抽象宾语(some hidden corner of my heart) + 分词状语(stirring/drawing)连锁描写心理反应

sentenceUpgrade.original: We should protect our environment, so I ask everyone to help.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: As our rivers grow ever murkier and our skies ever greyer, I earnestly appeal to every fellow citizen to act now, for the earth we borrow from our children brooks no further delay. （应用文·倡议书）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: as 引导环境背景 + earnestly appeal to...to... 正式呼吁句式 + for 引出理由 + brook no delay 高级搭配

classPractice.question: This semester our school offers many optional courses for the students, which ____ (appeal) to many students.
classPractice.note: 课件原题；先行词 courses 为复数，定语从句谓语 appeal to sb 用原形，appeal to = 吸引

classPractice.question: 一旦找到吸引你的那本书，你就必须专心去读。（用 appeal，课件）Once you find the book ____ ____ ____, you must devote yourself to reading.
classPractice.note: 课件原题：that appeals to you；定语从句先行词 the book 作主语，谓语 appeals to 单三

classPractice.question: 警方正呼吁公众提供关于失踪女孩的任何信息。（用 appeal，课件）The police are ____ ____ ____ for any information about the missing girl.
classPractice.note: 课件原题：appealing to the public for；appeal to sb for sth 向某人呼吁得到某物

classPractice.question: 面对缺水，政府正呼吁每个人节约用水。（用 appeal，课件）Facing the shortage of water, the government is ____ ____ ____ ____ save water.
classPractice.note: 课件原题：appealing to everyone to save water；appeal to sb to do sth 呼吁某人做某事

classPractice.type: 单句语法填空（课件·语法填空）
classPractice.question: It is the way he teaches maths that ____ (appeal) to me, not maths itself.
classPractice.note: 课件原题；强调句 It is...that... 中,还原后主语为 the way（第三人称单数），谓语用 appeals

classPractice.type: 单句语法填空（课件·语法填空）
classPractice.question: We should appeal ____ people to save things that nature offers to us.
classPractice.note: 课件原题；appeal to sb to do sth 呼吁某人做某事，此处填介词 to

classPractice.type: 单句语法填空（课件·语法填空）
classPractice.question: They appealed to the villagers ____ money to build the bridge.
classPractice.note: 课件原题；appeal to sb for sth 向某人恳求/募集某物，此处填 for

classPractice.type: 完成句子（课件·语法填空）
classPractice.question: 来自贫困家庭的孩子们正在呼吁享有平等的教育权利。（用 appeal）Children from poor families ____ ____ ____ equal rights in education.
classPractice.note: 课件原题：are appealing for；appeal for sth 呼吁（得到）某物，用现在进行时

classPractice.type: 完成句子（课件·语法填空）
classPractice.question: 原来这本书在过去的350多年里一直吸引着全世界的目光。（用 appeal）The book turns out to be one that ____ ____ ____ the world for more than 350 years.
classPractice.note: 课件原题：has appealed to；for more than 350 years 用现在完成时，appeal to = 吸引

classPractice.type: 单句语法填空（课件·语法填空）
classPractice.question: The government appealed to the International Red Cross ____ (help) the people suffering from the floods.
classPractice.note: 课件原题；appeal to sb to do sth 呼吁某人做某事，用不定式 to help

classPractice.type: 单句语法填空（课件·语法填空）
classPractice.question: What's more, it is another effective way to appeal ____ the news media.
classPractice.note: 课件原题；appeal to sb/sth 向……呼吁/求助，填介词 to

classPractice.question: In spring, the scene on top of the hill is so ____ (appeal) that it is beyond my words.
classPractice.note: 课件原题；be so...that 结构中作表语需形容词 appealing 有吸引力的

classPractice.question: The dog looked up at her ____ (appeal), begging silently for food.
classPractice.note: 课件原题；修饰动词 looked up 需副词 appealingly 可怜巴巴地/恳求地

classPractice.question: 作者向我们呼吁要对动物更加友好。① 用 appeal 作动词：The author ____ ____ ____ ____ be more kind to animals.
classPractice.note: 课件原题：appeals to us to；appeal to sb to do sth（v.）呼吁某人做某事

classPractice.question: 作者向我们呼吁要对动物更加友好。② 用 appeal 作名词：The author ____ ____ ____ ____ ____ be more kind to animals.
classPractice.answer: makes an appeal to us to
classPractice.note: 课件原题：makes an appeal to us to；make an appeal to sb to do sth（n.）向某人发出呼吁做某事

classPractice.question: 让一支小曲打动耳朵，一部巨著打动心灵。（用 appeal，课文原句）Let a little song ____ ____ the ear, or a great book to the heart.
classPractice.note: 课文原句 appeal to sth 打动/吸引；appeal 作'吸引'时后接介词 to

classPractice.question: On behalf of our club, I earnestly appeal ____ every student ____ (donate) whatever books they can spare.
classPractice.note: appeal to sb to do sth 呼吁某人做某事；第一空 to 为介词，第二空为不定式

classPractice.question: Refusing to accept the verdict, the coach decided to appeal ____ (for / against) the decision.
classPractice.note: appeal against sth 对……上诉；appeal for 是'呼吁得到某物'，语境为不服判决

translation: 确定；支配；决心 vi. 决心
original_sentence: The first step is to determine some of its significant qualities.
readingExamples: The first step is to determine some of its significant qualities.
definitionEn:
(1) vt. to officially decide something, or to find out the facts about something
(2) vt. to control or strongly influence what something will be
(3) vi./vt. to decide firmly to do something; to make up one's mind
(4) vt. to calculate or measure something precisely

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 查明，确定（找出事实/弄清情况）
uncommonMeanings.example: 课文原句：The first step is to determine some of its significant qualities.（第一步是确定它的一些重要特征。）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 决定，支配，是……的决定性因素（熟词僻义：主语常为抽象事物，非人）
uncommonMeanings.example: It is not talent alone but the countless hours of quiet practice that determine who finally stands on the winners' podium. （议论文·成功的要素）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 下定决心，决意（determine to do / be determined to do）
uncommonMeanings.example: After a sleepless night, she determined to chase her dream of studying medicine, whatever obstacles lay ahead. （读后续写·下定决心）

posExamples.sentence: Kneeling in the mud, the young detective examined every footprint, determined to determine the exact route the thief had taken before the rain could wash the clues away. （读后续写·悬疑推理）
After a sleepless night, she determined once and for all that she would chase her dream of studying medicine, whatever obstacles lay ahead. （读后续写·下定决心）
I am writing to inform you that the committee has finally determined the theme of this year's English Festival: 'A Bridge Between Cultures'. （应用文·通知）
It is one's attitude, rather than one's circumstances, that ultimately determines how far one can go in life. （议论文·态度与命运）

wordForms.other: predetermine (v. 预先决定); determinism (n. 决定论)

collocations.phrase: determine what is true / what is reasonable【课件】
collocations.translation: 确定什么是真实的（课件·义1 查明事实：to discover the facts / calculate exactly）
collocations.example: 课件原句：The aim of our research is to determine what is true, not what is reasonable.（我们研究的目的是要确定什么是真实的，而不是什么是合理的。）

collocations.phrase: determine what appeals to you【课件】
collocations.translation: 确定什么吸引你（课件·义1，衔接课文语境）
collocations.example: 课件原句：Before starting to read, you should determine what kind of book appeals to you.（开始阅读前，你应该确定什么样的书吸引你。）

collocations.phrase: determine the exact cause of sth【课件】
collocations.translation: 确定/查明……的确切原因（课件·义1）
collocations.example: 课件原句：We have to conduct an investigation to determine the exact cause of the car crash.（我们不得不开展调查以确定这起车祸的确切原因。）

collocations.phrase: a date has (not) been determined【课件】
collocations.translation: 日期（尚未）确定/规定（课件·义2 正式决定、规定：to officially decide and/or arrange sth）
collocations.example: 课件原句：A date for the final game has yet to be determined.（决赛的日期还有待确定。）

collocations.translation: 决定性因素（课件·义2 的现在分词形式作定语）
collocations.example: 课件词块：Talent is not the only determining factor in success.（天赋并非成功唯一的决定性因素。）

collocations.phrase: determine to do sth；be determined to do sth【课件】
collocations.translation: 决心做某事（课件·义3 to decide definitely to do sth；determined adj. 坚定的，determination n. 决心）
collocations.example: 课件原句：Mary determined to study hard so that she could make up for the lost time.（玛丽下决心努力学习以弥补失去的时间。）／ She was determined to work hard.（她决心努力学习。）

collocations.phrase: determine some of its qualities（课文原句）
collocations.translation: 确定它的一些特征【课文原句词块，此处 determine = 弄清/确定】
collocations.example: 课文原句：The first step is to determine some of its significant qualities.（第一步是确定它的一些重要特征。）
Bruised but unbroken, the little climber was determined to reach the summit before sunset. （读后续写·坚持）
He determined to turn over a new leaf and never touch a cigarette again. （读后续写·改过）
The doctors ran further tests to determine whether the treatment was working. （应用文·报道）
The essay explores the key factors that determine a nation's long-term prosperity. （议论文·社会）
A single moment of courage can determine the outcome of an entire life. （议论文·励志）
Investigators worked through the night to determine the cause of the sudden power failure. （应用文·报道）
With grim determination, she pushed the heavy door open and stepped into the unknown. （读后续写·勇气）
Scientists argue that not all human traits are genetically determined; environment plays an equal part. （议论文·科学）

synonyms.example: After much hesitation, she finally decided to accept the offer. （应用文·叙述）
synonyms.usage: decide 是最普通的"做出决定"，语气中性、日常；determine 更正式、更书面，且强调经过思考后坚定不移，或指抽象事物"决定/支配"结果。

synonyms.example: He resolved never to let fear hold him back again. （读后续写·内心独白）
synonyms.usage: resolve 与 be determined 意思相近，语气庄重，多用于书面表达坚定的决心；日常口语更常用 decide/make up one's mind。

synonyms.example: The police first needed to establish the victim's identity. （应用文·报道）
synonyms.usage: 表示"查明事实"时 determine 与 establish 可互换；establish 更强调通过证据"确立/证实"，determine 更强调"查出/判定"。

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·部分倒装（否定词/only+状语前置）
advancedExpressions.expression: Never/Seldom/Only + ...置于句首时，助动词提前，实现部分倒装（配合课件 determine 义3 决心语境）
advancedExpressions.example: Only after that sleepless night did she determine to chase her dream. / Never had she been so determined to succeed. （否定/only 前置引发部分倒装）

advancedExpressions.type: 短语群·determine 三大用法（一词三义，课件对齐）
advancedExpressions.expression: determine + wh-（查明 what is true）/ determine to do & be determined to do（下决心）/ 抽象主语或 a date/factor + determine（决定/规定/决定性）
advancedExpressions.example: The team worked to determine what had caused the failure; more importantly, they were determined to fix it, for they knew this project would determine the company's future. （查明→决心→决定，一段涵盖三义）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·功能：写'下定决心'（可替换）
advancedExpressions.expression: be determined to do / make up one's mind to do / resolve to do / set one's mind on doing
advancedExpressions.example: She was determined to succeed = made up her mind to succeed = resolved to succeed. （续写决心场景高级替换；辨析见 synonyms）

advancedExpressions.expression: determine(v.) → determined(adj. 坚决的) → determination(n. 决心) → determinedly(adv.) → determiner(n. 限定词)
advancedExpressions.example: With fierce determination she worked determinedly, so determined to win that no setback could shake her resolve. （同根词一句连缀）

advancedExpressions.expression: there and then, sb. determined that ...
advancedExpressions.example: There and then, gazing at the fading horizon, she determined that no failure would ever crush her spirit again. （there and then + determined that 表现当下顿悟与决心）

advancedExpressions.expression: the committee has determined that ..., so as to ...
advancedExpressions.example: The committee has determined that the contest will be held online this year, so as to allow every student to take part safely. （正式宣布决定+目的状语）

advancedExpressions.expression: it is not ... but ... that determines ...
advancedExpressions.example: It is not the size of one's dream but the persistence behind it that determines success. （强调句 + determine 抽象主语，凸显决定性因素）

advancedExpressions.type: 短语群·determine 三大用法（一词三义）
advancedExpressions.expression: determine + wh-（查明）/ determine to do & be determined to do（下决心）/ 抽象主语 + determine + n.（决定/支配）
advancedExpressions.example: The team worked to determine what had caused the failure; more importantly, they were determined to fix it, for they knew this project would determine the company's future. （查明→决心→决定，一段涵盖三义）

sentenceUpgrade.original: She decided to keep trying.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Wiping away the last of her tears, she clenched her fists and determined, with a fierceness that surprised even herself, to rise once more and try until she could try no more. （读后续写·意志描写）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 分词状语(Wiping away)前置画面 + 动作细节(clenched her fists) + determine to 表决心 + with a fierceness that... 定语从句渲染强度

sentenceUpgrade.original: Your attitude decides your future.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: It is ultimately not the hand fate deals us, but the attitude with which we play it, that determines the course our lives will take. （议论文·态度决定命运）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: It is not...but...that 强调句 + 隐喻(hand fate deals / play it) + determine 抽象主语 + 定语从句 the course our lives will take 增强文采

classPractice.note: 课件原题；determine 义3 决心做某事，determine to do；亦可 was determined to study hard

classPractice.question: 她决心更加努力工作以弥补失去的时间。She ________________ so that she could make up for the lost time.

classPractice.type: 语境应用·完成句子（课件原题）
classPractice.question: 我们决心立即离开。________________ at once.

classPractice.question: 她表明要实现目标的决心。She has ________ ________ to achieve her goals.
