original_sentence: The first step is to determine some of its significant qualities.
readingExamples: The first step is to determine some of its significant qualities.
definitionEn:
(1) adj. important, large, or noticeable enough to have an effect or to be worth attention
(2) adj. having a special or hidden meaning; expressing a particular message
(3) adj. (of an amount or effect) large enough to be measured or to matter statistically

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 意味深长的，别有含义的（熟词僻义：不是“重要”，而是“暗含深意”）
uncommonMeanings.example: She said nothing, but the significant glance she shot her brother across the dinner table told him everything: their secret was still safe. （读后续写·人物默契·眼神交流）

posExamples.sentence: That rainy afternoon in the tiny bookshop turned out to be the most significant moment of her life — the moment a single poem set her heart on fire and decided her future. （读后续写·命运转折）
I am glad to report that our recycling campaign has brought about a significant reduction in the amount of waste our school produces each week. （应用文·汇报/总结）
Reading plays a significant role in shaping a young mind, for it silently sows the seeds of empathy, imagination and independent thought. （议论文·阅读的意义）
The survey reveals a significant gap between what students say they value and how they actually spend their spare time. （议论文·调查论证）

wordForms.other: 构词法：sign(记号/迹象)→signi-(意义)+-fic(做,来自 facere)+-ant(形容词后缀)=“做出意义的”→重要的；名词 significance、副词 significantly、反义 insignificant(in-否定) 全家桶要一起记。特例：significant 作表语可接 that 从句表“意味深长的”(It is significant that...)；signify 后可跟宾语从句。sign(n. 迹象); signal(n. 信号)

collocations.translation: 重要的（显著的）特质（课文原句词块；significant 修饰名词作定语）
collocations.example: The first step is to determine some of its significant qualities. 第一步是确定它的一些重要特质。（课文原句）

collocations.phrase: play a significant role / part in sth
collocations.example: Teachers play a significant part in nurturing not just knowledge but character. （议论文·教育）

collocations.phrase: a significant impact / effect on sth
collocations.example: The kind words of a stranger had a significant effect on the lonely boy's outlook on life. （读后续写·善意的力量）
After a term of hard work, Li Ming made significant progress in his spoken English. （应用文·表扬信）
A significant number of students voiced their support for the new reading corner. （应用文·调查报告）
There is a significant difference between memorising a language and truly living in it. （议论文·语言学习）
That handwritten letter, faded and creased, was of great significance to the whole family. （读后续写·亲情信物）
The researchers found a statistically significant link between sleep and academic performance. （议论文·科学论证）
Volunteers made a significant contribution to the success of the charity concert. （应用文·感谢信）

synonyms.example: It is important to keep your promise, however small it may seem. （议论文·诚信）
synonyms.usage: 辨析①：important 是最普通、最主观的“重要”，强调对某人有价值、值得关注，可修饰任何事物；作表语常接 it is important to do / that... 从句。significant 更正式、更客观，强调“大到足以产生影响、引人注意或含有深意”，多修饰 change/difference/role/number/effect 等。

synonyms.example: The project required a considerable amount of time and effort. （应用文·总结）
synonyms.usage: 辨析②：considerable 只侧重“数量/程度大”，多修饰 amount/number/sum/time 等，不含“意义/影响”之意；significant 既可指数量大，也强调其带来的影响或意义。

synonyms.example: The most notable feature of her essay was its honesty. （议论文·评价）
synonyms.usage: 辨析③：notable 侧重“值得关注、引人注目、出众”，偏中性描述特征；significant 更强调“有实质影响或深远意义”，语气更重。

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·表示“重要/意义重大”(可替换)
advancedExpressions.expression: significant = important = of great significance = of great importance = play a key / crucial role
advancedExpressions.example: This decision was of great significance to her future. = This decision was highly significant to her future. （句中可互换，语气由弱到强、由口语到正式）

advancedExpressions.expression: play a significant role in / have a significant impact on / make significant progress / a significant number of
advancedExpressions.example: Reading plays a significant role in shaping a young mind and has a significant impact on one's whole life. （一句串起 role in + impact on 两大搭配）

advancedExpressions.expression: signi-fic-ant 意义+做→重要；同理 magni-fic-ent 宏大, terri-fic 极好, scienti-fic 科学的
advancedExpressions.example: Understanding the root -fic (to make) helps you unlock significant, magnificent and scientific at once. （用词根一次记一串）

advancedExpressions.expression: little did sb. know how significant that moment would prove to be
advancedExpressions.example: Little did she know how significant that chance meeting would prove to be in the years that followed. （倒装 little did + 后置感叹，为下文埋伏笔）

advancedExpressions.expression: our efforts have brought about a significant improvement in ...
advancedExpressions.example: Thanks to everyone's dedication, our efforts have brought about a significant improvement in the campus environment. （bring about + significant 汇报成效）

advancedExpressions.expression: ... plays a significant role in ..., in that ...
advancedExpressions.example: Curiosity plays a significant role in learning, in that it turns dull facts into exciting questions worth chasing. （play a significant role in + in that 引出理由）

sentenceUpgrade.original: That day was very important to me.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Looking back, I now understand that that unremarkable grey morning was the most significant turning point of my whole life — the moment a single act of kindness quietly rewrote the person I was to become. （读后续写·回望升华）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: Looking back 回溯视角 + 反差(unremarkable grey / most significant) + 破折号补充定义 + 定语从句 the person I was to become 升华主题

sentenceUpgrade.original: Reading is important for teenagers.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Far from being a mere pastime, reading plays a significant role in a teenager's growth, for it broadens horizons, sharpens judgement and, above all, cultivates the empathy on which a decent society is built. （议论文·阅读的意义）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: Far from being 让步开篇 + play a significant role in + for 引出理由 + 三项排比(broadens/sharpens/cultivates) + on which 定语从句拔高立意

classPractice.question: 第一步是确定它的一些重要特质。The first step is to determine some of its ____ ____.
classPractice.note: 课文原句；significant 作定语修饰名词 qualities

classPractice.question: Reading plays a ____ (significance) role in shaping a young mind.
classPractice.note: 此处需形容词修饰名词 role；significance(n.)→significant(adj.)

classPractice.question: 选词填空 (significant / important): The survey reveals a ____ gap between what students say and what they do.
classPractice.note: 此处考查可测量的差距，gap/difference 这类“大到足以引人注意、可度量”的差异习惯用 significant 搭配；important 侧重主观“重要”，不与 gap 这样表客观差距的名词自然搭配，故答案唯一为 significant。

classPractice.question: Volunteers made a significant ____ (contribute) to the success of the concert.
classPractice.note: make a contribution to 作出贡献；significant 后接名词 contribution

original_sentence: The article below describes the wonder of literature.
readingExamples: The article below describes the wonder of literature.
definitionEn:
(1) n. a piece of writing or speech that says what someone or something is like
(2) n. the act of describing something in words
(3) n. a type, sort, or kind (used in the phrase 'of every / all description')

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 种类，类型（of every/all description = 各种各样的）
uncommonMeanings.example: The old shopkeeper's dusty shelves held curiosities of every description, from cracked pocket watches to maps of countries that no longer existed. （读后续写·神秘小店·奇物罗列）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （好到/坏到）难以形容（beyond description）
uncommonMeanings.example: As the fireworks bloomed over the harbour, the beauty of that night was simply beyond description, and for once we stood in silent awe. （读后续写·环境描写·极致美景）

posExamples.sentence: Her vivid description of the storm was so lifelike that I could almost feel the icy wind biting my cheeks and hear the waves crashing against the rocks. （读后续写·环境渲染）
Please find enclosed a detailed description of the lost wallet, including its brown leather cover and the small scratch on one corner. （应用文·失物招领/求助信）
A good piece of literature offers far more than a plain description of events; it invites us to feel, to question and to grow. （议论文·文学的价值）
The tour guide gave a lively description of each ancient hall, bringing centuries of history back to life before our eyes. （读后续写·参观游览）

wordForms.adjective: descriptive (描述性的); describable / indescribable (无法描述的)
wordForms.other: 构词法：de-(向下,完全)+scribe(写,词根 to write)→“写下来”→describe(v.)→description(n. 去 e 加 -ption)→descriptive(adj.)。同根词族一起记：scribe(抄写员)、prescribe(开处方)、subscribe(订阅)、manuscript(手稿)。特例：注意拼写 describe→description 中 b 变 p；反义 indescribable(in-否定)=beyond description 难以形容。

idioms.translation: 难以形容，无法用言语表达
idioms.example: When she saw her long-lost father waiting at the arrival gate, her joy was beyond description. （读后续写·重逢·情感爆发）

idioms.translation: 符合（对某人/某物的）描述
idioms.example: The man loitering by the bank exactly fitted the description the police had circulated that morning. （读后续写·悬疑）

collocations.translation: 对……的描述/描写（核心搭配；名词 description 后常接 of + 被描述对象。课文动词原句：The article below describes the wonder of literature. 下文这篇文章描述了文学的奇妙。）
collocations.example: The article gives a vivid description of the wonder of literature. 这篇文章生动地描述了文学的奇妙。（据课文 describes 改写为名词搭配）
The witness gave a detailed description of the suspect to the officers. （应用文·报道）
His vivid description of the desert made the whole class feel the scorching heat. （读后续写·感染力）
None of the applicants quite matched the description of the ideal candidate. （应用文·招聘）
Could you provide a brief description of yourself for the exchange programme? （应用文·申请信）
For a lost-and-found notice, an accurate description of the item is essential. （应用文·招领启事）
The charity sale offered goods of every description, and the crowd bustled from stall to stall. （读后续写·集市热闹）
The panic that swept through the crowd was beyond description. （读后续写·危机）
The volunteer job description clearly listed the duties and required time commitment. （应用文·招募）

synonyms.translation: 叙述，描述（尤指事件经过）
synonyms.example: She gave the police a full account of what had happened that terrifying night. （读后续写·陈述经过）
synonyms.usage: account 侧重对“发生的事件、经过”的叙述，强调事情始末；description 侧重对“人、物、景象的样子”的刻画，强调特征外貌。

synonyms.translation: 描绘，刻画（尤指艺术/文学形象）
synonyms.example: The novel's tender portrayal of small-town life moved readers to tears. （议论文·文学评价）
synonyms.usage: portrayal 更书面、更艺术化，多指文学、影视中对人物或生活的刻画；description 更普通中性，可用于日常与说明文。

synonyms.example: The mural's depiction of village festivals captured the joy of a bygone era. （议论文·艺术）
synonyms.usage: depiction 常用于视觉艺术或文字中“生动再现某场景”，偏正式；description 适用范围最广，最常见。

advancedExpressions.expression: give / provide a vivid (detailed / accurate) description of / fit the description / beyond description / of every description
advancedExpressions.example: She gave such a vivid description of the storm that the scene was almost beyond description in its power. （一句连用 give a description of + beyond description）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·表示“描述/描写”(可替换)
advancedExpressions.expression: a description of = an account of = a portrayal of = a depiction of
advancedExpressions.example: The novel offers a moving description / account / portrayal of small-town life. （三者在“对……的描写”语境下可互换，见 synonyms 辨析各自侧重）

advancedExpressions.expression: describe, prescribe, subscribe, manuscript 同含词根 scribe/script(写)
advancedExpressions.example: Once you know scribe means 'to write', describe, prescribe and manuscript all make instant sense. （词根串记法）

advancedExpressions.expression: the ... was beyond description; words simply failed sb.
advancedExpressions.example: The relief that flooded over him was beyond description; words simply failed him as he clutched the rescued kitten to his chest. （beyond description + words failed sb. 强化难以言表之情）

advancedExpressions.expression: enclosed please find a detailed description of ...
advancedExpressions.example: Enclosed please find a detailed description of the missing bag, together with a photograph for your reference. （倒装 enclosed 开头，正式说明附件）

advancedExpressions.expression: great writing offers more than a description of ...; it ...
advancedExpressions.example: Great writing offers more than a description of the world as it is; it dares to imagine the world as it might be. （more than 递进 + as it is / as it might be 对照升华）

sentenceUpgrade.original: He described the mountain village well.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: His description of the mountain village was so vivid and tender that, sitting in the crowded classroom, I could almost smell the wood smoke curling from the chimneys and hear the distant bark of a dog echoing across the misty valley. （读后续写·画面感）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: so...that 结果状语 + 感官动词(smell/hear)营造画面 + 现在分词(curling/echoing)细节化 + 环境词汇(wood smoke/misty valley)增强代入感

sentenceUpgrade.original: Literature is more than describing things.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Far from being a mere description of life, true literature is a mirror in which we recognise ourselves and a window through which we glimpse the lives of others. （议论文·文学的价值）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: Far from being 让步开篇 + 双重隐喻(a mirror / a window) + in which / through which 平行定语从句 + 对称结构增强气势

classPractice.question: The article below ____ (description) the wonder of literature.
classPractice.note: 改写自课文原句；此处作谓语需动词 describe，主语第三人称单数用 describes；名词是 description

classPractice.question: When she saw her long-lost father at the gate, her joy was ____ description.
classPractice.note: beyond description 难以形容、无法用言语表达

classPractice.question: 证人向警察详细描述了嫌疑人。The witness gave the police a detailed ____ ____ the suspect.
classPractice.note: a detailed description of sth 对……的详细描述；名词后接 of

classPractice.question: 用适当词形填空 (describe): His ____ of the village was so vivid that we could smell the wood smoke.
classPractice.note: 形容词性物主代词 His 后需名词，describe→description

translation: 感觉敏锐的；体贴的；敏感的；灵敏的
original_sentence: Some truth and beauty remain unnoticed until a sensitive human soul brings them to our attention, just as the shell reflects the unnoticed sounds.
readingExamples: Some truth and beauty remain unnoticed until a sensitive human soul brings them to our attention, just as the shell reflects the unnoticed sounds.
definitionEn:
(1) adj. able to understand other people's feelings and needs; caring and thoughtful
(2) adj. easily hurt, upset, or offended; reacting strongly to something
(3) adj. (of a device, instrument, or the body) able to detect very small changes
(4) adj. (of a subject or situation) needing to be dealt with carefully because it may cause anger or trouble

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 体贴的，善解人意的（课件·义1 able to understand other people's feelings and problems）【课件】
uncommonMeanings.example: 课件原句：a sensitive and caring man（一个体贴而有爱心的人）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 敏感的，反应快的（课件·义2 react quickly or more than usual to；be sensitive to）【课件】
uncommonMeanings.example: 课件原句：My sister is very sensitive to other people's criticism.（我妹妹对别人的批评很敏感。）／ My teeth are very sensitive to cold food.（我的牙齿对冷食很敏感。）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 艺术感觉好的，有鉴赏力的（课件·义3 able to understand art, music and literature）【课件】
uncommonMeanings.example: 课件原句：an actor's sensitive reading of the poem（演员对这首诗富有感悟力的朗诵）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 易被惹怒的，易生气/易受伤的（课件·义4 easily offended or upset）【课件】
uncommonMeanings.example: He is very sensitive and takes even the mildest joke to heart.（他很容易生气，连最温和的玩笑都会往心里去。）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （信息/话题）需谨慎对待的，敏感的（课件·义5 [information]）【课件】
uncommonMeanings.example: This is highly sensitive information that must not be leaked to the press.（这是高度敏感的信息，绝不能泄露给媒体。）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （问题/话题）敏感的，需谨慎处理的
uncommonMeanings.example: Aware that money was a sensitive subject in their household, the boy swallowed his request for new shoes and said nothing. （读后续写·家境·懂事）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （仪器/皮肤等）灵敏的，易受影响的
uncommonMeanings.example: The camera was so sensitive to light that even the faint glow of a distant star left its mark on the film. （读后续写·科技/摄影场景）

posExamples.sentence: Sensitive to the sadness hidden behind her friend's forced smile, Anna quietly slipped a note into her hand: 'Whatever it is, you don't have to face it alone.' （读后续写·友情·体贴）
As a class monitor, one should be sensitive to the feelings of every classmate, especially those who are shy or new to our school. （应用文·倡议/演讲）
A truly great writer is sensitive to the small, overlooked details of daily life, and it is precisely these details that make his work ring true. （议论文·文学素养）
The little seedling proved extremely sensitive to cold, drooping at the first touch of frost, so Grandpa wrapped it gently in an old cloth each night. （读后续写·自然/亲情）

wordForms.noun: sensitivity (敏感，体贴); sense (感觉，理智); sensibility (感受力)
wordForms.adjective: sensitive (敏感的); insensitive (麻木的，不体贴的); sensible (明智的，注意区分！)
wordForms.adverb: sensitively (体贴地); insensitively; sensibly (明智地)
wordForms.other: 构词法：词根 sens/sent(感觉,to feel)→sense(感觉)→sensitive(-itive 易感的)。同根词族：sensation(感觉,轰动)、sensory(感官的)、sensor(传感器)。形近易混一定要连着背：sensitive(敏感)↔sensible(明智)；sensitivity(敏感)↔sensibility(感受力)。sensor (n. 传感器)

collocations.phrase: a sensitive and caring man【课件】
collocations.translation: 一个体贴而有爱心的人（课件·义1 体贴的、善解人意的）
collocations.example: 课件原句：a sensitive and caring man（一个体贴而有爱心的人）

collocations.translation: 对……敏感/反应强烈（课件·义2；也对应义1 对……体察入微）
collocations.example: 课件原句：My sister is very sensitive to other people's criticism.（我妹妹对别人的批评很敏感。）／ My teeth are very sensitive to cold food.（我的牙齿对冷食很敏感。）

collocations.phrase: a sensitive reading of the poem【课件】
collocations.translation: 富有感悟力/鉴赏力的朗诵（课件·义3 艺术感觉好的）
collocations.example: 课件原句：an actor's sensitive reading of the poem（演员对这首诗富有感悟力的朗诵）

collocations.phrase: sensitive information / a sensitive issue【课件】
collocations.translation: 敏感信息／敏感问题（课件·义5 需谨慎对待的）
collocations.example: The document contains sensitive information about the company's finances.（这份文件包含关于公司财务的敏感信息。）

collocations.translation: 一颗敏锐/善感的心灵（课文原句词块；sensitive 作定语，此处指“感觉敏锐、善于体察美”）
collocations.example: Some truth and beauty remain unnoticed until a sensitive human soul brings them to our attention. 有些真与美一直不被察觉，直到一颗敏锐的心灵把它们带到我们眼前。（课文原句）
A good teacher is sensitive to the different needs of every child. （议论文·教育）

collocations.translation: 对……很在意/容易介意（怕被提及）
collocations.example: He had always been sensitive about his height, so no one dared to mention it. （读后续写·人物心理）
The teacher handled the sensitive topic of divorce with remarkable tact. （应用文·报道）
People with sensitive skin should choose gentle, fragrance-free products. （应用文·说明）
Being emotionally sensitive, she wept openly at the film's tender ending. （读后续写·情感）
The nurse handled the frightened child sensitively, kneeling to his eye level and speaking softly. （读后续写·关怀）
Young writers are often overly sensitive to criticism, taking every comment to heart. （议论文·成长）
The device is highly sensitive to the slightest change in temperature. （议论文·科技）

synonyms.translation: 明智的，通情达理的（形近易混词，非“敏感”！）
synonyms.example: It was sensible of her to take an umbrella, for the sky had darkened by noon. （应用文/读后续写·明智之举）
synonyms.usage: 形近辨析（重点）：sensitive = 敏感的/体贴的（对情绪、刺激反应灵敏），常搭 be sensitive to/about；sensible = 明智的/合乎情理的（判断力好），常搭 It is sensible (of sb) to do。二者拼写只差一点，含义完全不同——“sensitive 感觉灵，sensible 脑子清”。名词也不同：sensitivity(敏感) vs sensibility(感受力)/sense(理智)。

synonyms.example: It was considerate of him to walk the elderly lady home in the dark. （读后续写·善意）
synonyms.usage: 辨析：considerate 侧重行为上主动为他人着想、做出体贴之举（It is considerate of sb to do）；sensitive 侧重能敏锐察觉他人情绪的内在感知力，未必表现为具体行动。

synonyms.example: A thoughtful gift needn't be expensive, only heartfelt. （应用文·感谢信）
synonyms.usage: 辨析：thoughtful 强调用心为对方着想、周到，也可指“爱思考的”；sensitive 更强调对情绪、氛围的细腻感知，且可含“易受伤/易被冒犯”的中性或负面义。

synonyms.example: Negotiating between the two angry sides was a delicate task. （议论文·处理棘手问题）
synonyms.usage: 辨析：指“棘手需谨慎”时 sensitive 与 delicate 近义（a sensitive/delicate issue）；delicate 还可指“精致、脆弱”，sensitive 还可指“对刺激反应灵敏”。

advancedExpressions.expression: be sensitive to sth (体察到) / be sensitive about sth (很介意) / a sensitive issue / handle sth sensitively
advancedExpressions.example: A good friend is sensitive to your mood but never sensitive about being teased. （一句对照 to 与 about 的差别）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·表示“体贴/善解人意”(可替换)
advancedExpressions.expression: sensitive to sb's feelings = considerate = thoughtful = understanding = caring
advancedExpressions.example: She was sensitive / considerate / thoughtful enough to notice the sadness behind his smile. （功能相同，可互换，语气各有侧重）

advancedExpressions.type: 构词法·sens- 词族与形近对比
advancedExpressions.expression: sens(feel)→sense, sensitive, sensation, sensor；勿与 sensible(明智) 混
advancedExpressions.example: Remember: a sensitive person feels deeply; a sensible person thinks clearly. （一句区分形近词）

advancedExpressions.expression: sensitive to the ... beneath sb's ..., sb. ...
advancedExpressions.example: Sensitive to the loneliness beneath the old man's cheerful greeting, she pulled up a chair and stayed to listen. （分词短语前置，表现敏锐察觉+主动关怀）

advancedExpressions.expression: let us be sensitive to ... and lend a hand whenever ...
advancedExpressions.example: Let us be sensitive to the struggles of our new classmates and lend a hand whenever they feel lost. （倡议句式，号召同理心）

advancedExpressions.expression: what sets ... apart is a rare sensitivity to ...
advancedExpressions.example: What sets a great artist apart is a rare sensitivity to the beauty that ordinary eyes overlook. （what 引导主语从句 + sensitivity to 名词化，凸显核心品质）

sentenceUpgrade.original: She noticed her friend was sad and comforted her.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Sensitive to the faint tremor in her friend's voice, she said nothing at first; she simply reached out, took the trembling hand in hers, and let the silence say what words never could. （读后续写·无声的安慰）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 分词状语(Sensitive to...)前置 + 细节捕捉(faint tremor) + 动作三连(reached out/took/let) + let the silence say... 以静写深情

sentenceUpgrade.original: Good writers pay attention to small things.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: What distinguishes a truly gifted writer is a heightened sensitivity to the small, forgotten details of everyday life — a fading photograph, a half-heard sigh — for it is in such fragments that the deepest truths quietly hide. （议论文·文学素养）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: What 引导主语从句 + sensitivity to 名词化 + 破折号举例(具体意象) + for it is...that 强调句收束，提炼观点

original_sentence: Some truth and beauty remain unnoticed until a sensitive human soul brings them to our attention, just as the shell reflects the unnoticed sounds.
readingExamples: Some truth and beauty remain unnoticed until a sensitive human soul brings them to our attention, just as the shell reflects the unnoticed sounds.
definitionEn:
(1) n. the spiritual part of a person, believed to continue existing after the body dies
(2) n. a person's deep inner feelings, character, and moral nature
(3) n. a person (used especially with words showing sympathy or affection)
(4) n. the deeply felt quality or spirit that gives something warmth, emotion, and life

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （可数）人，家伙（尤含同情或喜爱，常用 poor/kind soul）
uncommonMeanings.example: The poor soul had walked ten miles in the rain just to return a coin he thought he had underpaid. （读后续写·善良的陌生人·感人）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 灵魂人物；核心，精髓（the soul of sth）
uncommonMeanings.example: Grandmother was the very soul of our family; when she passed, the old house fell silent and something warm went out of every room. （读后续写·亲情·失去）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 灵魂乐（音乐流派，soul music）
uncommonMeanings.example: From the corner café drifted the warm, aching notes of old soul, and for a moment the whole rainy street seemed to slow down and listen. （读后续写·氛围渲染）

posExamples.sentence: As the last note of the violin faded into the night, it seemed to reach right into my soul, stirring a longing I had no words to name. （读后续写·音乐·心灵触动）
On this special day, I sincerely wish that peace and joy may fill the soul of everyone gathered here in the spirit of friendship. （应用文·致辞/贺词）
Great literature nourishes the soul, teaching us to feel more deeply, to think more clearly and to love more truly. （议论文·文学与心灵）
Not a soul was in sight as she crossed the empty square at midnight, her own footsteps echoing eerily off the silent walls. （读后续写·悬疑·孤寂环境）

wordForms.adjective: soulful (深情的); soulless (没有灵魂的，冷冰冰的)
wordForms.other: 构词法与特例：soul + -ful → soulful(深情的); soul + -less → soulless(无灵魂的)。复合词族：soulmate(灵魂伴侣)、soul-searching(深刻反省)、soul music(灵魂乐)。贴士：soul 作“人”讲时可数(a kind soul / not a soul)，作“灵魂、精髓”讲时常搭 the soul of。注意音标 /səʊl/ 与 sole(唯一的/鞋底) 同音，写作时勿混。

idioms.example: She knocked and knocked, but not a soul answered in the whole deserted village. （读后续写·孤寂）
He threw himself heart and soul into caring for the injured stray dog. （读后续写·全情投入）

idioms.idiom: the life and soul of the party
idioms.translation: 全场最活跃的人，聚会灵魂
idioms.example: Shy at school, Tom was surprisingly the life and soul of the party once the music began. （读后续写·反差人物）
Under the vast starry sky, the two old friends finally bared their souls to each other. （读后续写·深夜谈心）
In those hard years, a bowl of thin porridge was all that kept body and soul together. （读后续写·苦难岁月）

collocations.translation: 一颗敏锐/善感的心灵（课文原句词块；soul 此处指“人的心灵、内心”）
collocations.example: Some truth and beauty remain unnoticed until a sensitive human soul brings them to our attention. 有些真与美一直不被察觉，直到一颗敏锐的心灵把它们带到我们眼前。（课文原句）
Genuine emotion is the soul of any great performance. （议论文·艺术）
The long walk in the mountains refreshed her body and soul. （读后续写·治愈）
The old song touched the soul of every listener in the quiet hall. （读后续写·感染力）

collocations.translation: 善良的/可怜的/温柔的人
collocations.example: The gentle old soul next door always had a warm smile and a cup of tea for the lonely. （读后续写·邻里温情）
Deep in her soul she knew the truth, though she dared not speak it aloud. （读后续写·内心独白）
In that quiet bookshop she found not just a friend but a kindred soul. （读后续写·知己）

collocations.translation: 出卖灵魂（为利益放弃原则）
collocations.example: He refused to sell his soul for fame, choosing instead to stay true to his art. （议论文·坚守本心）

collocations.phrase: put one's heart and soul into sth
collocations.example: She put her heart and soul into the charity project, and it showed in every detail. （应用文·总结）

synonyms.example: Nothing could crush the fighting spirit of the young athlete. （读后续写·意志）
synonyms.usage: spirit 侧重“精神、志气、活力”，可指气概、情绪或宗教意义上的灵；soul 更侧重“内心最深处的情感与道德本性”，更私密、更感性，也常指“个人”。

synonyms.example: Her words came straight from the heart and moved us all. （读后续写·真情）
synonyms.usage: heart 侧重情感、爱与勇气所在，日常最常用；soul 更宏大、更精神化，指人的本质与灵魂，文学色彩更浓。

synonyms.example: Kindness is the very essence of true friendship. （议论文·友谊）
synonyms.usage: 表示“精髓、核心”时 the soul of sth 与 the essence of sth 近义；essence 更抽象客观、偏说明；the soul of 更富感情与温度。

advancedExpressions.expression: not a soul (一个人也没有) / heart and soul (全心全意) / body and soul (身心) / the soul of (……的灵魂)

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·表示“内心/精神”(可替换)
advancedExpressions.expression: soul = heart = spirit = inner self (视语境可替换)
advancedExpressions.example: The melody stirred something deep in her soul / heart / spirit. （三者在“触动内心”语境下可互换，见 synonyms 辨析侧重）

advancedExpressions.type: 构词法·soul 复合词与派生词
advancedExpressions.expression: soulful, soulless, soulmate, soul-searching, soul music
advancedExpressions.example: After much soul-searching, the soulful singer finally found her true soulmate. （复合词族串记）

advancedExpressions.expression: it reached right into sb's soul, stirring ...
advancedExpressions.example: The melody reached right into my soul, stirring a tenderness I thought the years had long buried. （reach into one's soul + 现在分词，写深度触动）

advancedExpressions.expression: may ... fill the soul of every ... with ...

advancedExpressions.expression: ... is not merely ...; it is food for the soul
advancedExpressions.example: Reading is not merely a pastime; it is food for the soul, quietly shaping who we are and who we long to become. （not merely...it is 递进 + food for the soul 隐喻升华）

sentenceUpgrade.original: The music moved me deeply.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: As the final chord trembled and died away, the music seemed to reach right into my soul, stirring memories and longings I had no words for, and I sat perfectly still, afraid that even a breath might break the spell. （读后续写·音乐心灵体验）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: As 时间状语铺垫 + reach into one's soul 隐喻 + 现在分词(stirring)连锁心理 + afraid that... 细节动作,以静衬情

sentenceUpgrade.original: Reading is good for people's minds.

translation: 反映，显示；映出（影像）；反射（声、光、热等）；沉思
original_sentence: Some truth and beauty remain unnoticed until a sensitive human soul brings them to our attention, just as the shell reflects the unnoticed sounds.
readingExamples: Some truth and beauty remain unnoticed until a sensitive human soul brings them to our attention, just as the shell reflects the unnoticed sounds.
definitionEn:
(1) vt. to show or be a sign of a particular situation, feeling or attitude
(2) vt. & vi. to throw back light, heat, sound or an image from a surface
(3) vi. to think carefully and deeply about something, especially your own past actions
(4) vi. (of an action or fact) to give a good or bad impression of someone or something

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 反映，显示（是……的表现/征兆）（课件·义1 to show or be a sign of a particular situation or feeling）【课件】
uncommonMeanings.example: 课件原句：The drop in plastic bag use reflects concern about the environment.（塑料袋使用量的减少反映了人们对环境的关注。）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 映出，照出（影像）（课件·义2 be reflected in a mirror/glass/water）【课件】
uncommonMeanings.example: 课件原句：He saw himself reflected in the water / mirror / shop window.（他看到自己映在水/镜子/橱窗里。）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 反射（光、热或声音）（课件·义3 to send back light, heat or sound）——亦为课文本义【课件】
uncommonMeanings.example: 课件原句：The sidewalks reflect heat on a hot day.（大热天人行道会反射热量。）／ 课文原句：just as the shell reflects the unnoticed sounds（正如贝壳反射那些无人留意的声音）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 沉思，深思，思考（课件·义4 reflect on/upon sth；on/upon reflection 经过考虑；reflection n. 反映/反射/映象/反思）【课件】
uncommonMeanings.example: 课件原句：The manager needed time to reflect on / upon the likely consequences of this course of action.（经理需要时间来思考这一举措可能的后果。）／ On/Upon reflection, I was determined to take the job.（经过考虑，我决定接受这份工作。）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 沉思，反思（reflect on / upon sth，课文延伸的高频义，非“反射光线”）
uncommonMeanings.example: Alone by the dying campfire, she reflected on the long road she had travelled, every stumble now glowing softly in her memory. （读后续写·夜晚独处·回望成长）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 反射（声、光、热或影像）——课文本义（the shell reflects the unnoticed sounds 贝壳反射那些无人留意的声音）
uncommonMeanings.example: The still lake reflected the crimson clouds so perfectly that sky and water seemed one. （读后续写·湖光倒影）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 反映，显示（是……的表现/写照）
uncommonMeanings.example: The choices a nation makes in crisis reflect its true values. （议论文·价值观）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 使蒙羞;给……带来（好/坏）名声（常用 reflect on / upon）
uncommonMeanings.example: The way you behave at the ceremony will reflect on the whole team, so hold your head high and let your manners speak for you. （读后续写·集体荣誉·长辈叮嘱）

posExamples.sentence: Alone by the dying campfire, she reflected on the long road she had travelled — every scar, every stumble, every small mercy of a stranger's kindness now glowing softly in her memory. （读后续写·夜晚独处·回望成长）
I sincerely hope this letter reflects not only my gratitude but also the deep respect I hold for everything you have taught our whole class over these three unforgettable years. （应用文·感谢信）
The choices a nation makes in times of crisis reflect its true values far more accurately than any slogan proclaimed in times of peace and comfort. （议论文·价值观）
The still surface of the mountain lake reflected the crimson clouds so perfectly that for a moment she could not tell where the sky ended and the water began. （读后续写·环境描写·湖光倒影）

wordForms.adjective: reflective (沉思的；反光的) / reflected (被反射的)
wordForms.other: 构词法：re-(回,back)+flect(弯,词根 to bend)→“把光/声/思绪弯回来”→反射/反映/反思，一词三义都由此而来。同根词族：flexible(灵活的,可弯的)、flex(弯曲)。特例辨义：reflection 兼作“倒影/反射”与“反思”双义；reflective 兼作“反光的”与“好沉思的”双义，靠语境判断。reflector（反光器）

collocations.translation: 反映（关注/某种状况）（课件·义1 to show or be a sign of）
collocations.example: 课件原句：The drop in plastic bag use reflects concern about the environment.（塑料袋使用量的减少反映了人们对环境的关注。）

collocations.phrase: be reflected in the water / mirror【课件】
collocations.translation: 映现/照出在水中/镜中（课件·义2 照出影像）
collocations.example: 课件原句：He saw himself reflected in the water / mirror / shop window.（他看到自己映在水/镜子/橱窗里。）

collocations.translation: 反射热/光/声（课件·义3；亦为课文 the shell reflects sounds 本义）
collocations.example: 课件原句：The sidewalks reflect heat on a hot day.（大热天人行道会反射热量。）

collocations.translation: 沉思/深思/反思某事（课件·义4）
collocations.example: 课件原句：The manager needed time to reflect on / upon the likely consequences of this course of action.（经理需要时间来思考这一举措可能的后果。）

collocations.translation: 经过考虑，仔细想过之后（课件短语；reflection n.）
collocations.example: 课件原句：On/Upon reflection, I was determined to take the job.（经过考虑，我决定接受这份工作。）

collocations.translation: 反射那些无人留意的声音（课文原句词块；reflect 作“反射声/光/影像”的本义）
collocations.example: Just as the shell reflects the unnoticed sounds. 正如贝壳反射那些无人留意的声音。（课文原句）

collocations.translation: 反思、沉思某事（高频考点，介词 on 不能少）
collocations.example: Before making so grave a decision, she took a whole night to reflect on what truly mattered to her. （读后续写·抉择时刻）

collocations.translation: 给某人带来（好/坏）影响或名声
collocations.example: A single act of dishonesty can reflect badly on an otherwise spotless reputation. （议论文·诚信）
The soaring number of volunteers reflects a heartening change in how young people view social responsibility. （应用文·调查报告）
The freshly fallen snow reflected the morning sunlight so fiercely that we had to shield our eyes. （读后续写·雪景）
Her inner calm was reflected in every unhurried, deliberate movement of her hands. （读后续写·人物刻画）
The gloomy grey sky seemed to reflect the mood of the entire graduating class as they said goodbye. （读后续写·离别·情景交融）
I would suggest that the school set aside ten quiet minutes each day to give students time to reflect. （应用文·建议信）
Reflecting deeply on his failure, the young inventor finally understood where his design had gone wrong. （读后续写·励志）

synonyms.example: The novel mirrors the anxieties of an entire generation caught between tradition and change. （议论文·文学与社会）
synonyms.usage: 辨析：mirror 作动词时更形象，强调如镜子般忠实、完整地映照，常用于文学与社会评论；对应 reflect 的“反映/映现”义，但 reflect 更通用、正式，且还兼有“反射光线”和“反思”义。

synonyms.example: She sat by the window, pondering the strange offer the old man had made. （读后续写·思索）
synonyms.usage: 辨析：ponder 只对应 reflect 的“深思、琢磨”这层含义，语气更文学化，不含“反射光线/反映情况”之意，可替换 reflect on。

synonyms.example: The results clearly indicate that regular reading improves writing ability. （议论文·数据论证）
synonyms.usage: 辨析：indicate 侧重客观地“指示、表明”事实，多用于数据与研究结论；reflect 更强调“映现内在实质”，是内在特质在外的体现。

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·reflect on 与 reflect 及物的区别
advancedExpressions.expression: reflect on sth = 反思(不及物,加 on)；reflect sth = 反映/反射(及物,直接跟宾语)
advancedExpressions.example: She paused to reflect on her choice (反思), for her choice would reflect her character (反映). （同词双义，靠有无 on 区分）

advancedExpressions.expression: reflect on/upon sth (反思) / reflect a trend (反映趋势) / reflect light (反射光) / be reflected in (体现于) / reflect well/badly on sb (给人好/坏印象)
advancedExpressions.example: The lake reflected the sky, while she reflected on how the results reflected a worrying trend. （一句演绎“反射/反思/反映”三义）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·表示“反思”(可替换)
advancedExpressions.expression: reflect on = ponder = think deeply about = look back on = contemplate
advancedExpressions.example: Looking back, she reflected on / pondered / contemplated all she had lost and gained. （功能相同，可互换）

advancedExpressions.expression: as she reflected on ..., it slowly dawned on her that ...
advancedExpressions.example: As she reflected on all those years of silent effort, it slowly dawned on her that the journey itself had been the reward. （现在分词+顿悟句式，结尾段升华）

advancedExpressions.expression: looking back, I cannot help but reflect on how much ...
advancedExpressions.example: Looking back, I cannot help but reflect on how much this experience has reshaped the person I have become. （感谢信/发言稿总结段，情感真挚）

advancedExpressions.expression: what ... does is not merely ..., but reflects ...
advancedExpressions.example: What a person chooses to defend in silence does not merely reveal courage, but reflects the very core of his character. （递进结构，透过现象看本质）

sentenceUpgrade.original: She thought about her past by the fire.

sentenceUpgrade.original: The survey shows people read more now.

translation: 有能力，有才能；能力强的
original_sentence: " One who reads it is capable of seeing the beauty that was hidden from his eyes before.
readingExamples: " One who reads it is capable of seeing the beauty that was hidden from his eyes before.
definitionEn:
(1) adj. having the ability, skill or power needed to do something (capable of doing sth)
(2) adj. having the qualities or nature necessary to produce a particular result (capable of sth)
(3) adj. clever, efficient and able to do things well; competent

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 能力强的，能干的（课件·义2 able to do things well）【课件】
uncommonMeanings.example: 课件原句：She's a very capable teacher.（她是一位非常能干的老师。）

posExamples.sentence: Trembling at the foot of the cliff, the boy suddenly realised he was capable of far more than he had ever dared to imagine, and he began, hand over hand, to climb. （读后续写·突破自我·攀爬）
I am writing to recommend Li Hua, a highly capable and dependable student who I am certain will handle the responsibilities of monitor with great care. （应用文·推荐信）
History has shown time and again that ordinary people, when united by a common purpose, are capable of achieving the seemingly impossible. （议论文·团结的力量）
Beneath that gentle, unassuming smile lay a fiercely capable mind that had solved problems the finest engineers had abandoned as hopeless. （读后续写·人物反差·揭示能力）

wordForms.adjective: capable (有能力的; 反义 incapable 无能力的)
wordForms.other: 构词法：词根 cap(拿,抓住,to take/hold)+-able(能……的)→“能抓住/胜任的”→capable→名词 capability(-ity)。同根词族：capacity(容量,能力)、capture(捕获)、captive(俘虏)。特例·句型对比：capable 只能说 be capable of (doing) sth，不能说 capable to do；反义 incapable 也接 of。

collocations.translation: 有能力做某事（课件·义1 having the qualities or ability needed to do sth；capable 后接 of + n./doing，不接 to do）
collocations.example: 课件原句：You are capable of better work than this.（你有能力做得比这更好。）／ I am perfectly capable of looking after myself.（我完全有能力照顾自己。）

collocations.translation: 一位能干的老师（课件·义2 能力强的、能干的）
collocations.example: 课件原句：She's a very capable teacher.（她是一位非常能干的老师。）

collocations.phrase: the capability of doing sth【课件】
collocations.translation: 做某事的能力（课件；capability n. 能力，能耐）
collocations.example: 课件原句：Animals in the zoo have lost the capability of catching food for themselves.（动物园里的动物已失去自己捕食的能力。）

collocations.translation: 反义词 incapable 无能力的；副词 capably 能干地；名词 capability 能力（课件词族对比）
collocations.example: A capable leader works capably, whereas an incapable one soon reveals a lack of real capability.（能干的领导做事得力，而无能者很快就暴露出缺乏真本领。）

collocations.translation: 有能力做某事；可能做出某事（课文原句词块；capable 后必接 of + 名词/doing，不接 to do）
collocations.example: One who reads it is capable of seeing the beauty that was hidden from his eyes before. 读它的人便能看到从前对他隐藏的美。（课文原句）

collocations.translation: 能干的领导 / 学生；可靠的人
collocations.example: The project was left in the capable hands of a girl who had never once let the team down. （读后续写·信任）
Determined to prove herself capable, she volunteered for the very task everyone else feared. （读后续写·励志）
Don't worry about her — she is more than capable of handling the crowd on her own. （读后续写·对话）
A highly capable team of volunteers made the charity event run smoothly from start to finish. （应用文·活动报道）
The old teacher believed that every child, no matter how shy, was capable of great things. （读后续写·师生·信念）
Exhausted and frozen, he was hardly capable of taking another step through the blinding snow. （读后续写·极限处境）

synonyms.example: He is an able and hard-working young man who deserves this opportunity. （应用文·推荐信）
synonyms.usage: 辨析（重点·句法差别）：be capable of doing sth 用介词 of + 动名词，且更含“有此能耐/有可能做出”之意（含潜在可能，也可指坏事：be capable of murder）；be able to do sth 用 to + 动词原形，多陈述“客观上能够做到”的事实。作定语时 an able / capable student 近义。记忆点：capable of doing ↔ able to do，介词和句型不可混。

synonyms.example: She proved a competent organiser, calm even when a dozen problems struck at once. （应用文·活动总结）
synonyms.usage: 辨析：competent 侧重“足以胜任某项具体工作、达到合格标准”，语气客观、偏中性；capable 更强调潜在能力与办事本领，可搭 be capable of doing。

synonyms.example: The talented young violinist silenced the entire hall with a single note. （读后续写·才华展露）
synonyms.usage: 辨析：talented 侧重与生俱来的天赋，多形容艺术、体育才能；capable 侧重后天可胜任、有办事能力，二者语义重心不同。

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·capable of vs able to
advancedExpressions.expression: be capable of + n./doing（介词+动名词） ≠ be able to + do（不定式）
advancedExpressions.example: She is capable of finishing it alone (of doing), and I am sure she is able to finish it in time (to do). （同一意思，两种句型，介词与不定式不可混）

advancedExpressions.expression: be capable of doing sth / more than capable / prove oneself capable / in the capable hands of
advancedExpressions.example: Having proved herself more than capable, she left the whole event in the capable hands of her team. （一句串起 prove capable + capable hands）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·表示“有能力做某事”(可替换)
advancedExpressions.expression: be capable of doing = be able to do = have the ability to do = be up to (doing)
advancedExpressions.example: He is capable of / able to / has the ability to solve it on his own. （功能相同，注意搭配句型各异）

advancedExpressions.expression: not until ... did sb. realise how capable ... truly was
advancedExpressions.example: Not until she stood, breathless, at the summit did she realise how capable she truly was. （部分倒装，续写高潮处强调觉醒）

advancedExpressions.expression: I am confident that ... is more than capable of ...
advancedExpressions.example: I am confident that he is more than capable of representing our school with dignity and enthusiasm. （推荐信正式表态，语气坚定）

advancedExpressions.expression: human beings are capable of ..., provided that ...
advancedExpressions.example: Human beings are capable of extraordinary compassion, provided that we resist the temptation to look away. （让步条件收束，突出前提）

sentenceUpgrade.original: She found she could do it.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: In that trembling moment, she discovered she was capable of far more than fear had ever let her believe. （读后续写·心理转折）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: be capable of 替换 could + far more than 比较级夸张 + fear had let her believe 拟人化障碍 + 时间状语渲染氛围

sentenceUpgrade.original: He is a good student, so I recommend him.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: It is my firm belief that Li Hua, a remarkably capable and conscientious student, is the ideal candidate for this exchange programme. （应用文·推荐信）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: It is my firm belief that 正式主句 + 同位语插入(a...student)扩充信息 + remarkably/conscientious 高级形容词 + ideal candidate 定性收束

original_sentence: Its attraction lies more in what it awakens in us than what it says.
readingExamples: Its attraction lies more in what it awakens in us than what it says.
definitionEn:
(1) vt. to make a feeling, memory or interest start to exist in someone (awaken sth in sb)
(2) vt. & vi. to wake up, or to make someone wake up from sleep (literary)
(3) vt. to make someone become aware of something they had not noticed or realised (awaken sb to sth)

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 唤起，激发（某种情感/记忆/兴趣）——课文本义（awaken sth in sb 在某人内心唤起某物）
uncommonMeanings.example: The faded photograph awakened in her a flood of memories she had long buried. （读后续写·睹物思人）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 使意识到，使认清（awaken sb to sth）
uncommonMeanings.example: The old fisherman's quiet story awakened the boy to a truth he had spent years running from. （读后续写·顿悟·代际传承）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: (使)醒来，(使)觉醒（文学用法，awaken from sleep/a dream）
uncommonMeanings.example: She awakened at dawn to the soft drumming of rain on the roof. （读后续写·清晨·环境）

posExamples.sentence: The faded photograph awakened in her a flood of memories — the smell of her grandmother's kitchen, the warmth of a hand long gone, the laughter of summers that would never come again. （读后续写·睹物思人）
We sincerely hope this exhibition will awaken in every visitor a deeper appreciation of the fragile beauty of our natural world. （应用文·倡议书/展览通知）
Great literature does more than entertain; it awakens in readers a compassion for lives utterly unlike their own. （议论文·文学的价值）
She awakened at dawn to the soft drumming of rain on the roof, and for one drowsy moment forgot where she was. （读后续写·清晨·环境）

wordForms.verb: awaken / awake / waken / wake（均可作“唤醒/醒来”）
wordForms.adjective: awake（醒着的，作表语）/ awakened（被唤起的）
wordForms.other: 构词法与特例：a-(加强)+waken(醒)→awaken。近义动词一组要理清：wake(up)最口语、awake 多作形容词(be awake 醒着)也可作动词(过去式 awoke)、awaken 最文学正式(规则变化 awakened)、waken 较少用。贴士：awake 作形容词只能作表语(She is awake，不说 an awake child)；表“唤起情感”这一抽象义，首选 awaken sth in sb。

idioms.example: Only when the flames reached the doorway did the sleeping village awaken to the danger. （读后续写·危机）

collocations.translation: 【课件】（使）醒来；（被）唤醒（三态同形；对比 wake~woke~woken）
collocations.example: She was awakened in the night by the sound of rain beating against her windows. 她在夜里被雨点敲打窗户的声音惊醒。（课件例句）
She was awakened by the sound of birds singing outside her window. 她被窗外的鸟鸣声唤醒。（课件例句）

collocations.translation: 【课件】醒来听到 / 意识到……；对……觉醒
collocations.example: She awakened to the sound of birds singing. 她醒来时听到鸟儿在歌唱。（课件例句）

collocations.phrase: awaken sth in sb（lies more in what it awakens in us）
collocations.translation: 【课件】在某人内心唤起某物（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: Its attraction lies more in what it awakens in us than what it says. 文学的魅力更多在于它唤起了我们什么，而不在于它说了什么。（课文原句）
The documentary awakened millions to the urgent reality of climate change. （议论文·环保）
A single inspiring lesson can awaken a lifelong curiosity in a young mind. （应用文·教育感悟）
The familiar tune awakened memories she had carefully buried for years. （读后续写·音乐·回忆）
He awakened from a restless dream, his heart still pounding against his ribs. （读后续写·梦醒）
It is the writer's duty to awaken the conscience of society. （议论文·文人责任）
The nation gradually awakened to the value of its own forgotten traditions. （议论文·文化自觉）

collocations.translation: 唤起某人内心的某种情感（课文原句词块；awaken 后接被唤起之物 + in sb）
collocations.example: Its attraction lies more in what it awakens in us than what it says. 它的魅力更多在于它在我们心中唤起了什么，而非它说了什么。（课文原句）

synonyms.example: The mysterious letter aroused her curiosity at once. （读后续写·悬念）
synonyms.usage: 多与 interest/curiosity/suspicion/anger 等抽象情感搭配，语气较强，指‘瞬间激起’；awaken 更文学，含‘从沉睡中被唤起’的意味

synonyms.translation: 唤起，使人想起（记忆、画面、情感）
synonyms.example: The scent of pine evoked memories of childhood winters. （读后续写·嗅觉·回忆）
synonyms.usage: 侧重‘唤起记忆、联想、画面感’，常搭 memories/image/feeling，书面且文艺；awaken 可含‘使觉醒、意识到’之意，evoke 无此义

synonyms.example: His speech stirred the hearts of everyone in the hall. （应用文·演讲）
synonyms.usage: 口语与书面皆可，强调‘触动、搅动内心’，常搭 heart/emotion；awaken 更强调‘从无到有地唤起或使意识到’

advancedExpressions.expression: awaken~awakened~awakened（三态同形，文学书面）；wake~woke~woken（口语常用，wake up）
advancedExpressions.example: I was already awake when the alarm tried to wake me, but it was the news that truly awakened me to the danger. （课件辨析：wake up 叫醒 / awaken to 觉醒）

advancedExpressions.expression: awaken sth in sb (唤起) / awaken sb to sth (使意识到) / awaken interest / awaken memories / awaken the conscience
advancedExpressions.example: The film awakened in us a compassion that awakened the whole nation to its long-ignored duty. （一句连用 awaken sth in sb 与 awaken sb to sth）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·表示“唤起/激起（情感）”(可替换)
advancedExpressions.expression: awaken = arouse = evoke = stir = kindle (视语境可替换)
advancedExpressions.example: The old song awakened / evoked / stirred a longing she had no words for. （功能相同，可互换，见 synonyms 辨析侧重）

advancedExpressions.type: 构词法·awake / awaken / wake 辨析
advancedExpressions.expression: wake(up) 口语，awake 常作形容词(be awake)，awaken 文学正式且规则变化
advancedExpressions.example: I was already awake when the alarm tried to wake me, but it was the news that truly awakened me to the danger. （一句区分三词）

advancedExpressions.expression: something ... awakened in sb a ... long thought lost
advancedExpressions.example: Something in the child's fearless laughter awakened in him a joy he had long thought lost. （抽象名词作宾语+定语后置，续写情感升华）

advancedExpressions.expression: may this ... awaken in us all a renewed sense of ...
advancedExpressions.example: May this campaign awaken in us all a renewed sense of responsibility towards our shared planet. （may 引导祈愿句，倡议书结尾呼吁）

advancedExpressions.expression: true education does not merely inform; it awakens
advancedExpressions.example: True education does not merely inform the mind; it awakens the soul to wonder, doubt and endless questioning. （否定递进+三名词并列，凸显教育本质）

sentenceUpgrade.original: The old song made her remember many things.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The first few notes of that old song awakened in her a rush of memories so vivid she could almost feel the summer breeze of that distant afternoon. （读后续写·感官·回忆）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: awaken in sb 替换 make sb remember + a rush of 量化情感 + so...that 结果状语 + 通感(feel the breeze)增强画面

sentenceUpgrade.original: The film made people care about the environment.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: By laying bare the quiet devastation of our forests, the documentary awakened in millions a conscience that decades of dry statistics had failed to stir. （议论文·环保）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: awaken a conscience 抽象升华 + By doing 方式状语前置 + that 定语从句对比(had failed to stir) + 用 stir 呼应避免重复

translation: 使（船）下水；开始从事，发动
original_sentence: When Christopher Marlowe's Doctor Faustus asks in the presence of Helen, "Was this the face that launched a thousand ships?" he opens a door through which our imagination enters a new world, a world of love, beauty and heroism.
readingExamples: When Christopher Marlowe's Doctor Faustus asks in the presence of Helen, "Was this the face that launched a thousand ships?" he opens a door through which our imagination enters a new world, a world of love, beauty and heroism.
definitionEn:
(1) vt. to start something, especially an organised activity, campaign or attack
(2) vt. to put a boat or ship into the water, especially one that has just been built
(3) vt. to send a spacecraft, missile or weapon into the air or space
(4) vt. to make a new product available or introduce it to the public for the first time
(5) n. an act of launching something (a product, ship, spacecraft or campaign)

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 发起，开始（有组织的活动、运动、进攻）——课文语境(launched a thousand ships 引申义)
uncommonMeanings.example: To raise awareness of food waste, our student union launched a week-long 'Clean Plate' campaign. （应用文·倡议书）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 使（船）下水；发射（火箭、卫星、导弹）——课文本义(launched a thousand ships 使千舰起航/出海)
uncommonMeanings.example: Millions held their breath as the rocket was launched into the star-strewn sky. （读后续写·航天·壮观场面）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 推出，发布（新产品、新书、应用）
uncommonMeanings.example: The company chose our city to launch its latest electric car. （应用文·新闻报道）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 发射；发布；下水；（活动的）启动（the launch of sth）
uncommonMeanings.example: The launch of the new library app was met with such enthusiasm that the servers crashed within the first hour. （应用文·活动报道）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 突然开始（做/说某事）；一头扎进（launch into）
uncommonMeanings.example: Before I could even sit down, Grandpa launched into the same old story about the storm of '58, his eyes lighting up as if it had happened yesterday. （读后续写·长辈·滔滔不绝）

posExamples.sentence: With nothing but a borrowed camera and a stubborn dream, the two teenagers launched a small film club that would one day fill the whole town's cinema. （读后续写·追梦·白手起家）
To raise awareness of food waste, our student union has decided to launch a week-long 'Clean Plate' campaign starting next Monday. （应用文·倡议书/通知）
Every great reform in history has had to be launched against the fierce resistance of those who profit from the way things already are. （议论文·改革与阻力）
The launch of the new library app was met with such enthusiasm that the servers crashed within the first hour. （应用文·活动报道）

wordForms.noun: launch（发射；发布；下水）/ launcher（发射器）
wordForms.other: 构词法与特例：launch 一词兼作动词与名词，形态不变（zero-derivation 零派生）——v. launch a rocket / n. the launch of a rocket。派生：re-(重新)+launch→relaunch(重新发起/发布)；launch+-er→launcher(发射器)。贴士：launch into sth(突然开始) 与 launch out(放胆开创) 为高频短语动词。relaunch（重新发起/发布）

idioms.translation: 突然开始（做某事、讲某事）
idioms.example: Without a word of greeting, she launched into a passionate defence of her plan. （读后续写·激动·争辩）

idioms.translation: 着手开创（新事业）;放胆去做
idioms.example: At forty, he finally found the courage to launch out on his own and open the bakery he had always dreamed of. （读后续写·中年追梦）

collocations.phrase: launch a (new) ship / a communication satellite / a rocket
collocations.translation: 【课件】使（船）下水；发射（卫星、火箭等）
collocations.example: They launched a new communication satellite into orbit last week. 他们上周把一颗新的通信卫星送入了轨道。（课件义项一·发射）

collocations.phrase: launch a campaign / an appeal / an investigation
collocations.translation: 【课件】发起一场运动 / 发出呼吁 / 展开调查
collocations.example: The police launched an investigation into the cause of the accident. 警方就事故起因展开了调查。（课件义项二·发起）

collocations.phrase: launch a new model / a new novel
collocations.translation: 【课件】（首次）推出、上市（新款、新书）
collocations.example: The company will launch its new model at the auto show next month. 这家公司将在下月的车展上推出新款车型。（课件义项三·上市）

collocations.translation: 【课件】……的发射 / 发布 / 启动（launch 作名词）
collocations.example: The launch of his new novel is arranged on Tuesday. 他新小说的发布定在星期二。（课件例句·名词）

collocations.translation: 使千舰起航/出海（课文原句词块；launch 本义“使船下水/出航”，此处出自马洛名句，形容海伦倾国之貌）
collocations.example: Was this the face that launched a thousand ships? 就是这张脸让千帆竞发（引发特洛伊之战）吗？（课文原句）

collocations.translation: 发起一场运动 / 呼吁
collocations.example: The school launched a campaign to encourage students to walk or cycle to school. （应用文·倡议书）
Under cover of darkness, the small band launched a daring attack on the enemy camp. （读后续写·战争·奇袭）

collocations.translation: 推出产品 / 新书 / 应用
collocations.example: The company chose our city to launch its latest electric car. （应用文·新闻报道）
We are proud to launch a project that pairs senior citizens with student volunteers. （应用文·倡议书）

collocations.translation: 发射火箭 / 卫星 / 航天器
collocations.example: Millions held their breath as the rocket was launched into the star-strewn sky. （读后续写·航天·壮观场面）
The whole village gathered on the shore to watch the new fishing boat launched. （读后续写·渔村·集体时刻）
That single audition launched a career that would span four decades. （读后续写·励志·转折）

collocations.translation: ……的启动 / 发布（launch 作名词）
collocations.example: The launch of the reading festival drew crowds from every corner of the campus. （应用文·活动报道）

synonyms.example: The government initiated a series of reforms to protect the environment. （议论文·政策）
synonyms.usage: 辨析：initiate 非常正式，侧重“率先启动一个过程/程序”，多用于政策、改革、调查；launch 更有“声势浩大地推出、发射、下水”的动态感，可搭 campaign/product/rocket/ship。

synonyms.translation: 着手，开始（新的重大事业/旅程）
synonyms.example: At eighteen, she embarked on a journey that would change her life forever. （读后续写·人生新篇）
synonyms.usage: 辨析：embark on 为短语动词，强调“开始一段较长、重要的历程或事业”，含开启新阶段之意；launch 更强调“正式对外推出或猛然发动”，宾语多为具体活动/产品。

synonyms.example: One brave decision set in motion a chain of events no one could have predicted. （读后续写·蝴蝶效应）
synonyms.usage: 辨析：set in motion 强调“使某个过程开始运转、连锁展开”，偏比喻；launch 多指主动、有计划地发起某项具体活动或产品。

advancedExpressions.expression: launch a campaign/attack/product/rocket/ship/career (v.) / the launch of sth (n.) / launch into sth (突然开始)
advancedExpressions.example: The launch of the rocket was flawless, but back home the company was about to launch a bold new campaign. （一句演示 the launch of 名词 + launch 动词）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·表示“发起/开启”(可替换)
advancedExpressions.expression: launch = initiate = start up = embark on = set ... in motion = get ... off the ground
advancedExpressions.example: They launched / initiated / embarked on a project to green the campus. （功能相同，可互换，见 synonyms 辨析侧重）

advancedExpressions.type: 构词法·launch 零派生与派生词
advancedExpressions.expression: launch(v.=n. 同形) → relaunch(重新推出), launcher(发射器)
advancedExpressions.example: After a poor start, the company decided on a relaunch, and this time the launch was a triumph. （同形词 + relaunch 对照）

advancedExpressions.expression: with nothing but ..., sb. launched ...
advancedExpressions.example: With nothing but a battered notebook and an unshakeable belief, he launched the very venture the whole town had laughed at. （介词短语前置突出反差，续写励志开端）

advancedExpressions.expression: in an effort to ..., we are launching ...
advancedExpressions.example: In an effort to build a greener campus, we are launching a tree-planting programme this spring and warmly invite you to join. （倡议书主体，目的状语开头）

advancedExpressions.expression: no meaningful change is ever launched without ...
advancedExpressions.example: No meaningful change is ever launched without courage, for the first to move always faces the loudest doubt. （否定强调+for 引导原因，凸显改革之难）

sentenceUpgrade.original: They started a small club with little money.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: With little more than pocket money and boundless enthusiasm, the two friends launched a small club that no one believed would last a single term. （读后续写·白手起家）

original_sentence: The third quality of literature, coming out of the other two, is its permanence.
readingExamples: The third quality of literature, coming out of the other two, is its permanence.
definitionEn:
(1) n. the state or quality of lasting or remaining unchanged for a very long time or forever
(2) n. the condition of being permanent, stable and continuing without interruption
(3) n. (of art, literature, etc.) the quality of enduring beyond one's own age; timelessness

posExamples.sentence: In a world where everything seemed to slip through her fingers, the old stone bridge gave her a rare sense of permanence — something that had stood, and would go on standing, long after she was gone. （读后续写·寻找归属·永恒之物）
I am writing to propose that our class plant a tree in the school garden, so that our friendship may be given a symbol of permanence long after we graduate. （应用文·建议信）
The true permanence of a great work of literature lies not in the paper it is printed on, but in the ideas it plants in the minds of every generation that reads it. （议论文·文学的不朽）
Nothing lends a friendship greater permanence than the quiet loyalty that asks for nothing in return. （议论文·友谊·哲理）

wordForms.adjective: permanent（永久的，反义 impermanent / temporary 暂时的）
wordForms.other: 构词法：per-（自始至终）+ man(ere)（停留，同 remain）+ -ence（名词后缀）→ 一直留存 → 永久；对照记忆 permanent adj. / permanently adv. / temporary（临时的，反义）

collocations.translation: 文学的持久性 / 永恒（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: The third quality of literature, coming out of the other two, is its permanence. （必修二 U4 课文原句）
The ancient oak in the courtyard gave the whole village a comforting sense of permanence. （读后续写·环境·安定感）
Writing down our memories lends a kind of permanence to moments that would otherwise fade. （议论文·记录的意义）

collocations.translation: 某物的持久性 / 永恒
collocations.example: She marvelled at the permanence of the mountains against the fleeting seasons. （读后续写·自然·感慨）
Only a handful of works ever achieve the permanence of true classics. （议论文·经典）

original_sentence: To achieve this, it should contain two elements: universal interest and personal style.
readingExamples: To achieve this, it should contain two elements: universal interest and personal style.
definitionEn:
(1) vt. to have something inside or as part of it; to include as a component
(2) vt. to hold or be able to hold a particular amount of something
(3) vt. to control or restrain a feeling, emotion or reaction; to keep it within limits
(4) vt. to prevent something harmful, such as a fire, disease or conflict, from spreading

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【课件】包含，含有，容纳（有某物在内或作为一部分；不用被动、无进行时）
uncommonMeanings.example: This book contains all the information you need. 这本书包含你需要的全部信息。（课件义项一）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【课件】抑制，控制（火势、疫情等有害事物），阻止其蔓延或恶化
uncommonMeanings.example: Firefighters are trying their best to contain the forest fire. 消防员正竭尽全力控制这场森林大火。（课件义项三）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 控制、抑制（情绪、局势、疫情、火势等），使不扩散
uncommonMeanings.example: She could scarcely contain her excitement as the envelope trembled in her hands, and when at last she read the word 'Accepted', all restraint dissolved into tears of joy. （读后续写·喜极而泣·情绪失控）

posExamples.sentence: The dusty wooden box, hidden beneath the floorboards for half a century, contained a bundle of letters that would unravel every secret her family had buried. （读后续写·悬念·发现）

synonyms.example: The hall can hold up to a thousand people. （应用文·场地介绍）
synonyms.usage: 指‘容纳、装得下（某容量）’时与 contain 近，但 hold 更口语、更强调容量上限，常与 up to 连用；contain 还可表‘控制情绪/局势’，hold 无此常见义

synonyms.usage: 对应 contain‘抑制情绪’这层义，restrain 更强调‘主动地拉住、制止(自己或他人)’，可接宾语或 restrain sb from doing；contain oneself 侧重‘竭力保持镇定、不外露’

original_sentence: To achieve this, it should contain two elements: universal interest and personal style.
readingExamples: To achieve this, it should contain two elements: universal interest and personal style.
definitionEn:
(1) n. one part or feature of a whole system, plan, or piece of work, especially one that is essential or typical
(2) n. a simple chemical substance such as carbon or oxygen that consists of atoms of only one type and cannot be broken down into anything simpler
(3) n. a small amount of a particular quality, feeling, or emotion
(4) n. (the elements) the weather, especially bad or severe weather such as wind and rain

uncommonMeanings.meaning: (某人)如鱼得水的环境;适宜的领域 (in one's element)

definitionEn:

(2) n. a brief account that presents the essential information about a longer text, event, or discussion
(3) adj. (formal) done immediately, without paying attention to the usual process or formalities

idioms.example: In summary, courage is not the absence of fear but the mastery of it — a lesson the young soldier learned at a terrible cost. （议论文·结论）

advancedExpressions.expression: the defining feature of ... lies in ...

original_sentence: One important feature of classic literature is that it often reflects an author's own experiences and can therefore help us understand the important issues of his or her time.
readingExamples: One important feature of classic literature is that it often reflects an author's own experiences and can therefore help us understand the important issues of his or her time.
definitionEn:
(1) adv. for that reason; as a result of something that has just been mentioned
(2) adv. (used to introduce a logical conclusion) it follows from this that
(3) adv. (in formal or written argument) consequently; and so

posExamples.sentence: The little match girl had sold nothing all day; her father would surely beat her if she went home, and she therefore huddled in a freezing corner, striking her matches one by one against the dark. （读后续写·苦难叙事）
The library closes an hour earlier during the exam period; students are therefore advised to reserve a seat online in advance to avoid any disappointment. （应用文·通知）
Reading widely broadens one's horizons and sharpens one's judgement; it is therefore, in my firm opinion, the single most rewarding habit a student can ever cultivate. （议论文·阅读的价值）
She had rehearsed the speech a hundred times and knew every line by heart; when the spotlight finally found her, she therefore felt not a flicker of fear, only a quiet, steady confidence. （读后续写·人物心理）

collocations.phrase: and can therefore help us understand ...
collocations.translation: 从而能帮助我们理解……（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: One important feature of classic literature is that it often reflects an author's own experiences and can therefore help us understand the important issues of his or her time. （课文原句）
The plan cuts costs and therefore frees up funds for the new reading room. （应用文·倡议书）

collocations.phrase: therefore, it is important / essential that ...
collocations.example: Therefore, it is essential that every volunteer arrive on time so that the charity sale can begin as scheduled. （应用文·活动方案）
We must therefore act now, for every day of delay only allows the problem to take deeper root. （议论文·呼吁行动）
Classic literature mirrors an author's own age and can therefore help us grasp the hopes and fears of a distant generation. （议论文·文学价值）
A single kind word costs nothing and would therefore seem a small thing, yet to a lonely newcomer it can mean the whole world. （读后续写·主题升华）
From these three lines of evidence we may therefore conclude that persistence, not talent, is the truer key to success. （议论文·结论段）

collocations.phrase: it is therefore no surprise / no wonder that ...
collocations.example: She had poured her heart into every rehearsal; it was therefore no wonder that the audience rose to their feet the moment the final note faded. （读后续写·结局）
These young athletes have trained through wind and rain and therefore deserve our warmest applause. （应用文·颁奖致辞）

synonyms.example: He kept a diary throughout the war and thus left behind an invaluable first-hand record of those turbulent years. （议论文·历史记录）
synonyms.usage: 较 therefore 更正式、更书面，常引出结果或方式；语义偏'如此/这样'，可直接接分词(thus leaving)，多见于学术与议论文写作

synonyms.example: The bridge had collapsed in the flood; hence the villagers had no choice but to cross the swollen river on foot. （读后续写·困境）
synonyms.usage: 非常正式；语义侧重'由此(推出/产生)'，句法上可直接接名词短语(hence the delay)而不加动词，这是与 therefore 最大的区别，口语中少用

synonyms.example: He had ignored every warning sign; consequently, the small crack in the dam widened into a disaster no one could stop. （议论文·因果论证）
synonyms.usage: 强调前因后果的必然联系，语气比 therefore 更重于'结果'；常置于句首加逗号，适合议论文推理链

synonyms.example: The whole team stayed up polishing the design; as a result, their project won first prize at the science fair. （读后续写·团队成功）
synonyms.usage: 口语与书面皆宜，位置灵活，比 therefore 更口语化；是短语而非副词，句首常加逗号，续写与应用文都常用

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·表'因果结论'(可替换)
advancedExpressions.expression: therefore = thus = hence = consequently = as a result = accordingly
advancedExpressions.example: The witnesses' accounts all agreed; we may therefore / thus / hence / consequently / as a result conclude that the boy was telling the truth. （六者都引出因果结论,正式度 hence/thus>consequently>therefore>as a result,写作按语体选用）

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·therefore 的位置与标点
advancedExpressions.expression: therefore 是副词，不能像连词那样连接两个句子；分句间须用分号或句号
advancedExpressions.example: 误 It rained, therefore we stayed in. → 正 It rained; therefore, we stayed in. / It rained. Therefore, we stayed in. （therefore 前须句号或分号,不可只用逗号,高考语法填空/改错高频考点）

advancedExpressions.expression: sb. had learned that ...; and therefore, sb. did ...
advancedExpressions.example: She had learned that courage is not the absence of fear but the will to act in spite of it; and therefore, trembling yet unbowed, she stepped forward. （对比定义+therefore引出行动，续写升华段）

advancedExpressions.expression: given that ..., it is therefore advisable that ...
advancedExpressions.example: Given that reading enriches both mind and heart, it is therefore highly advisable that we set aside half an hour of quiet reading each day. （given引导前提+therefore引出建议，倡议信结尾）

advancedExpressions.expression: if ..., then it follows that ...; sth. is therefore ...
advancedExpressions.example: If character is forged through hardship rather than comfort, then it follows that adversity is a teacher; it is therefore not to be feared but embraced. （条件推理链+therefore收束观点）

translation: 重要议题，争论的问题，问题，担忧；（报刊）一期 vt. 宣布，公布
original_sentence: One important feature of classic literature is that it often reflects an author's own experiences and can therefore help us understand the important issues of his or her time.
readingExamples: One important feature of classic literature is that it often reflects an author's own experiences and can therefore help us understand the important issues of his or her time.
definitionEn:
(1) n. an important topic or problem for debate or discussion
(2) n. a matter of concern or difficulty; something causing worry
(3) n. a single copy of a newspaper or magazine published at a particular time

posExamples.sentence: As the two friends sat by the flickering campfire, their laughter faded, and at last the issue neither had dared to raise all evening rose quietly between them. （读后续写·友情裂痕）

collocations.phrase: the important issues of his or her time
collocations.translation: 他/她那个时代的重要问题（课文原句词块）

collocations.translation: 重要的 / 迫切的问题
collocations.example: How to protect the environment has become a burning issue for every country. （议论文·环境话题）

advancedExpressions.expression: the issue that had long lain unspoken between them at last surfaced

original_sentence: The novel contains a great number of details such as what the upper class wore and ate.
readingExamples: The novel contains a great number of details such as what the upper class wore and ate.
definitionEn:
(1) n. a long written story about imaginary people and events, published as a book
(2) adj. new, original and interesting in a way that is unusual and often appealing
(3) n. (as a genre) fiction of book length, as distinct from short stories or poetry

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 新颖的，与众不同的（熟词僻义，高考爱考）
uncommonMeanings.example: Instead of scolding the daydreaming boy, the wise teacher tried a novel approach: she asked him to turn his wandering thoughts into a story for the whole class. （读后续写·因材施教·巧思）

posExamples.sentence: Late into the night, the lonely widow turned page after page of the worn novel, and for a few precious hours the fictional world felt warmer and kinder than her own. （读后续写·孤独与慰藉）
I would like to recommend this novel to every member of our reading club, for its vivid characters and gripping plot kept me awake until dawn. （应用文·推荐信）
The winning team impressed the judges with a novel solution that no one else had even thought to consider. （议论文·创新与竞赛）
A great novel does more than tell a story; it holds up a mirror to society, letting each reader see both the world and themselves anew. （议论文·文学价值）

wordForms.other: novella (中篇小说)

collocations.phrase: The novel contains a great number of details
collocations.translation: 这部小说包含大量细节（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: The novel contains a great number of details such as what the upper class wore and ate. （课文原句）

collocations.translation: 新颖的想法 / 方法（熟词僻义 adj.）
collocations.example: The science fair rewarded students who dared to try a novel idea rather than repeat a safe experiment. （议论文·鼓励创新）
Curled up by the fire, she lost herself in a classic novel her grandmother had once loved. （读后续写·温情回忆）
After ten years of quiet struggle, the young teacher finally published the novel she had begun in college. （读后续写·梦想成真）

collocations.translation: 历史 / 言情 / 侦探小说
collocations.example: This gripping detective novel keeps its readers guessing right up to the very last page. （应用文·书评）
Her debut work soon became a best-selling novel, translated into more than twenty languages. （应用文·人物报道）

collocations.phrase: the novel is set in / tells the story of ...
collocations.translation: 小说以……为背景 / 讲述……的故事
collocations.example: The novel is set in a small fishing village and tells the story of a boy who dreams of the wider world. （应用文·内容简介）
Drawing on his own experiences, the author based the novel on the turbulent years of his childhood. （应用文·作家访谈）

collocations.phrase: adapt a novel into a film
collocations.example: When the beloved novel was adapted into a film, fans queued outside the cinema for hours. （读后续写·热潮）

synonyms.example: She far preferred fiction to biography, delighting in worlds that never were. （应用文·阅读偏好）
synonyms.usage: 不可数总称，泛指一切虚构文学；novel 特指'长篇小说'这一具体作品，可数，前可加 a/the

synonyms.example: Grandpa told us a story so vivid that we could almost hear the waves crashing on the shore. （读后续写·祖孙温情）
synonyms.usage: 最普通，长短不限，可口头可书面；novel 专指成书出版的长篇作品

synonyms.translation: 新颖的，原创的（辨析 novel adj.）
synonyms.example: Her original take on an old fairy tale won the storytelling contest. （议论文·创意）
synonyms.usage: 作形容词时 novel 近 original/innovative，强调'前所未见、令人耳目一新'，比 new 更书面且含褒义；new 只中性表'新的',无'新颖'的赞赏色彩

advancedExpressions.expression: a novel idea / approach / solution / way of doing sth.
advancedExpressions.example: What impressed the judges was not a bigger budget but a genuinely novel idea nobody had dared to try. （高考熟词僻义:novel 作形容词'新颖的'≈original/innovative,阅读与语填爱考）

advancedExpressions.expression: novel (n./adj.) → novelist (小说家) → novelty (n. 新奇；新奇事物) → novella (中篇小说)
advancedExpressions.example: The young novelist's debut owed its success less to novelty for its own sake than to its warm, human heart. （novel 派生 novelist/novelty,记'小说家/新奇'一族,构词法高频）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·表'新颖的'(可替换)
advancedExpressions.expression: novel = original = innovative = fresh = groundbreaking
advancedExpressions.example: Their design was praised as novel / original / innovative / fresh — a truly groundbreaking step forward. （五者都表'新颖有创意'可替换,程度 groundbreaking>innovative>novel/original>fresh）

advancedExpressions.expression: sb. lost themselves in the pages of a novel, until ...
advancedExpressions.example: She lost herself in the pages of the novel, until the ticking clock, the cold tea and the whole grey world outside quietly dissolved away. （lost oneself in沉浸 + 三项并列消隐,营造入迷氛围）

advancedExpressions.expression: I cannot recommend this novel highly enough, for ...
advancedExpressions.example: I cannot recommend this novel highly enough, for it not only entertains but also quietly reshapes the way one sees the world. （cannot...highly enough双重否定强调+not only...but also递进,推荐信高分句式）

advancedExpressions.expression: what sets sth. apart is its novel ...
advancedExpressions.example: What sets this proposal apart is its novel approach — instead of punishing failure, it celebrates the courage to experiment. （what引导主语从句+破折号解释,论证创新价值）

sentenceUpgrade.original: She read a novel and forgot her troubles.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: As she sank deeper into the tattered novel, the weight of the day's troubles slowly lifted, until she was no longer a tired girl in a cold room but an adventurer sailing across seas she had never seen. （读后续写·逃离现实）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: As引导伴随时间从句 + 抽象名词具象化(the weight lifted) + no longer...but对比转换 + 想象画面延伸

sentenceUpgrade.original: This is a new and good idea.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: This is a strikingly novel idea — one that breaks free from convention and dares us to imagine what has never been imagined before. （议论文·褒扬创新）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: strikingly副词强化 + novel替换new升格 + 破折号补充说明 + dares us to三重递进 imagine what...never...before

classPractice.question: The team won first prize with a ____ (novel / novelist) approach that no one had ever thought of.
classPractice.note: 空处修饰 approach 作形容词'新颖的',用 novel;novelist 是名词'小说家'

classPractice.question: The famous ____ (novel) spent years quietly gathering the stories that would fill her greatest book.
classPractice.note: 定冠词 The + 形容词 famous 后需名词作主语,且指'人',用 novelist

classPractice.question: 把下面句子译成英语：这个新颖的想法给了评委耳目一新的感觉。
classPractice.answer: This novel idea gave the judges a fresh / new feeling. / The novel idea impressed the judges as fresh and original.
classPractice.note: 考 novel 作形容词'新颖的'的熟词僻义,搭配 a novel idea

original_sentence: No doubt drawing on his own experiences, Cao Xueqin gives a detailed description of what life was like at that time.
readingExamples: No doubt drawing on his own experiences, Cao Xueqin gives a detailed description of what life was like at that time.
definitionEn:
(1) phr. v. to use a supply of something (knowledge, experience, resources) that is available to you
(2) phr. v. (of time or a season) to pass and come gradually to an end; to approach
(3) phr. v. to take something (breath, a cigarette) in by inhaling

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （时间、季节）渐渐流逝，接近尾声
uncommonMeanings.example: As the long winter evening drew on, the old fisherman fell silent, his gaze fixed on the last thread of light dying over the harbour. （读后续写·时间流逝·暮年心境）

posExamples.sentence: When words failed her on that trembling stage, she drew on every ounce of courage her grandmother had ever taught her, lifted her chin, and began to sing. （读后续写·危机时刻·内在力量）
In writing this report, our team drew on the survey results of over three hundred students to ensure that our conclusions were both fair and reliable. （应用文·调查报告）
A truly persuasive writer knows how to draw on personal experience, for a story lived through the heart speaks louder than any borrowed statistic. （议论文·写作与真实）
Faced with the sudden power cut, the young nurse drew on her years of training and calmly guided every patient to safety in the dark. （读后续写·临危不乱）

collocations.phrase: No doubt drawing on his own experiences, ...
collocations.translation: 无疑，凭借着自己的亲身经历，……（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: No doubt drawing on his own experiences, Cao Xueqin gives a detailed description of what life was like at that time. （课文原句）
No doubt drawing on his own experience, the veteran teacher knew exactly how to comfort a frightened first-year. （读后续写·经验之谈）
In the debate, she drew on her wide knowledge of history to support every point she made. （议论文·论据充分）
The charity drew on the resources of the whole community to rebuild the flooded school. （应用文·公益报道）
Drawing on a reserve of strength she never knew she had, the mother lifted the fallen beam off her child. （读后续写·母爱奇迹）
He had to draw on his savings to keep the little bookshop from closing. （读后续写·坚守梦想）

collocations.phrase: have a rich source to draw on
collocations.example: Growing up beside the sea, the poet had a rich source of imagery to draw on. （议论文·创作源泉）

collocations.phrase: as the day / night / year draws on
collocations.translation: 随着一天 / 夜晚 / 一年渐近尾声
collocations.example: As the night drew on, the campfire dimmed and the children's laughter softened into sleepy whispers. （读后续写·夜幕降临）

synonyms.example: The students made good use of the recycled materials to build their model bridge. （应用文·活动报道）
synonyms.usage: 最通用，指利用任何具体或抽象事物；draw on 更强调'从已有的储备(经验、知识、资金)中调取'，语体更书面

synonyms.example: In the wilderness, they could rely on nothing but their wits and each other. （读后续写·荒野求生）
synonyms.usage: 强调'依赖、指望'某事物作为支撑；draw on 强调'主动汲取利用'储备，不含'离不开'的依赖意味

synonyms.example: The workshop helped her tap into a creativity she never knew she possessed. （应用文·活动感悟）

synonyms.example: In her darkest hour she called upon every lesson her mother had taught her. （读后续写·内心力量）
synonyms.usage: 较正式，含'唤起、求助'之意，可指调动内在品质或请求他人帮助；draw on 侧重'汲取利用'资源

advancedExpressions.expression: draw on 利用/(时间)流逝 · draw up 起草/拟定 · draw near 临近 · draw a conclusion 得出结论 · draw attention to 引起对…的注意
advancedExpressions.example: As the deadline drew near, she drew on years of practice, drew up a clear plan, and finally drew the conclusion that early planning draws everyone's attention for a reason. （一句串起 draw near/on/up/a conclusion/attention,记 draw 短语家族）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·表'利用/借助'(可替换)
advancedExpressions.expression: draw on = make use of = draw upon = tap into = rely on（据侧重选用）
advancedExpressions.example: In writing the report, we drew on / made use of / tapped into the survey results of three hundred students. （三者都表'利用现有资源'可替换;draw on=make use of=draw upon 最贴近'调取储备'）

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·drawing on 现在分词作状语

advancedExpressions.example: Drawing on his own experiences, Cao Xueqin described that vanished world in vivid detail. （现在分词短语作状语,其逻辑主语 = 主句主语 Cao Xueqin,续写/读写常用,不可写成 Drawing on... 后主语突然换人）

advancedExpressions.expression: drawing on a strength sb. never knew they possessed, ...

advancedExpressions.expression: in preparing this ..., we have drawn on ...

advancedExpressions.expression: great works draw on lived experience rather than empty imagination
advancedExpressions.example: The greatest literature draws on lived experience rather than empty imagination, for only what is deeply felt can be deeply moving. （对比 lived experience/empty imagination,论证真情实感的价值）

sentenceUpgrade.original: She used her past experience and stayed calm.

sentenceUpgrade.techniques: Drawing on现在分词状语前置 + hard-won lessons形容词升格 + 动作细节(a slow, steadying breath) + a calm that...定语从句反衬内心

sentenceUpgrade.original: As it got late, the party ended.
