classPractice.note: draw on/upon sth.'调动、汲取(经验、训练)',两个介词皆可

classPractice.question: As the winter evening ____ (drew on / drew up), the room grew colder and the old man fell silent.
classPractice.note: 主语是时间 evening,draw on 表'(时间)渐渐流逝';draw up 意为'起草/停车',不合语境

original_sentence: The novel contains a great number of details such as what the upper class wore and ate.
readingExamples: The novel contains a great number of details such as what the upper class wore and ate.
definitionEn:
(1) adj. in a higher position; situated above another part
(2) adj. higher in rank, status or importance
(3) adj. (of a place) situated on higher ground or further from the sea

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （鞋的）鞋面（熟词僻义）
uncommonMeanings.example: The old cobbler ran his thumb along the cracked leather upper, and in that worn, faithful shoe he read the whole hard journey of the man who had worn it. （读后续写·匠人·物件叙事）

posExamples.sentence: From the upper window of the crumbling tower, the little girl watched the carriages of the rich roll past, dreaming of a world she had only read about in books. （读后续写·贫富对照）
Students in the upper years are warmly invited to serve as mentors, guiding the newcomers through their first uncertain weeks on campus. （应用文·倡议书）

wordForms.other: uppermost (adj. 最高的，最重要的)

idioms.example: For most of the match the visitors held the upper hand, yet a single moment of brilliance turned the whole game around. （读后续写·比赛逆转）

idioms.translation: 咬牙坚持，不动声色地忍受
idioms.example: Though her heart was breaking, she kept a stiff upper lip, smiled at the waving crowd, and boarded the train alone. （读后续写·离别·隐忍）

collocations.phrase: what the upper class wore and ate

collocations.phrase: gain / have the upper hand (over sb.)

advancedExpressions.expression: just as ... seemed to have the upper hand, ...

translation: （事情发生的）背景，环境，来龙去脉；上下文，语境
original_sentence: As a result, readers are capable of better understanding the gap between rich and poor, men and women, the learned and the uneducated in the historical context.
readingExamples: As a result, readers are capable of better understanding the gap between rich and poor, men and women, the learned and the uneducated in the historical context.
definitionEn:
(1) n. the situation, events, or background that surround something and help explain its meaning or cause
(2) n. the words, sentences, or ideas that come just before and after a particular word or statement and help make its meaning clear
(3) n. a set of conditions within which something exists or is understood

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 语法/计算机中的“上下文环境”（决定含义或行为的周边条件）
uncommonMeanings.example: Torn from its context, the professor's remark sounded shockingly harsh; yet within the full lecture it was nothing more than a gentle, fatherly warning to careless students. （读后续写·误会澄清·断章取义）

posExamples.sentence: Only when Grandpa spread the faded letters across the table did the strange silver key finally make sense — placed in the context of a wartime promise, it was no longer junk but the last trace of a love that had outlived the bombs. （读后续写·物品揭秘·真相还原）

I am writing to suggest that our reading club discuss each novel within its social and historical context, so that members can grasp not merely what the author wrote, but why such words mattered to that particular age. （应用文·建议信）
No single statistic, however alarming, should be judged in isolation; only when we examine it in the broader context of long-term trends can we draw a fair and reasoned conclusion. （议论文·理性思辨）
A word carries no fixed meaning of its own — strip away the context and even the simplest sentence dissolves into ambiguity, as any careful reader soon discovers. （议论文·语言与理解）

collocations.translation: 在历史背景中；结合历史语境（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: As a result, readers are capable of better understanding the gap between rich and poor, men and women, the learned and the uneducated in the historical context. （课文原句）
In the context of a rapidly ageing society, the value of these old craftsmen's skills suddenly seemed more precious than ever. （议论文·社会变迁）

collocations.translation: 断章取义地；脱离上下文
collocations.example: The reporter had quoted her out of context, twisting a hopeful remark into a bitter complaint. （读后续写·媒体误读）

collocations.translation: 历史 / 社会 / 文化背景
collocations.example: To appreciate the poem fully, one must place it against its historical context, when the whole nation stood on the brink of change. （应用文·读书报告）

collocations.translation: 在这种情况下；就这一点而言
collocations.example: In this context, an apology alone would never be enough to mend what had been broken between the two old friends. （读后续写·矛盾化解）
A brief introduction before the exhibition gave much-needed context to the ancient relics on display. （应用文·展览通知）
Guess the new word in context first, and only reach for the dictionary when the sentence still refuses to reveal its meaning. （应用文·学习建议）
Against the context of the fierce competition, her calm smile before the final round struck everyone as almost heroic. （读后续写·赛前氛围）
Within the broader context of climate change, one small town's decision to plant a forest took on a significance far beyond its size. （议论文·环保）

synonyms.example: Knowing the family background of the shy new boy, the teacher chose her words with unusual tenderness. （读后续写·师生理解）
synonyms.usage: 指人物、事件的'身世/前情'，较口语、通俗；context 更强调'理解某事所需的周边条件与关系'，学术味更浓

synonyms.example: The moonlit graveyard was the perfect setting for the ghost story Grandma began to tell. （读后续写·氛围渲染）
synonyms.usage: 多指文学作品中时间地点的'场景设定'，具象可感；context 抽象，指赋予意义的整体情境

synonyms.translation: 情况，情形（尤指影响结果的客观条件）

synonyms.usage: 侧重具体的、往往不利的客观处境；context 侧重'理解/解读'所依赖的框架

advancedExpressions.type: 短语群·context 固定搭配(高频)

advancedExpressions.example: Taken out of context his words seemed cruel, but placed in the context of everything he had suffered, they made perfect sense. （对照 out of context ↔ in the context of,记'脱离/结合'两面,呼应课文 historical context）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·表'背景/情境'(可替换)

advancedExpressions.expression: context (n.) → contextual (adj. 上下文的) → contextually (adv.) → out of context (习语,断章取义)

advancedExpressions.expression: I would suggest ... within its ... context, so that ...

advancedExpressions.expression: no ... can be fairly judged apart from its context
advancedExpressions.example: No action, however questionable, can be fairly judged apart from the context in which it was taken; to ignore circumstances is to mistake prejudice for justice. （否定前置+对照，强化思辨）

original_sentence: In summary, we can learn much about a specific period in history from classic literature.
readingExamples: In summary, we can learn much about a specific period in history from classic literature.
definitionEn:
(1) adj. clearly defined, exact, and detailed rather than general or vague
(2) adj. relating to one particular thing, person, or group and not others
(3) adj. (of a quality, effect, or feature) belonging uniquely to a particular thing

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （复数 specifics）具体细节，详情
uncommonMeanings.example: The plan sounded wonderful in outline, but when the manager pressed him for the specifics — dates, costs, names — the young man's confident smile began to fade. （读后续写·计划受挫·细节暴露）

posExamples.sentence: "Be specific," the old coach snapped, leaning closer until she could see the fire in his eyes. "Don't tell me you 'tried'. Tell me exactly how many times you got up after you fell." （读后续写·教练激励·对话描写）

wordForms.other: specific ↔ vague (具体 ↔ 含糊) 常构成写作对照

collocations.translation: 历史上某个特定的时期（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: In summary, we can learn much about a specific period in history from classic literature. （课文原句）
Please be specific about the time and place, so that every volunteer knows exactly where to gather on Saturday morning. （应用文·活动通知）

collocations.translation: 出于特定的原因 / 目的

In summary, we can learn much about a specific period in history from classic literature. （应用文·读书报告）

collocations.translation: 提供具体的指导 / 说明

synonyms.example: She kept a detailed diary, filling each page with sights, sounds and half-forgotten smells. （读后续写·细腻叙事）

advancedExpressions.expression: it was one specific ... that ...

original_sentence: To start with, ask your friends, parents and teachers to recommend what books you ought to read.

definitionEn:

(2) modal v. used to say that something is probable or can reasonably be expected
(3) modal v. (ought to have done) used to express regret or criticism about something not done in the past

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （ought to have done）表示对过去未做之事的懊悔或责备：本应……却没有
uncommonMeanings.example: He stared at the unopened letter for a long time. He ought to have replied months ago; now the address was blurred with rain, and perhaps, he feared, so was their friendship. （读后续写·悔恨心理·错失联系）

posExamples.sentence: "You ought to be proud of yourself," Grandma whispered, brushing a tear from the boy's cheek. "Not everyone would have run back into the smoke to save a stranger's dog." （读后续写·祖孙情·褒奖）

synonyms.usage: 【课件】ought to 与 should 意思大致相同，都表示‘义务、要求或劝告’，只是 ought to 比 should 的语气稍重一些。最常用、语气较随意，几乎可与 ought to 互换；句法上二者后都接动词原形，只是 ought 后须带 to

synonyms.example: Every citizen must obey the law, whatever his rank or wealth. （议论文·法治）
synonyms.usage: 表强制义务或强烈推测，语气最重、无回旋余地；ought to 是‘应当（明智之举/道义要求）’，留有选择余地。句法上 must 后接原形，无 to

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·ought to 的否定与疑问（课件）

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·ought to 的否定与疑问

advancedExpressions.expression: if ..., we ought to ... rather than ...

translation: 特别的，格外的；特指的；挑剔的
original_sentence: Teachers in particular can provide suggestions for interesting reading materials that can be found in the library or bookshop easily.
readingExamples: Teachers in particular can provide suggestions for interesting reading materials that can be found in the library or bookshop easily.
definitionEn:
(1) adj. used to emphasize that you are referring to one specific thing or person and not others
(2) adj. special, or greater than usual; deserving special attention
(3) adj. very careful, and hard to please about exactly how or what you want
(4) n. (usually plural: particulars) a detail or piece of information

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【课件】格外的，特别的，很特殊的（very special；如 a matter of particular importance 格外重要的事、for no particular reason 无特殊原因）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【课件】特指的，某个特定的（specific；如 in this particular case 在此个别情况中）
uncommonMeanings.example: In this particular case, the usual rule simply does not apply. （课件义·特指的）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【课件】讲究的，挑剔的（be particular over / about sth 对……挑剔）
uncommonMeanings.example: French people are said to be very particular about clothes. （课件原句·挑剔的）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 特指的，某个特定的（强调众多之中的这一个，非其他）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 挑剔的，讲究的，苛求的（about）

collocations.translation: 【课件】对……讲究、挑剔（particular = 挑剔的、讲究的）

original_sentence: Teachers in particular can provide suggestions for interesting reading materials that can be found in the library or bookshop easily.

definitionEn:
(1) phr. especially; more than others (used to single out one thing or person from a group for emphasis)

original_sentence: 1 How is the story of the child and the man related to the topic of literature?
readingExamples: 1 How is the story of the child and the man related to the topic of literature?
definitionEn:
(1) n. a subject that people discuss, write about, or study
(2) n. the main theme or matter dealt with in a piece of writing, a speech, or a conversation
(3) n. (topic sentence) the sentence that states the main idea of a paragraph

posExamples.sentence: At the mention of his late wife, the old man fell silent, and the children, sensing they had strayed onto a forbidden topic, quietly slipped out of the room. （读后续写·敏感话题·体贴）
For our next club meeting, I propose that we choose environmental protection as the main topic, since it concerns every single one of us. （应用文·倡议 / 通知）
Whatever the topic under debate, a wise speaker listens far more than he speaks, for understanding must always come before persuasion. （议论文·辩论素养）
The weather was the safest topic they had, and so they clung to it, two strangers on a long train journey, each too shy to say what really lay on their minds. （读后续写·陌生人相处·欲言又止）

collocations.translation: 文学这一话题（课文原句）
collocations.example: How is the story of the child and the man related to the topic of literature? （课文原句）
No one dared to raise the topic of money at the dinner table. （读后续写·家庭紧张）
Artificial intelligence has become a hot topic in every classroom. （议论文·科技）

No one dared to raise the topic of money at the dinner table. （读后续写·家庭）
In a good argument, one must stick to the topic. （议论文·辩论规则）
Halfway through, the speech wandered hopelessly off topic, and the restless audience began checking their watches. （读后续写·演讲失利）
Begin each paragraph with a clear topic sentence. （应用文·写作指导）
The lecture covered a wide range of topics, from ancient poetry to modern film. （应用文·讲座通知）

synonyms.example: The subject of her painting was a lonely lighthouse standing firm against the storm. （读后续写·艺术）
synonyms.usage: 含义最广，可指‘话题、绘画/文章主题、学科科目’；topic 更具体，指‘被讨论、写作或研究的具体题目’，不指学科

synonyms.example: Loneliness runs through the whole novel like a dark thread, its central theme quietly binding every chapter together. （议论文·文学赏析）
synonyms.usage: 侧重作品/活动中反复出现的‘中心思想或基调’，较抽象、深层；topic 是表层讨论对象，更具体、可数、常搭 the topic of

synonyms.example: Climate change is the most pressing issue our generation will ever have to face. （议论文·社会议题）
synonyms.usage: 侧重‘有争议、待解决的问题’，带矛盾冲突；topic 中性，泛指任何谈论/写作的题目，不必有争议

advancedExpressions.expression: the topic of sth / change the topic / stick to the topic / off topic / a topic sentence
advancedExpressions.example: the topic of literature 文学话题；change the topic 转移话题；stick to the topic 不跑题；go off topic 离题；a topic sentence 主题句。

advancedExpressions.expression: topic(n.) → topical(adj. 时下热议的/局部的)
advancedExpressions.example: Climate change is a highly topical subject these days. —— 形容词 topical 表‘当下热门的、与时事相关的’。

advancedExpressions.expression: at the mention of the topic, ...
advancedExpressions.example: At the mention of that painful topic, a shadow crossed her face, and the warm, chattering room seemed all at once to grow cold and still. （at the mention of+环境随情绪变化）

advancedExpressions.expression: I propose that we take ... as the topic of ...
advancedExpressions.example: I propose that we take mental well-being as the topic of this month's assembly, for it is a subject too often whispered about and too rarely openly discussed. （propose that虚拟语气+for原因）

advancedExpressions.expression: when it comes to the topic of ..., opinions divide sharply

original_sentence: Take time to look through the collections in different sections of your local library, and you are likely to come across books you love to read.
readingExamples: Take time to look through the collections in different sections of your local library, and you are likely to come across books you love to read.
definitionEn:
(1) n. a group of objects, works, or texts that have been gathered together, often of the same kind or by one person
(2) n. the act or process of gathering things together over a period of time
(3) n. an amount of money collected from a number of people, especially for charity or in a religious service
(4) n. a range of new clothes or products designed to be sold in a particular season

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【课件】（同类的）收集物，收藏品；一批物品（a group of objects；如 a stamp/coin collection、a collection of paintings）
uncommonMeanings.example: We enjoyed a fine collection of paintings in the art gallery. （课件原句·收藏品）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【课件】作品集（a collection of short stories 短篇小说集）
uncommonMeanings.example: The writer's latest collection of short stories has just been published. （课件义·作品集）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【课件】取走，聚集；（垃圾的）收运、（数据的）采集（an act of taking sth away / bringing things together）
uncommonMeanings.example: Your suit will be ready for collection on Tuesday. / rubbish / data collection （课件原句·取走/收集）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【课件】募捐；募集的钱（an act of collecting money to help a charity；make a collection for）
uncommonMeanings.example: They made a collection for Cancer Research. The total collection last week rose to £250. （课件原句·募捐；课件原文误作 raised，此处 rise 不及物用 rose）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （同类）收藏品；收藏系列（a group of gathered objects/works）
uncommonMeanings.example: Kneeling on the attic floor, she opened the dusty box and gasped: inside lay her grandfather's stamp collection. （读后续写·睹物思人）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 收集（的过程）；（垃圾等的）收运；数据的采集
uncommonMeanings.example: Careful data collection over three years finally allowed the team to prove what everyone had only suspected. （议论文·科研方法）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （教堂或活动中的）募捐；募集的款项
uncommonMeanings.example: As the wooden plate went round the candlelit chapel, the old woman dropped her last coin into the collection — a gift far heavier than its weight in silver. （读后续写·善良与牺牲）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （服装、产品的）系列，一季新品
uncommonMeanings.example: The designer's spring collection sold out within hours of its release. （应用文·时尚报道）

posExamples.sentence: Kneeling on the attic floor, she opened the dusty box and gasped: inside lay her grandfather's stamp collection, each faded square a tiny window onto journeys he had never lived to finish. （读后续写·睹物思人）
I am writing to invite you to donate to the book collection our school is building for the mountain village school, so that children there may finally have a library to call their own. （应用文·倡议信）
A well-curated collection of primary sources, rather than a single textbook, is what truly trains students to weigh evidence and think for themselves. （议论文·教育主题）

collocations.translation: 【课件】为……募捐（an act of collecting money to help a charity 募捐、募集的钱）
collocations.example: They made a collection for Cancer Research. / The total collection last week rose to £250. （课件原句·募捐；课件原文误作 raised，intransitive 应用 rose）

Careful data collection over three years finally allowed the team to prove their point. （议论文·科研方法）

original_sentence: Take time to look through the collections in different sections of your local library, and you are likely to come across books you love to read.
readingExamples: Take time to look through the collections in different sections of your local library, and you are likely to come across books you love to read.
definitionEn:
(1) n. one of the parts that something is divided into
(2) n. a distinct part of a document, book, newspaper, or piece of writing
(3) n. a department or division of an organization, shop, or institution
(4) n. a representation of what the inside of something would look like if it were cut through; a cross-section

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【课件】部分，部门（any of the parts into which sth is divided；如 the reference section 参考书部、one section of the road 一段路）
uncommonMeanings.example: You'll find that book in the reference section. 你可以在参考书部找到那本书。 （课件原句·部分/部门）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【课件】（文件、书报的）节，栏，版（a separate part of a document, book, etc.；如 the sports section、in the next section）
uncommonMeanings.example: These issues will be discussed more fully in the next section. 这些问题将在下一节中有更加充分的讨论。 （课件原句·节/栏）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （空间的）区，区域（如图书馆、商店的分区）
uncommonMeanings.example: Lost in the vast reading room, the boy wandered from section to section until, in the dimmest corner, a battered adventure novel seemed to call his name. （读后续写·图书馆奇遇）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （文件、书报的）栏目，版块，一段
uncommonMeanings.example: Grandfather always reached for the sports section first. （读后续写·人物习惯）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （机构、公司的）部门，处，科

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 剖面图；横截面（= cross-section）

sentenceUpgrade.original: He looked for the book in the library.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: He drifted through section after section of the silent library, fingertips grazing the spines, until one worn cover — its title half rubbed away — stopped him as surely as a hand on the shoulder. （读后续写·寻书）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: section after section 叠词营造漫游感 + 分词伴随(fingertips grazing) + 破折号补充细节 + as surely as a hand on the shoulder 明喻收束

sentenceUpgrade.original: The form has different parts to fill in.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The application form is divided into clearly labelled sections, so please complete each one in turn to ensure that no essential information is accidentally left out. （应用文·填表须知）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: be divided into clearly labelled sections 正式被动 + so please... 转入祈使指令 + to ensure that... 目的状语明确后果

classPractice.question: 你可以在参考书部找到那本书。You'll find that book ____ ____ ____ ____.
classPractice.note: 课件原句；section 指图书馆分出来的‘部分/区’

classPractice.question: 这些问题将在下一节中有更加充分的讨论。These issues will be discussed more fully ____ ____ ____ ____.
classPractice.note: 课件原句；section 指文件/书报的‘节、栏、版’

classPractice.question: 花时间浏览图书馆不同区域的藏书。Take time to look through the collections ____ ____ ____ of your local library.
classPractice.note: 课文原句；section 此处指图书馆的‘分区/区域’

classPractice.question: 用 section / department 填空：Grandfather always turned to the sports ____ of the newspaper first, while Mum worked in the sales ____ of a big store.
classPractice.note: 报刊栏目用 section；公司按职能划分的部门用 department

classPractice.question: The survey deliberately included ____ ____ ____ ____ society, from students to retired workers, so its conclusions could be trusted.
classPractice.note: a cross-section of 某群体的典型代表/横截面

translation: 吝啬的，小气的；不善良的，刻薄的
original_sentence: The book's main character is Scrooge, a rich but mean old man.
readingExamples: The book's main character is Scrooge, a rich but mean old man.
definitionEn:
(1) adj. unkind, cruel, or unpleasant, especially in a spiteful way
(2) adj. not willing to give or spend money; stingy
(3) v. to intend to express or refer to a particular thing; to signify
(4) v. to intend to do something, or intend that something should happen

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【课件】（金钱方面）吝啬的，小气的（be mean with money；opp. generous）——课文义
uncommonMeanings.example: The book's main character is Scrooge, a rich but mean old man. （课文原句·吝啬鬼形象）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【课件】对某人刻薄的，不善良的（be mean to sb；unkind）
uncommonMeanings.example: It is unkind to be mean to those who are weaker than you. （课件义·刻薄）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【课件】卑鄙的（a mean trick 卑鄙的伎俩）
uncommonMeanings.example: In order to climb up the career ladder, he does not hesitate to use every mean trick. （课件原句·卑鄙）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【课件】平均的；平均数（mean temperature 平均气温；average）
uncommonMeanings.example: The mean temperature in July here is around thirty degrees. （课件义·平均）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【课件】打算，意欲（mean to do sth）；应当（be meant to do = be supposed to do）
uncommonMeanings.example: I meant to apologize, but the words stuck in my throat. / You are meant to hand it in by Friday. （课件短语·打算/应当）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 吝啬的，小气的（unwilling to spend money）——课文义
uncommonMeanings.example: The book's main character is Scrooge, a rich but mean old man. （课文原句·吝啬鬼形象）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 不善良的，刻薄的，卑鄙的（unkind, spiteful）
uncommonMeanings.example: It is mean to laugh at a classmate's accent. （议论文·品德）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 意味着，表示；意思是（signify）
uncommonMeanings.example: Please note that a signature on this form means you agree to abide by all the club's rules. （应用文·须知）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 打算，意欲（intend）
uncommonMeanings.example: I did not mean to hurt you, Grandma; the words had escaped before I could catch them. （读后续写·悔悟）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （数学、统计）平均数；平均的；中间值
uncommonMeanings.example: The teacher scribbled the mean value on the board, but my eyes were fixed on the window. （读后续写·课堂走神）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （口语）出色的，极好的
uncommonMeanings.example: 'He plays a mean guitar,' the old busker chuckled, nodding toward the boy whose fingers danced across the strings. （读后续写·街头才艺）

posExamples.sentence: The old landlord was famous for being mean — he counted every lump of coal and let the fire die long before the children's fingers had thawed. （读后续写·吝啬人物）
It is mean to laugh at a classmate's accent; a truly kind person builds others up rather than tearing them down. （议论文·品德主题）
I did not mean to hurt you, Grandma; the words had escaped before I could catch them, and now I would have given anything to take them back. （读后续写·悔悟）
Please note that a signature on this form means you agree to abide by all the club's rules. （应用文·须知）

wordForms.other: means 手段/方法（by means of 借助）, meantime / meanwhile 与此同时；meanness n. 吝啬/刻薄；mean 为不规则动词 meant - meant；注意 means 作‘手段’单复数同形

idioms.example: 'May I borrow your notes?' 'By all means — I only wish mine were tidier.' （应用文·对话）
Success is by no means guaranteed, yet giving up guarantees the very failure we fear. （议论文·励志）
She meant well, but her blunt honesty left him staring silently at the floor. （读后续写·好心办坏事）
When the coach rolled up his sleeves and blew the whistle twice, we knew he meant business. （读后续写·训练）
For her, money had always been merely a means to an end, never the end itself. （议论文·价值观）

collocations.translation: 【课件】（金钱方面）吝啬的，小气的（opp. generous）
collocations.example: The book's main character is Scrooge, a rich but mean old man who is mean with money. （课件原句/义·吝啬）
It is unkind to be mean to those who are weaker than you. （课件义·刻薄）
In order to climb up the career ladder, he does not hesitate to use every mean trick. （课件原句·卑鄙）
The mean temperature in July here is around thirty degrees. （课件义·平均）
I meant to thank him properly, but by the time I found the courage, the train had already pulled away. （课件短语·打算）

collocations.translation: 【课件】应当做某事（= be supposed to do）
collocations.example: You are meant to fill in this part in block capitals. 这一栏你应当用大写字母填写。 （课件短语·应当）

collocations.translation: 【课件】本意是好的，出于好心（adj. well-meaning）
collocations.example: She meant well, but her blunt honesty left him staring silently at the floor. （课件短语·好心）
The stray dog meant no harm; it simply longed, like all of us, for a little warmth. （课件短语·无恶意）
Don't laugh — I mean it: one more careless mistake and you are off the team. （课件原句·认真）

collocations.translation: 一个吝啬（刻薄）的老头（课文原句）
collocations.example: The book's main character is Scrooge, a rich but mean old man. （课文原句）
I meant to thank him properly, but by the time I found the courage, the train had already pulled away. （读后续写·遗憾）

collocations.translation: 对某人意味着；对某人很重要
collocations.example: That faded scarf meant more to her than any treasure, for it still carried her mother's scent. （读后续写·怀念）
The other children were mean to the new boy, mocking his shabby coat until his eyes glistened. （读后续写·校园欺凌）

collocations.phrase: mean a lot / everything to sb
collocations.example: Your encouragement means everything to me, and it gave me the courage to step onto that stage. （应用文·感谢信）
His well-meaning advice, however clumsy, came from a place of genuine care. （读后续写·人物）
He grew up on the mean streets of the old town, where survival demanded a toughness few could imagine. （读后续写·背景铺垫）
The stray dog meant no harm; it simply longed, like all of us, for a little warmth. （读后续写·怜悯）
'What do you mean by staying out so late?' her father asked, though relief, not anger, trembled in his voice. （读后续写·亲情）

synonyms.example: Unlike his mean old master, the boy grew up warm-hearted and generous, always ready to share his last coin. （读后续写·品格对照）
synonyms.usage: 【课件】mean（吝啬的）的反义词即 generous。generous 指乐于给予、花钱大方，褒义；与 be mean with money 恰成对照，写吝啬人物时可用 generous 反衬

synonyms.example: It was cruel of them to abandon the puppy on such a bitter, snow-swept night. （读后续写·冷漠）
synonyms.usage: 程度比 mean 重，强调造成实际痛苦或伤害，常搭 It is cruel of sb to do；mean 常指日常的刻薄、小气、不友善，程度较轻

synonyms.example: He was too stingy to spare even a coin for the shivering beggar. （读后续写·人物弱点）
synonyms.usage: 专指在钱财上吝啬，与 mean 的‘吝啬’义完全重合，但 stingy 更口语、贬义更集中，不含‘刻薄’一义；作表语/定语皆可

synonyms.example: You are supposed to hand in the form by Friday. （应用文·规定说明）
synonyms.usage: 【课件】be meant to do = be supposed to do，均表‘（按规定/惯例）应当做某事’，可互换；后接动词原形，随主语与时态变 be 动词

synonyms.example: A single red envelope, in our culture, can signify years of unspoken love. （议论文·文化）
synonyms.usage: 正式用词，多用于符号、标志所代表的含义；mean 更通用，日常口语和写作皆宜，后可接 that 从句或 to do

synonyms.example: I intend to devote this summer to helping migrant children with their English. （应用文·计划）
synonyms.usage: 较正式，强调有明确目的和计划，常搭 intend to do / intend doing；口语里 mean to do 更自然、更随意

advancedExpressions.expression: find + 宾语 + 宾补（形容词/doing/done/名词/介词短语）：发现……处于某种状态
advancedExpressions.example: Over time, you may find yourself better able to seek out books to your taste. （课文原句·find+宾+形容词）/ I found the vase broken.（find+宾+done 被动）/ People often find the old lady appreciating the flowers.（find+宾+doing 主动）/ The police found the criminal's car abandoned in a remote playground.（find+宾+done）/ She found him a very clever boy.（find+宾+名词）/ She found herself in a different world.（find+宾+介词短语） —— find 后接形容词/doing(主动)/done(被动)/名词/介词短语作宾补，表‘发现宾语处于某种状态’。

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·感官动词see/watch/hear+宾补（被动还原to）
advancedExpressions.expression: see / watch / observe / notice / hear / feel + 宾语 + do / doing / done；被动语态中省略的 to 须还原
advancedExpressions.example: We saw the student practise singing in the classroom.（感官动词+宾+省 to 不定式，表全过程）→ 被动：The student was seen to practise singing in the classroom.（还原 to） —— 感官动词后接省 to 的不定式作宾补，主动省 to、被动须还原 to；同类还有 make / keep / name / call / leave 等亦常接宾补。

advancedExpressions.type: 短语群·mean 一词多义速记
advancedExpressions.expression: be mean to sb（刻薄）/ a mean man（吝啬）/ mean to do（打算）/ mean sth to sb（对…重要）/ mean no harm（无意伤害）
advancedExpressions.example: adj. 吝啬/刻薄；v. 意味着/打算；n. 平均数 —— 靠搭配定词性词义，如 be mean to sb 刻薄、mean to do 打算。

advancedExpressions.expression: by all means 当然 / by no means 决不 / a means to an end 手段 / meanwhile 与此同时
advancedExpressions.example: by no means 绝不（可置句首引起部分倒装：By no means should we give up）；meanwhile 承接前后事件，作副词。

advancedExpressions.expression: mean(v./adj.) → meaning(n.意义) → meaningful(adj.重要的/意味深长的) → meaningless(adj.无意义的) → meanness(n.吝啬)
advancedExpressions.example: a meaningful look 意味深长的一瞥；a meaningless argument 毫无意义的争论；his meanness with money 他用钱上的吝啬。 —— 课件强调 meaning / meaningful / meaningless 一族。

advancedExpressions.expression: sb. had never meant to ...; and yet ...
advancedExpressions.example: She had never meant to let him down; and yet, watching the disappointment settle over his face, she realised that good intentions, unspoken, weigh nothing at all. （转折+格言式升华）

advancedExpressions.expression: words can hardly express how much ... has meant to ...
advancedExpressions.example: Words can hardly express how much your patient guidance has meant to me over these three years. （感谢信高级开头，避免直白的 thank you）

advancedExpressions.expression: true ... does not mean ...; rather, it means ...
advancedExpressions.example: True courage does not mean the absence of fear; rather, it means acting rightly in spite of it. （下定义式论证）

sentenceUpgrade.original: He was a mean old man.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: He was a mean old man to the very marrow — a soul so shrivelled by greed that even the warmth of a Christmas fire seemed, in his eyes, an unforgivable waste. （读后续写·反派刻画）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: to the very marrow 强化程度 + 破折号引出比喻(soul shrivelled by greed) + in his eyes 视角揭示扭曲价值观

sentenceUpgrade.original: Your help was very important to me.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Looking back on that difficult year, I now understand just how much your quiet, unfailing support meant to me — a lifeline extended precisely when I felt myself sinking. （应用文·感谢信）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: Looking back... 分词回顾开头 + just how much...meant 强调重要性 + 破折号+比喻(a lifeline) 情感升华

classPractice.type: 辨析选词（课件·一词多义）
classPractice.question: 判断 mean 词义：(1) a rich but ____ old man 意为____；(2) Don't be ____ ____ your little brother. 意为____；(3) the ____ temperature in July 意为____。（词填 mean，义写中文）
classPractice.answer: mean(吝啬的); mean to(对……刻薄); mean(平均的)
classPractice.note: 课件义：be mean with money 吝啬（反 generous）；be mean to sb 刻薄；mean temperature 平均气温

classPractice.type: 完成句子（课件·应当=be supposed to）
classPractice.question: 这一栏你应当用大写字母填写。You ____ ____ ____ fill in this part in block capitals.（用 be meant to）
classPractice.note: 课件：be meant to do = be supposed to do 应当做某事

classPractice.question: Over time, you may find ____ (you) better able to seek out books to your taste; and one morning you may find the vase ____ (break) on the floor.
classPractice.note: 课件·find+宾补：find yourself + adj.（better able）；find + 宾 + done（broken 表被动状态）

classPractice.type: 句型转换（课件·感官动词被动还原to）
classPractice.question: We saw the student practise singing in the classroom. → 改为被动语态：The student ____ ____ ____ practise singing in the classroom.
classPractice.note: 课件：感官动词主动省 to，变被动时不定式须还原 to（was seen to practise）

classPractice.question: 判断 mean 词义（吝啬/意味着/打算）：Scrooge is a rich but ____ old man who counts every coin. 此处 mean 意为____。
classPractice.note: 课文原句 a rich but mean old man；mean 作形容词表‘吝啬、小气’

classPractice.question: I didn't ____ (mean) to hurt you—the words escaped before I could stop them.
classPractice.note: mean to do sth 打算/有意做某事；didn't 后接动词原形

classPractice.question: 成功绝不是必然的。Success is ____ ____ ____ guaranteed.
classPractice.note: by no means 决不/一点也不，为否定副词短语（对应 by all means 当然可以）

translation: 运输，运送； /ˈtrænspɔːt/ n. 交通运输系统；交通车辆；运输
original_sentence: On Christmas Eve, he is transported to different points in his life by three spirits.
readingExamples: On Christmas Eve, he is transported to different points in his life by three spirits.
definitionEn:
(1) v. to move people or goods from one place to another using a vehicle
(2) n. a system or means of carrying people or goods from one place to another
(3) n. the act or process of moving people or goods
(4) v. (literary) to make someone feel as if they were somewhere else, or in a different state of mind

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （文学用法）使沉浸；使心驰神往（仿佛置身别处）
uncommonMeanings.example: The first few notes of the old lullaby transported her back to a summer kitchen thirty years gone, where sunlight pooled on the tiles and her mother hummed at the stove. （读后续写·音乐唤起回忆）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （旧时）流放；被流放的犯人
uncommonMeanings.example: In those harsh centuries, even the theft of a loaf of bread could sentence a man to transport across the ocean, never to see his homeland again. （读后续写·历史沧桑）

posExamples.sentence: The rescue team worked through the night to transport the stranded villagers to higher ground, cradling the smallest children against the driving rain. （读后续写·救援）
Closing the novel at last, she felt as though the story had transported her to windswept moors she would never truly leave. （读后续写·阅读体验）
To reduce our carbon footprint, I strongly recommend that we all choose public transport over private cars whenever the journey allows. （应用文·倡议信）
A city's investment in clean, efficient public transport is, in the long run, an investment in the health, time and dignity of every citizen who calls it home. （议论文·城市与环保）

wordForms.other: transit（过境；运输）

collocations.translation: 被运送到；（文学）被带到（另一时空/心境）【课文原句词块】
collocations.example: On Christmas Eve, he is transported to different points in his life by three spirits. （课文原句）

collocations.translation: 公共交通【重音在前 n. /ˈtrænspɔːt/】
collocations.example: I take public transport to school every day to save money. （日常出行）
The bicycle is the greenest mode of transport for short trips. （议论文·环保）

collocations.translation: 把某人／某物运送到【重音在后 v. /trænˈspɔːt/】
collocations.example: The ambulance transported the injured hiker to hospital within the hour. （应用文·事故报道）
Volunteers used their own vans to transport supplies to families cut off by the landslide. （读后续写·灾后互助）
A reliable transport network is the quiet backbone on which a modern economy depends. （议论文·基础设施）
Poor transport links have long kept the mountain village trapped in poverty. （议论文·发展问题）
Shifting more freight from road to rail transport would cut both traffic jams and emissions at a stroke. （议论文·可持续发展）
The organisers kindly provided transport for elderly participants unable to make the journey alone. （应用文·活动通知）

synonyms.example: The porters carried the heavy crates up the steep mountain path, sweat streaming down their sunburnt faces. （读后续写·劳作）
synonyms.usage: 最普通的搬运词，可指手提、肩扛，也可指工具运送；transport 更正式，多指用交通工具较长距离运输

synonyms.example: Pipelines convey fresh water across hundreds of kilometres of desert to the thirsty city. （议论文·工程）
synonyms.usage: 正式书面语，既可指运送货物、液体，也可指传达信息、情感；transport 更侧重具体的人或货物

synonyms.example: The factory ships thousands of parcels overseas every single day. （应用文·商务）
synonyms.usage: 原指海运，现泛指用各种方式（尤指长途、商业）运送货物；口语商业味浓，不用于'运送乘客'

advancedExpressions.type: 构词法·trans-（跨越）+ port（搬运/港口）
advancedExpressions.expression: trans-（横过、越过）+ port（搬、运）→ transport 把东西「搬过」空间＝运输；同根 transfer 转移、transmit 传送、transform 变形、transplant 移植、import 进口、export 出口、portable 便携的
advancedExpressions.example: 记住 port＝carry：trans-port 搬过去＝运输，im-port 搬进来＝进口，ex-port 搬出去＝出口，sup-port 从下托举＝支撑。（构词法串记）

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·重音移位辨词性（名动同形）
advancedExpressions.expression: transport 名词重音在前 /ˈtrænspɔːt/（交通/运输），动词重音在后 /trænˈspɔːt/（运送）；同类词 record / present / import / export / increase / object 都是「名前动后」
advancedExpressions.example: We should improve public ˈtransport (n.) so that fewer cars are needed to transˈport (v.) people around the city. （一句内对比名动重音）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·「运送」功能（可替换 transport sth）
advancedExpressions.expression: transport / carry / convey / ship / deliver / move（均可表『把人或货物运送到某处』，正式度与侧重不同：carry 最普通，convey 最正式，ship 商业运货，deliver 递送到位）
advancedExpressions.example: The company can transport / carry / convey / ship / deliver / move the goods overseas within a week. （功能同义替换）

advancedExpressions.expression: the ... instantly transported sb. back to ...
advancedExpressions.example: The scent of pine needles instantly transported him back to the winters of his childhood, when snow muffled the world and hope came wrapped in coloured paper. （感官触发+时空穿越，营造温暖回忆）

advancedExpressions.expression: by opting for public transport rather than ..., we can ...
advancedExpressions.example: By opting for public transport rather than private cars, we can each play a small but meaningful part in clearing our city's skies. （倡议信呼吁行动，small but meaningful 谦逊有力）

advancedExpressions.expression: an efficient transport system serves as ...
advancedExpressions.example: An efficient transport system serves as the arteries of a nation, carrying not merely people and goods, but opportunity itself. （隐喻 arteries + not merely...but 递进升华）

sentenceUpgrade.original: The song reminded her of her hometown.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: One bar of that half-forgotten melody was enough to transport her home — to the crooked lane, the smoke of evening cooking, and a mother's voice calling her in from the dusk. （读后续写·思乡）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: transport her home 熟词僻义(使心驰神往) + 破折号+三项并列意象(lane, smoke, voice) 铺陈画面 + 具象细节唤起乡愁

sentenceUpgrade.original: We should use public transport more.

original_sentence: On Christmas morning, he sends a large turkey to a poor man for Christmas dinner.
readingExamples: On Christmas morning, he sends a large turkey to a poor man for Christmas dinner.
definitionEn:
(1) n. a large bird that is often kept for its meat, traditionally eaten at Christmas or Thanksgiving
(2) n. the meat of this bird
(3) n. (informal, especially American English) a film, play, or event that is a complete failure
(4) n. (informal, American English) a stupid or foolish person

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （美式口语）彻底失败之作；砸锅的演出或电影
uncommonMeanings.example: Everyone had expected a triumph, yet the long-awaited play turned out to be a turkey — the curtain fell to a silence heavier than any boo. （读后续写·希望落空）

posExamples.sentence: The golden turkey sat steaming at the centre of the table, and for the first time in years the whole family gathered round it, the old quarrels melting away in the candlelight. （读后续写·团圆）
On Christmas morning the reformed old man sent the biggest turkey in the shop to the poor family down the lane, and joy came knocking where sorrow had long lived. （读后续写·善良的转变）
We warmly invite every family to our charity dinner, where a traditional roast turkey will be shared with lonely elderly neighbours this festive season. （应用文·邀请函）
The Thanksgiving turkey is more than a dish; it is a yearly reminder that gratitude, freely shared, is the surest recipe for a warm home. （议论文·感恩主题）

idioms.translation: （美式口语）打开天窗说亮话；谈正经事
idioms.example: Enough small talk — let's sit down and talk turkey about how we are going to fund this project. （应用文·商议）
He quit his phone addiction cold turkey, and the first sleepless nights were a battle he barely won. （读后续写·自律）

idioms.translation: （英式）自寻死路；做违背自身利益的事
idioms.example: For the workers to support the plan was like turkeys voting for Christmas, and yet fear kept them silent. （议论文·反常选择，慎用于口语化语境）

collocations.translation: 一只（大）火鸡【课文原句词块】
collocations.example: On Christmas morning, he sends a large turkey to a poor man for Christmas dinner. （课文原句）
The smell of roast turkey drifted from the kitchen at Christmas. （节日）
Carving the Thanksgiving turkey was Father's proudest duty of the whole year. （读后续写·家庭传统）
Grandfather stood to carve the turkey, and a hush of respect settled over the crowded table. （读后续写·家庭仪式）
Mother let me help stuff the turkey that year, and flour on my nose became the badge of my new grown-up status. （读后续写·童年记忆）
We are organising a free turkey dinner for anyone who would otherwise spend Christmas alone. （应用文·公益活动）
He carried a whole turkey through the snow to the widow's door, saying only, 'Merry Christmas,' before vanishing into the night. （读后续写·无名善举）

advancedExpressions.expression: talk turkey 打开天窗说亮话／谈正经事｜quit / go cold turkey 突然彻底戒断（毒瘾、手机瘾等）｜a turkey（美式口语）彻底失败之作（电影/演出砸锅）
advancedExpressions.example: Let's stop joking and talk turkey; if you truly want to change, you may have to quit gaming cold turkey. （两习语同句）

advancedExpressions.type: 构词法·专有名词与普通名词（首字母大小写辨义）
advancedExpressions.expression: 小写 turkey＝火鸡；大写 Turkey＝土耳其（国名）。类似『小写普通义 / 大写专有义』的还有 china 瓷器 / China 中国，japan 漆器 / Japan 日本，polish 擦亮 / Polish 波兰的
advancedExpressions.example: The turkey on our table has nothing to do with the country Turkey. （小写火鸡 vs 大写国名）

advancedExpressions.expression: around the ... turkey, the whole family ...
advancedExpressions.example: Around the steaming turkey, the whole family drew close, and years of distance seemed to dissolve in a single shared grace. （以食物为圆心聚拢人物，象征和解）

advancedExpressions.expression: we would be honoured to share our turkey dinner with ...
advancedExpressions.example: This Christmas, we would be honoured to share our turkey dinner with any neighbour who might otherwise face the day alone. （邀请函，honoured 显真诚谦和）

advancedExpressions.expression: the ... turkey stands as a symbol of ...
advancedExpressions.example: Far more than a festive dish, the Thanksgiving turkey stands as a symbol of gratitude, abundance shared, and the ties that bind a family together.

sentenceUpgrade.original: The family ate turkey together at Christmas.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: As the golden turkey was set down at the heart of the table, the whole family fell quiet for a heartbeat — and in that hush, wrapped in the smell of sage and candle smoke, each of them silently gave thanks for simply being together. （读后续写·团圆感恩）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: As... 时间状语开场 + at the heart of the table 空间聚焦 + 破折号+for a heartbeat 定格瞬间 + wrapped in the smell of... 分词嵌入感官细节

sentenceUpgrade.original: We will give a turkey dinner to lonely people.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: This festive season, we are opening our doors to host a turkey dinner for elderly neighbours who live alone, in the firm belief that no one should have to face Christmas in silence. （应用文·公益倡议）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: This festive season 时间状语点氛围 + open our doors to host 生动动词 + in the firm belief that... 表明动机与情怀 + no one should... 呼吁式收尾

classPractice.question: 在圣诞节早晨，他送了一只大火鸡给一个穷人做圣诞晚餐。On Christmas morning, he sends ____ ____ ____ to a poor man for Christmas dinner.
classPractice.note: 课文原句还原；turkey 可数名词，前加不定冠词 a。

classPractice.question: Enough polite chatter — it's time we sat down and talked ____ about who is going to pay for all this.
classPractice.note: talk turkey『打开天窗说亮话、谈正经事』；固定习语用 turkey，不加冠词。

classPractice.question: 选词填空（turkey / Turkey）：The roast ____ smelled wonderful, but Grandpa spent the whole dinner talking about his trip to ____.
classPractice.note: 小写 turkey＝火鸡；大写 Turkey＝土耳其（国名），句首/专有名词首字母大写。

original_sentence: There is something that can be learnt from A Christmas Carol: we should treat others with kindness, generosity and love.
readingExamples: There is something that can be learnt from A Christmas Carol: we should treat others with kindness, generosity and love.
definitionEn:
(1) n. the quality of being kind and willing to give money, help, or time freely
(2) n. the quality of being willing to see the good in others and not to judge them harshly; broad-mindedness
(3) n. an act of giving something, especially money, willingly and abundantly

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （尺寸、数量上的）宽裕；丰厚
uncommonMeanings.example: It was the generosity of the portions, as much as the warmth of the welcome, that made the tiny roadside inn a place travellers never forgot. （读后续写·旅途温情）

posExamples.sentence: Moved by the stranger's generosity, the boy stared at the banknote pressed into his palm and vowed, there and then, to pass such kindness on one day. （读后续写·善意传递）
On behalf of the whole class, I would like to thank you for your generosity in donating so many books to our library. （应用文·感谢信）
Generosity, far from making us poorer, enriches the giver in ways no bank balance can ever measure. （议论文·品德主题）
The transformation of Scrooge reminds us that a heart hardened by greed can still be thawed by a single act of generosity. （议论文·文学感悟）

wordForms.other: 词族：generous (adj.) → generosity (n.) → generously (adv.)；反义 mean / stingy（吝啬的）；treat sb with generosity = be generous to sb

collocations.phrase: treat others with kindness, generosity and love
collocations.translation: 以善良、慷慨和爱对待他人【课文原句词块】
collocations.example: We should treat others with kindness, generosity and love. （课文原句）
She always gives to those in need with generosity. （品德）
That small act of generosity — a warm coat handed to a shivering stranger — set off ripples of kindness across the whole town. （读后续写·善意涟漪）
Even in her own hardship, the widow showed a generosity that put wealthier neighbours to shame. （读后续写·人性光辉）
We sincerely thank every donor for their generosity, without which this charity concert could never have happened. （应用文·致谢）
He shared his last loaf with great generosity, keeping only a corner for himself. （读后续写·牺牲）
What I admired most in my grandmother was her generosity of spirit — she forgave those who had wronged her before they even thought to ask. （读后续写·人物美德）
Stranded far from home, she survived on the quiet generosity of strangers who asked for nothing in return. （读后续写·困境）
He lent them the cottage out of pure generosity, waving away every offer of rent. （读后续写·善良）

collocations.translation: 无尽的／令人动容的慷慨
collocations.example: The community's overwhelming generosity after the fire restored the family's faith in human kindness. （读后续写·灾后互助）

synonyms.example: A single word of kindness from the teacher was enough to steady the trembling new student. （读后续写·关怀）
synonyms.usage: 泛指一切善意与友好，范围最广；generosity 特指乐于给予（金钱、时间、宽容），是 kindness 的一种具体表现

synonyms.example: The old scholar lived on charity in his final years, yet never lost his dignity. （读后续写·晚景）
synonyms.usage: 既指慈善机构／慈善事业，也指对穷困者的救济，可能略带'受人施舍'的意味；generosity 更强调给予者主动、大方的品质

synonyms.example: The founder's benevolence lived on in the free school that still bore his name. （议论文·善行）
synonyms.usage: 正式、书面，强调怀有对他人幸福的善意（一种态度）；generosity 更侧重实际的慷慨给予行为

synonyms.example: In victory he showed rare magnanimity, praising the very rivals he had just defeated. （议论文·胸襟）
synonyms.usage: 极正式，专指对待对手或过失时的宽容大度；对应 generosity 中'宽宏大量'一义，但语体更高、更书面

advancedExpressions.type: 构词法·形容词 → 抽象名词（-ity）
advancedExpressions.expression: generous (adj.) 慷慨的 → generosity (n.) 慷慨；同类『-ous → -osity/-ity』：curious→curiosity 好奇，able→ability 能力，pure→purity 纯洁，active→activity 活动，responsible→responsibility 责任
advancedExpressions.example: Being generous costs little, yet generosity can change a life. （形容词转抽象名词同句对照）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·「慷慨/善心」功能
advancedExpressions.expression: generosity / kindness / benevolence / magnanimity（均含善意给予之意：kindness 泛指善良最广，generosity 侧重乐于给予，benevolence 书面『仁心』，magnanimity 专指对对手的宽宏大量）
advancedExpressions.example: We should treat others with kindness and generosity, and, towards those who wrong us, with magnanimity. （递进列举）

advancedExpressions.expression: it was an act of generosity that ... would never forget
advancedExpressions.example: It was an act of generosity so quiet, so unlooked-for, that the boy would carry it in his heart for the rest of his days. （强调式 it was...that + so...so 排比，放大微小善举的重量）

advancedExpressions.expression: your generosity has made ... possible
advancedExpressions.example: Your generosity has made it possible for dozens of rural children to hold a brand-new storybook for the very first time. （感谢信主体，用具体成果替代空泛感谢）

advancedExpressions.expression: generosity is not measured by ..., but by ...
advancedExpressions.example: Generosity is not measured by the size of the gift, but by the size of the sacrifice behind it. （not...but 对照定义，直击本质，警句收束）

sentenceUpgrade.original: The old man became kind and gave a lot to others.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The man who had once counted every coin now gave with open hands and an open heart, his newfound generosity spilling over the town like sunlight after a long, bitter winter. （读后续写·浪子回头）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: who had once... 定语从句形成前后对比 + with open hands and an open heart 平行结构 + spilling over...like sunlight after winter 明喻+季节隐喻升华

sentenceUpgrade.original: Thank you for giving so much to help us.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: On behalf of everyone who has benefited, I wish to express our heartfelt gratitude for the extraordinary generosity you have shown, which has quietly changed more lives than you may ever know. （应用文·感谢信）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: On behalf of... 代表身份提升正式度 + express heartfelt gratitude for 高级致谢 + which 非限制定语从句延伸影响 + than you may ever know 含蓄动人收尾

classPractice.question: There is something we can learn from the story: we should treat others with kindness, ____ (generous) and love.
classPractice.note: 课文原句考点；介词 with 后接名词，且与 kindness、love 并列，故用名词 generosity 而非形容词。

classPractice.question: 用 generous 的适当形式填空：He is a ____ man who always helps others, and it is this ____ that everyone in the village remembers.
classPractice.note: 第一空作定语用形容词 generous；第二空作 this 后的名词中心词，用 generosity。

classPractice.question: 正是陌生人的慷慨（善意）救了她一命。（用 It is ... that 强调句 + the generosity of strangers）
classPractice.answer: It was the generosity of strangers that saved her life. / It is the generosity of strangers that saved her life.
classPractice.note: 强调句 It is/was ... that；generosity 为不可数名词，前不加 a；短语 the generosity of strangers。

original_sentence: Usually divided into several chapters.
readingExamples: Usually divided into several chapters.
definitionEn:
(1) n. one of the parts into which a book is divided, usually numbered or titled
(2) n. a particular period or distinct phase in someone's life or in history
(3) n. a local branch of a society, club or organization
(4) n. (in the phrase 'chapter and verse') an exact and detailed reference or authority for something

uncommonMeanings.meaning: (人生或历史的)一段时期，篇章
uncommonMeanings.example: As the train pulled out of the station and her hometown shrank into the mist, she knew that a new chapter of her life was quietly beginning — one written not in the language of the familiar, but in the trembling ink of the unknown. （读后续写·离别启程·人生阶段）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: (团体的)分会，分部
uncommonMeanings.example: The local chapter of the Red Cross recruited more than fifty volunteers within a single week, most of them students eager to make a difference. （应用文·社团招募）

posExamples.sentence: That summer marked the closing chapter of my childhood: the treehouse we had built with our own hands was torn down, and the empty lot where it once stood seemed to echo with the laughter we would never share again. （读后续写·成长回忆）
I am writing to recommend that the reading club divide each classic novel into weekly chapters, so that members can savour the plot at a steady pace rather than rushing through it. （应用文·建议信）
History is not a single triumphant story but a book of many chapters, and every generation must decide whether it will write one of courage or one of regret. （议论文·历史与责任）

idioms.translation: 详尽准确的出处；确凿的细节
idioms.example: When challenged, the old librarian could quote chapter and verse on every treaty the village had ever signed, silencing his critics at once. （读后续写·人物博学）
The expedition turned into a chapter of accidents — a broken compass, a sudden storm, a lost map — yet somehow the team emerged closer than ever. （读后续写·历险）

collocations.translation: 被分成若干章【课文原句词块】
collocations.example: Usually divided into several chapters. （课文原句）
Going to college opened a new chapter in her life. （人生阶段）
The opening chapter grips you instantly, plunging the reader straight into the heart of the storm. （议论文·文学评论）

collocations.translation: 翻开新的一页；重新开始
collocations.example: Determined to leave his failures behind, he turned over a new chapter and threw himself into his studies with fresh resolve. （读后续写·励志）
The author divided her memoir into twelve chapters, each named after a city she had once called home. （应用文·图书介绍）
The peace agreement wrote the final chapter of a conflict that had scarred the region for decades. （议论文·历史）
She read the story to her little brother chapter by chapter, until his eyelids finally grew heavy. （读后续写·亲情）
Each chapter heading was a single, haunting word that lingered in the reader's mind long after the page was turned. （议论文·文学评论）

collocations.translation: 前面的 / 后面的章节
collocations.example: The clue planted in an early chapter only reveals its meaning in the very last pages. （议论文·叙事技巧）

synonyms.example: The report is neatly organized into a section on causes and a section on solutions. （应用文·报告）
synonyms.usage: 泛指任何被划分出来的部分，比 chapter 更中性、更广，可用于文件、建筑、乐曲等；chapter 特指书籍中较大且有编号的部分

synonyms.example: The project moved smoothly into its final phase once funding was secured. （议论文·计划）
synonyms.usage: 指发展过程中的一个阶段，强调时间上的连续与演变；当 chapter 表'人生阶段'的比喻义时二者相通，但 phase 更学术、更中性

synonyms.example: The rescue was the most dramatic episode in the entire voyage. （读后续写·历险）
synonyms.usage: 指相对独立、生动的一段经历或事件，常带戏剧色彩；chapter 表'人生篇章'时更宏大、更连贯，episode 更零碎、更聚焦单一事件

advancedExpressions.expression: a new chapter (in one's life) 人生新篇章｜turn over a new chapter / turn a new leaf 翻开新一页、重新开始｜open / close a chapter 开启／结束一个阶段｜write the next chapter 书写下一篇章
advancedExpressions.example: Graduation closed one chapter and opened a brand-new one; it was time to turn over a new chapter of my life. （多短语连用）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·「阶段/时期」功能（chapter 比喻义）
advancedExpressions.expression: chapter / phase / stage / period / episode（均可指人生或历史的一段：chapter 比喻『篇章』最有文采，phase/stage 中性指阶段，episode 指一段插曲/经历）
advancedExpressions.example: That year marked a new chapter — a difficult but decisive phase / stage in my life. （比喻义同义替换）

advancedExpressions.type: 读后续写·人生阶段升华
advancedExpressions.expression: as one chapter closed, another quietly opened
advancedExpressions.example: As one chapter of her life closed with the soft click of the departing gate, another — brighter and braver — quietly opened before her. （首尾呼应+拟人，续写结尾段升华）

advancedExpressions.expression: let us write the next chapter of ... together
advancedExpressions.example: Let us, hand in hand, write the next chapter of our school's history — a chapter of unity, courage and shared dreams. （倡议书结尾号召，破折号补充+排比）

advancedExpressions.expression: each generation adds its own chapter to ...
advancedExpressions.example: Each generation adds its own chapter to the unfinished book of human progress, and the ink we choose today will be read by those who come after us.

sentenceUpgrade.original: A new part of my life started.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: As the door swung shut behind me, I felt with sudden clarity that a new chapter of my life was turning — its pages still blank, yet already trembling with the promise of everything I had yet to become. （读后续写·心理描写+比喻）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: chapter/pages 比喻延伸(仍空白的书页) + felt with sudden clarity 心理觉醒 + yet already 转折递进营造希望感

sentenceUpgrade.original: The book has several parts.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Skilfully divided into seven interlocking chapters, the novel unfolds like a series of doors, each swinging open to reveal a room more surprising than the last. （议论文·文学评论）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 过去分词短语作状语(divided...)前置 + unfolds like a series of doors 明喻 + each swinging open 独立主格递进

classPractice.question: A novel is a long story that is usually ____ (divide) into several chapters.
classPractice.note: 课文原句考点；a story 与 divide 是被动关系，is 后用过去分词构成被动语态 be divided into。

classPractice.question: 上大学为她的人生翻开了新的一章。Going to university opened ____ ____ ____ in her life.
classPractice.note: a new chapter in one's life『人生新篇章』；chapter 可数，前加 a。

classPractice.question: 选词填空（chapter / phase / step）：The first ____ towards success is to make a plan; then you move through each ____ of the project one at a time, just as a book unfolds ____ by ____.
classPractice.note: step 最小的『一步/步骤』；phase/stage 较大『阶段』；chapter by chapter『一章接一章地』为 chapter 固定搭配。

original_sentence: A hundred men may pass a field and see only dead grass; but a poet stops, looks deeper, sees truth and beauty, and writes, "Yesterday's flowers am I." One who reads it is capable of seeing the beauty that was hidden from his eyes before.
readingExamples: A hundred men may pass a field and see only dead grass; but a poet stops, looks deeper, sees truth and beauty, and writes, "Yesterday's flowers am I." One who reads it is capable of seeing the beauty that was hidden from his eyes before.
definitionEn:
(1) n. literary work in which the expression of feelings and ideas is given intensity by attention to rhythm, sound and imagery; poems as a body or genre
(2) n. the art or craft of writing poems
(3) n. a quality of beauty, grace or intense emotion, likened to that of poetry

uncommonMeanings.meaning: (如诗一般的)优美，动人之处
uncommonMeanings.example: There was a kind of poetry in the way the old fisherman cast his net — a silent grace born of a thousand dawns spent alone with the sea. （读后续写·人物描写·诗意美感）

posExamples.sentence: On rainy afternoons Grandmother would read poetry aloud by the window, and her soft, unhurried voice seemed to slow the whole world down until even the raindrops appeared to listen. （读后续写·亲情回忆）
I would like to invite all classmates to our poetry recital next Friday, where you can not only enjoy famous verses but also share the original works you have written yourselves. （应用文·活动邀请）
Some dismiss poetry as useless in a scientific age, yet it is precisely poetry that teaches us to feel deeply, to question boldly and to see the world with fresh, wondering eyes. （议论文·文学的价值）

wordForms.noun: poetry（诗歌，总称，不可数）/ poem（一首诗，可数）/ poet（诗人）
wordForms.other: 词族一图记：poet 诗人 —— writes —— poems（一首首诗，可数）—— 合称 poetry（诗歌总称，不可数）；poem (n. 一首诗)

idioms.translation: 行云流水般优美(常形容动作)
idioms.example: As the young gymnast leapt and spun across the mat, she was poetry in motion, and the entire gymnasium held its breath. （读后续写·比赛场景）

collocations.translation: 诗人……写下……【课文原句词块，poet 为 poetry 的关联词】
collocations.example: A poet stops, looks deeper, sees truth and beauty, and writes, "Yesterday's flowers am I." （课文原句）

collocations.translation: 朗读 / 背诵诗歌【poetry 不可数，无 a、无复数】
collocations.example: Every morning he would recite poetry on the quiet path to school. （校园）
She began to write poetry as a way of pouring out the feelings she could never speak aloud. （读后续写·心理）

collocations.translation: 一篇 / 一首诗作【不可数，量词用 a piece of】
collocations.example: This short piece of poetry, barely twelve lines long, has moved readers to tears for over a century. （议论文·文学评论）

collocations.translation: 现代 / 古典 / 抒情诗
collocations.example: Our teacher devoted a whole month to classical Chinese poetry, unlocking a world of beauty we had walked past for years. （应用文·课程介绍）
Those who learn to appreciate poetry often find that ordinary life begins to shimmer with hidden meaning. （议论文·审美）
For his birthday she gave him a worn collection of poetry, its margins crowded with her own pencilled notes. （读后续写·礼物）
Reading aloud is the surest way to feel the rhythm of poetry pulsing beneath the words. （应用文·读书方法）
The poet had a gift for turning ordinary sorrow into poetry that healed. （议论文·文学功能）

synonyms.translation: 一首诗（可数，与 poetry 辨析）
synonyms.example: She wrote a poem for her mother, and it became her favourite piece of all her poetry. （一首 vs 总称同句对照）
synonyms.usage: 【辨析核心】poem 可数指『一首诗』(a poem, two poems)；poetry 不可数是诗歌的『总称/门类』(much poetry, a piece of poetry)。一首首 poems 合起来就是 poetry

synonyms.example: The card was signed with a few lines of gentle verse. （读后续写·温情）
synonyms.usage: 既可指诗体(与散文 prose 相对)，也可指某一段诗行；比 poetry 更侧重'有韵律的文字形式'，poetry 更强调作为艺术门类的整体

synonyms.example: He wrote his memories in plain prose, without a single flourish. （议论文·文体）
synonyms.usage: 与 poetry 相对，指不押韵、不分行的普通书面语；辨析时常用'poetry vs prose'对比，散文重叙述、诗歌重意象与节奏

synonyms.example: The lyric captured her longing in just eight aching lines. （读后续写·情感）
synonyms.usage: 作名词指抒情短诗或歌词，聚焦个人情感；poetry 是上位统称，lyric 是其中侧重抒情、篇幅较短的一类

advancedExpressions.expression: poet 诗人（-t 表人）/ poem 一首诗 / poetry 诗歌（总称，-ry 表门类/集合）/ poetic 有诗意的（-ic 形容词后缀）。集合名词后缀 -ry 还见于：machine→machinery 机器（总称），jewel→jewellery 珠宝（总称）
advancedExpressions.example: A poet writes a poem; many such poems make up poetry, and a truly poetic soul finds poetry everywhere. （四词一句串记）

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·不可数名词 poetry 的用法
advancedExpressions.expression: poetry 不可数：不能说 a poetry / poetries；量化用 a piece of poetry / much poetry / a lot of poetry；作主语谓语用单数（Poetry is ...）。要说『一首诗』须换 a poem
advancedExpressions.example: Poetry is a kind of art; if you want to quote just one, choose a poem, not "a poetry". （用法提醒）

advancedExpressions.type: 读后续写·环境/意境渲染
advancedExpressions.expression: there was a quiet poetry in ...
advancedExpressions.example: There was a quiet poetry in the falling snow, and for one still moment all our quarrels seemed to melt into the white silence. （抽象名词 poetry 作意境词+环境定格，续写画面升华）

advancedExpressions.expression: poetry has the power to ..., so let us ...
advancedExpressions.example: Poetry has the power to bind hearts across time and distance, so let us gather this weekend to celebrate the verses that have shaped us. （倡议信，抽象力量+号召句式）

advancedExpressions.expression: in an age of ..., poetry reminds us that ...
advancedExpressions.example: In an age obsessed with speed and profit, poetry reminds us that some of life's deepest truths can be grasped only when we slow down and truly feel.

sentenceUpgrade.original: She liked reading poetry very much.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Poetry was her refuge; whenever the noise of the world grew too loud, she would slip away with a slim volume of verse and let its music wash the day's dust from her weary heart. （读后续写·心理描写+比喻）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 分号连接两个独立句 + refuge 隐喻(诗歌是避难所) + let its music wash...the dust 使役结构+洗涤意象

sentenceUpgrade.original: Poetry is useful for students.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Far from being a mere ornament of the curriculum, poetry cultivates in students an empathy and imagination that no formula or theorem could ever supply. （议论文·观点论证）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: Far from being...让步反驳开头 + cultivates in sb. an empathy...抽象名词宾语 + no...could ever supply 否定强调对比

classPractice.question: 选词填空（poem / poetry）：She loves ____, and last night she wrote a beautiful ____ about the moon.
classPractice.note: poetry 不可数，指诗歌总称作 love 的宾语；『一首诗』可数，用 a poem。

classPractice.question: A hundred men may pass a field and see only dead grass, but a ____ (poetry) stops, looks deeper, and sees truth and beauty.
classPractice.note: 课文语境；此处指『写诗的人＝诗人』，用 poet；a poet 可数，前有 a。

classPractice.question: ____ (poetry) is not useless in a scientific age; it teaches us to feel deeply and see the world with fresh eyes.
classPractice.note: poetry 作主语，不可数名词，谓语用单数 is；句首首字母大写。

translation: 舞台；阶段；步骤 vt. 上演，举办
original_sentence: Play: A story written for performance on the stage.
readingExamples: Play: A story written for performance on the stage.
definitionEn:
(1) n. a raised platform on which actors, performers or speakers stand to be seen by an audience
(2) n. a particular point, period or step in a process, development or activity
(3) n. (the stage) the profession of acting; the theatre as an art form
(4) vt. to organize and present a play, event or public activity
(5) vt. to plan and carry out an action for effect, especially publicly

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 舞台（供演员/演讲者表演之处）
uncommonMeanings.example: The actors bowed as the curtain rose on the brightly lit stage. （最常见义·舞台）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 阶段，时期，步骤（过程中的一段）
uncommonMeanings.example: At this stage of the project, we still need more feedback. （常见义·阶段）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: (the stage) 戏剧界；演艺事业
uncommonMeanings.example: She left a comfortable job for the stage, determined to become an actress. （演艺界）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 上演，举办(演出/活动)
uncommonMeanings.example: Our school will stage an English drama festival next month. （举办活动）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 组织，举办(抗议等)；策划实施
uncommonMeanings.example: The students staged a peaceful demonstration outside the town hall, holding candles that flickered bravely against the gathering dark. （读后续写·集体行动）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: (旅程的)一段路程；驿站段
uncommonMeanings.example: They completed the final stage of the mountain trek at dusk, their legs aching but their spirits soaring above the clouds. （读后续写·徒步历险）

posExamples.sentence: The moment she stepped onto the stage, the blinding lights swallowed the audience whole, and in that heart-pounding hush she suddenly forgot every word of her speech. （读后续写·登台紧张）
At this stage of the project, I would strongly suggest that we gather feedback from every class before finalizing the plan. （应用文·建议信）
Our school will stage an English drama festival next month, and every class is warmly encouraged to prepare a short play of its own. （应用文·活动通知）
Growth never happens all at once; it advances stage by stage, and those who despise the slow, humble steps rarely reach the summit at all. （议论文·成长/坚持）

wordForms.other: onstage / offstage (adv./adj. 台上 / 台下)

idioms.example: That single act of kindness set the stage for a friendship that would last a lifetime. （读后续写·情节铺垫）

idioms.translation: 成为焦点，占据核心地位
idioms.example: As the debate heated up, the question of fairness took centre stage, pushing all other concerns aside. （议论文·焦点转移）
At this stage, no one could have foreseen how dramatically the story would end. （读后续写·叙事）

collocations.translation: 在舞台上【课文原句词块】
collocations.example: Play: A story written for performance on the stage. （课文原句）
At this stage, we still need more feedback before deciding. （建议信）

collocations.translation: 上演戏剧 / 举办演出、活动【stage＝v. 上演/举办】
collocations.example: The drama club staged a moving performance that left the whole hall in tears. （应用文·活动报道）

collocations.translation: 举行抗议 / 实现逆转 / 举行罢工
collocations.example: Trailing by two goals, the team staged a stunning comeback in the last ten minutes. （读后续写·体育逆转）
Trembling, he stepped onto the stage, and the roar of applause seemed to lift him off his feet. （读后续写·登台）
The disease can be cured if it is caught at an early stage. （议论文·健康）
Our teacher supported us at every stage of the competition, from the first draft to the final performance. （应用文·感谢信）
In the final stage of the race she found a hidden reserve of strength and surged past her rival. （读后续写·比赛）
Every teenager goes through a stage of doubting who they truly are. （议论文·成长）

collocations.phrase: a stage in one's life / career
collocations.translation: 人生 / 职业生涯的一个阶段
collocations.example: Leaving home marked a decisive stage in her career as a scientist. （议论文·人生）
To share the stage with her childhood idol felt like a dream she dared not wake from. （读后续写·圆梦）

synonyms.example: The rocket separated cleanly during the second phase of the launch. （议论文·科技）
synonyms.usage: 指发展过程中一个可区分的时期，常用于科学、技术、心理描述；stage 更强调'步骤/进度'且可数、可排序，phase 更学术、常暗示自然演变

synonyms.example: The first step towards change is admitting that a problem exists. （议论文·论证）
synonyms.usage: 指过程中的一个具体动作或环节，比 stage 更小、更操作化；stage 是较大的时期，一个 stage 可包含多个 step

synonyms.example: She climbed onto the platform and cleared her throat nervously. （读后续写·演讲）
synonyms.usage: 指供人站立、展示的架高台面，中性；stage 特指供表演/演出的舞台，带表演与观众的语境色彩

advancedExpressions.type: 短语群·stage 一词多义速记
advancedExpressions.expression: on the stage 在舞台上｜at this / an early / every stage 在现/早/每个阶段｜stage a play / event / protest / comeback 上演、举办、发起、逆转｜set the stage for 为……铺垫｜take centre stage 成为焦点
advancedExpressions.example: The team staged a comeback that took centre stage in the news; at this stage, they were unstoppable. （一词多义连用）

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·stage 名动同形（一词多义）
advancedExpressions.expression: stage 作名词＝①舞台 ②阶段；作动词＝上演/举办/发起。判断词性看结构：the/a + stage（名词），stage + 宾语（动词，如 stage a play/protest）
advancedExpressions.example: On the stage (n. 舞台), the actors staged (v. 上演) a play about a hero at every stage (n. 阶段) of his life. （同词三义一句）

advancedExpressions.expression: the moment sb. stepped onto the stage, ...
advancedExpressions.example: The moment she stepped onto the stage, a hush fell over the hall, as though a thousand people had drawn a single breath. （The moment 引导时间状语从句+as though 虚拟比喻，人物出场定格）

advancedExpressions.expression: we are proud to stage ..., which aims to ...
advancedExpressions.example: We are proud to stage a charity concert this Saturday, which aims to raise funds for children in remote mountain villages. （通知/邀请，which 非限制定语从句说明目的）

advancedExpressions.expression: success unfolds stage by stage, not in a single leap
advancedExpressions.example: Success unfolds stage by stage, not in a single dazzling leap; it is the sum of countless small, unglamorous efforts patiently stacked one upon another.

sentenceUpgrade.original: She went on stage and everyone looked at her.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: As she stepped into the pool of golden light at the centre of the stage, a thousand pairs of eyes turned towards her, and the silence pressed so close that she could hear her own heartbeat thundering in her ears. （读后续写·环境+心理）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: pool of golden light 光影意象 + a thousand pairs of eyes 夸张 + silence pressed so close...thundering 通感(听见心跳)营造紧张

sentenceUpgrade.original: We will hold a drama festival.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: In order to enrich our campus life and showcase students' talents, our school has decided to stage a three-day English Drama Festival, to which every class is warmly invited to contribute. （应用文·通知）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: In order to...目的状语开头 + 双宾并列(enrich...showcase) + to which 非限定定语从句 + warmly invited 正式邀请语气

classPractice.question: 戏剧是一种为在舞台上演出而写的故事。A play is a story written for performance ____ ____ ____.
classPractice.note: 课文原句还原；on the stage『在舞台上』为固定搭配。

classPractice.question: 选词填空，判断 stage 在句中的意思（舞台／阶段／上演）：At this ____ of rehearsal, we are not yet ready to ____ the play on the big ____.
classPractice.answer: stage（阶段）; stage（上演）; stage（舞台）
classPractice.note: at this stage＝阶段(n.)；stage the play＝上演(v.)；on the stage＝舞台(n.)，一词多义三处不同。

classPractice.question: The disease can be completely cured if it is caught at an early ____ (阶段).
classPractice.note: at an early stage『在早期阶段』；stage 此处作可数名词『阶段』。

original_sentence: Autobiography: The story of the writer's own life.
readingExamples: Autobiography: The story of the writer's own life.
definitionEn:
(1) n. an account of a person's life written by that person
(2) n. the branch of literature consisting of such self-written life stories

posExamples.sentence: Late one night I found my late grandfather's unfinished autobiography in a dusty drawer, and as I turned its yellowed pages, the man I thought I had known came slowly, achingly, back to life. （读后续写·发现遗物）
I would like to recommend this inspiring autobiography to every member of our reading club, for it shows how one ordinary boy rose above poverty through sheer determination. （应用文·推荐信）
A good autobiography is valuable not because it flatters its author, but because it dares to confront failure and shame with unflinching honesty. （议论文·文学价值）

wordForms.other: biography (n. 传记)

collocations.phrase: the story of the writer's own life
collocations.translation: 作者自己人生的故事（＝自传的定义）【课文原句词块】
collocations.example: Autobiography: The story of the writer's own life. （课文原句）
At the age of eighty, she finally sat down to write her autobiography, determined to leave her grandchildren the whole unvarnished truth. （读后续写·晚年）
In his autobiography, the explorer confesses that fear had been his constant companion on every journey. （议论文·引述）
The autobiography of the deaf pianist moved the entire audience to a standing ovation. （应用文·书评）

collocations.translation: 畅销的 / 感人的自传
collocations.example: Her moving autobiography spent months at the top of the bestseller list. （应用文·图书介绍）
Reading the autobiography of a scientist she admired, the girl began to believe that her own dreams were not impossible after all. （读后续写·励志）

synonyms.example: Her memoir focused only on the ten years she had spent as a war nurse. （议论文·文体）
synonyms.usage: 同为第一人称自述，但 memoir 通常聚焦人生某一段特定时期或主题，autobiography 力求覆盖一生、更系统全面

synonyms.example: The biography of the composer was written decades after his death. （应用文·书评）
synonyms.usage: 关键区别在作者：autobiography 由本人所写(auto-=自己)，biography 由他人撰写，视角与客观性不同

synonyms.example: He told us his whole life story over one long, unforgettable evening. （读后续写·倾诉）
synonyms.usage: 口语化说法，泛指某人一生的经历，可口述可书写；autobiography 特指正式书面、由本人执笔的作品

advancedExpressions.type: 构词法·auto-（自己）+ bio（生命）+ -graphy（写/记录）
advancedExpressions.expression: auto-（自己）+ bio-（生命）+ -graphy（书写、记述）＝『自己写自己的一生』＝自传。拆开对比：biography 传记（他人写的一生）、biology 生物学（bio 生命 + -logy 学科）、photography 摄影（photo 光 + -graphy）、geography 地理（geo 地 + -graphy）
advancedExpressions.example: Break it down: auto (self) + bio (life) + graphy (writing) — an autobiography is you writing your own life. （构词拆解记忆）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·「自述生平」功能
advancedExpressions.expression: autobiography / memoir / life story（均为第一人称自述：autobiography 力求覆盖一生、正式书面；memoir 回忆录聚焦人生某一段/主题；life story 口语泛称，可口述可书写）
advancedExpressions.example: She wrote her whole autobiography, though only one memoir about her war years became famous. （辨析对照）

advancedExpressions.expression: reading his autobiography felt less like reading and more like ...
advancedExpressions.example: Reading his autobiography felt less like reading and more like sitting across from an old friend who, at last, had decided to tell me everything. （less like...more like 比较结构，把阅读体验人格化，续写感悟段）

advancedExpressions.expression: I have no hesitation in recommending this autobiography, which ...
advancedExpressions.example: I have no hesitation in recommending this autobiography, which not only recounts a remarkable life but also teaches us the true meaning of perseverance. （推荐信句式，which 引导双重功能定语从句）

advancedExpressions.expression: the worth of an autobiography lies not in ... but in ...
advancedExpressions.example: The worth of an autobiography lies not in the triumphs it parades but in the honesty with which it faces its own mistakes.

sentenceUpgrade.original: I read his autobiography and was moved.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: As I closed the final page of his autobiography, I sat motionless for a long while, my eyes brimming — for in the story of one stranger's struggles I had somehow found the courage to face my own. （读后续写·阅读感悟）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: As 时间状语引入动作定格 + eyes brimming 独立主格情感外化 + for 引导原因升华(在他人故事中找到自己的勇气)

sentenceUpgrade.original: This autobiography is worth reading.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: This autobiography deserves a place on every young reader's shelf, for it transforms one man's hardships into a source of hope that outlives its author. （应用文·推荐信）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: deserves a place on...shelf 形象化推荐 + for 引导理由 + transforms...into 转化结构 + outlives its author 抽象升华

classPractice.question: 自传是作者自己人生的故事。An autobiography is the story of the ____ ____ life.
classPractice.note: 课文定义还原；writer's own life『作者自己的人生』，own 加强『本人的』语气。

classPractice.question: 选词填空（autobiography / biography）：Since the book was written by the president himself, it is an ____, not a ____.
classPractice.note: 关键看作者：本人写＝autobiography（auto- 自己）；他人写＝biography。

classPractice.question: The novel is largely ____ (autobiography), drawing heavily on the author's own childhood.
classPractice.note: 此处作表语修饰 novel，需用形容词 autobiographical『自传体的』，而非名词。

original_sentence: Biography: The story of a person's life written by someone else.
readingExamples: Biography: The story of a person's life written by someone else.
definitionEn:
(1) n. an account of a person's life written, composed or produced by someone else
(2) n. the branch of literature that deals with the lives of individuals

posExamples.sentence: The dusty biography she pulled from the top shelf had belonged to her mother, and pressed between its pages was a faded photograph of a woman she had never had the chance to know. （读后续写·睹物思人）
I am writing to recommend a biography of Madame Curie, which vividly portrays how a determined woman overcame prejudice to change the course of science. （应用文·推荐信）
A well-written biography does more than record dates and deeds; it lets us walk, if only for a while, in the shoes of a life utterly different from our own. （议论文·阅读的意义）

wordForms.other: 对照记：biography 传记（他人写）↔ autobiography 自传（本人写，auto-＝自己）；作者：biographer 传记作者 ↔ autobiographer

collocations.phrase: the story of a person's life written by someone else
collocations.translation: 由他人所写的某人一生的故事（＝传记的定义）【课文原句词块】
collocations.example: Biography: The story of a person's life written by someone else. （课文原句）
It took the historian ten painstaking years to write a biography worthy of so great a life. （议论文·治学）
A biography of the young inventor inspired a whole generation to tinker fearlessly in their garages. （议论文·榜样）
By reading the biography of a great explorer, the timid boy discovered that even heroes had once been afraid. （读后续写·励志）

collocations.translation: 获授权的 / 未经授权的传记
collocations.example: The authorized biography drew on hundreds of the singer's private letters. （应用文·图书介绍）

collocations.translation: 详尽的 / 生动的传记
collocations.example: This vivid biography brings a distant century roaring back to life. （应用文·书评）
The subject of the biography was a nurse whose quiet courage had gone unrecognized for decades. （议论文·平凡英雄）

synonyms.example: A biography is written by someone else, while an autobiography is written by the person himself. （他写 vs 自写同句对照）
synonyms.usage: 【辨析核心】区别在作者身份：biography 由他人执笔(视角更客观)；autobiography 由本人所写(auto-=自己，视角更主观、亲历感更强)

synonyms.example: Her memoir focused only on the ten years she had spent as a war nurse. （议论文·文体）
synonyms.usage: memoir 多为本人所写、聚焦人生某一特定时期或主题；biography 由他人撰写、系统覆盖传主一生

synonyms.example: The magazine ran a short profile of the rising young pianist. （应用文·报道）
synonyms.usage: 指篇幅短小的人物介绍或新闻特写，聚焦某人的性格与成就；biography 是完整、系统、覆盖一生的著作，篇幅长得多

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·「记述生平」功能
advancedExpressions.expression: biography / profile / life story（均指某人生平：biography 他人所写、系统完整；profile 短小特写；life story 口语泛称）；辨析对立面 autobiography（本人自写）

advancedExpressions.expression: the biography did not merely tell his story; it ...

original_sentence: He is extremely good at describing the adventures of tough men who he believes "can be destroyed but not defeated".

collocations.translation: 极冷 / 极热 / 极其谨慎

synonyms.example: The rescue team worked incredibly fast, reaching the trapped hikers within the hour. （读后续写·救援）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·表'极其/非常'(可替换)
