advancedExpressions.expression: I am extremely + 情感形容词 + to / that ...
advancedExpressions.example: I am extremely delighted to learn that our proposal for a school library has finally been approved. （感谢/回信句式，extremely 加强情感真诚度）

advancedExpressions.expression: while ... may be extremely ..., we must not ...
advancedExpressions.example: While technology may be extremely convenient, we must not allow it to erode the deep human connections that give life its meaning.

sentenceUpgrade.original: It was extremely cold that night.

classPractice.question: The author is extremely good at ____ (describe) the adventures of tough men.

original_sentence: He is extremely good at describing the adventures of tough men who he believes "can be destroyed but not defeated".
readingExamples: He is extremely good at describing the adventures of tough men who he believes "can be destroyed but not defeated".
definitionEn:
(1) vt. to damage something so badly that it no longer exists, works or can be repaired
(2) vt. to defeat someone completely or ruin their reputation, happiness or chances of success
(3) vt. to kill a sick or injured animal deliberately, especially because it cannot recover

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （因病或受伤而人道地）杀死（动物）
uncommonMeanings.example: The old vet lowered his eyes as he explained that the wounded racehorse would have to be destroyed — a mercy, he called it, though the word tasted of ash in his mouth. （读后续写·动物伦理·艰难抉择）

posExamples.sentence: In a single deafening instant the flood swept through the valley, destroying everything the villagers had spent their whole lives building — homes, fields and the little stone bridge where children once laughed. （读后续写·天灾场景）
I am writing to urge our community to act now, for careless littering and unchecked pollution are gradually destroying the very river that has nourished our town for generations. （应用文·倡议书）
Some argue that competition destroys friendship, yet history shows the opposite: rivals who push one another to the limit often forge the deepest and most enduring bonds. （议论文·竞争与友谊）
One thoughtless comment can destroy a person's confidence that took years to build, which is why we should always weigh our words before we speak. （议论文·言语的力量）

wordForms.noun: destruction (n. 摧毁，破坏), destroyer (n. 驱逐舰；破坏者)
wordForms.adjective: destructive (adj. 破坏性的), destroyed, indestructible (adj. 坚不可摧的)
wordForms.other: 构词法：de-(向下/否定)+ -stroy(建造 struct) → 拆建 → 摧毁；名词 destruction、形容词 destructive、反义 indestructible 一并记；辨析 destroy(彻底毁灭)/damage(部分损坏可修)/ruin(毁掉计划名声)

collocations.phrase: destroy sth（完全彻底破坏，使不复存在/无法修复）
collocations.translation: 【课件】摧毁，毁灭；彻底破坏（to damage sth so badly that it no longer exists, works, etc.）
collocations.example: The school was completely destroyed by fire. （课件原句：学校被大火彻底烧毁）

collocations.phrase: destroy sb's hope / reputation / confidence / career / life
collocations.translation: 【课件】毁掉某人的希望／名誉／信心／事业／生活
collocations.example: You have destroyed my hopes of happiness. （课件原句：你毁掉了我幸福的希望）

collocations.translation: 【课件】对……的破坏（destruction n. 摧毁，破坏）
collocations.example: Many people are very concerned about the destruction of animal habitats. （课件原句：许多人非常担心动物栖息地遭到破坏）

collocations.translation: 【课件】……的破坏性影响（destructive adj. 毁灭性的，引起破坏的）
collocations.example: Psychologists have long warned of the destructive effect of anxiety on the mind. （课件短语：焦虑的破坏性影响）

collocations.phrase: can be destroyed but not defeated
collocations.translation: 可以被毁灭，但不能被打败【课文原句词块】
collocations.example: He describes tough men who "can be destroyed but not defeated". （课文原句节选）

collocations.translation: 摧毁某物 / 被……摧毁（destroy 及物动词）
collocations.example: The whole town was destroyed by the flood in a single night. （读后续写·灾难）
The fire destroyed the ancient library completely, reducing centuries of manuscripts to ash. （读后续写·文化损失）
If we continue to fell trees at this rate, we will destroy the environment our children must inherit. （应用文·环保）

collocations.translation: 摧毁某人的信心／希望／梦想
collocations.example: A harsh word from the coach nearly destroyed the boy's hopes. （读后续写·情感转折）
The detective arrived just in time to stop the suspect from destroying the crucial evidence. （读后续写·悬疑）

collocations.phrase: be destroyed by fire / flood / war
collocations.example: The town, once famous for its music, was destroyed by war. （读后续写·战争记忆）
A single lie can destroy the trust that took years of honesty to build. （议论文·诚信）
Arriving late and unprepared destroyed any chance she had of impressing the interviewers. （读后续写·挫折）

synonyms.translation: 【课件】损坏，损害（造成损害使之不那么有用/美观，物体仍在，常可修复）
synonyms.example: The car was only slightly damaged in the accident. （课件原句：车在事故中只受了点轻微损坏）
synonyms.usage: 【课件·辨析 destroy/damage/ruin】damage：harm to sth/sb which makes it less useful or attractive，程度可轻可重、物体仍存在、常可修复；destroy：损坏到 no longer exists/works，彻底、无法修复；ruin：damage sth so badly that it loses its value or pleasure，多指毁掉价值/乐趣（计划、心情、名声）

synonyms.translation: 【课件】毁灭，糟蹋（使失去价值或乐趣）
synonyms.example: The bad weather ruined our trip. （课件原句：坏天气毁了我们的旅行）
synonyms.usage: 【课件·辨析】ruin = damage sth so badly that it loses its value or pleasure，程度介于 damage 与 destroy 之间，多指毁掉计划、心情、名声、外观，物件常有残存；destroy 更彻底、强调化为乌有；damage 最轻、常可修复

synonyms.example: The council decided to demolish the crumbling factory and build a park. （应用文·城市改造）
synonyms.usage: 三词辨析③：demolish 多指有意拆除建筑物，或在辩论中彻底驳倒论点，含'系统性拆解'之意；destroy 泛指各类彻底破坏

synonyms.example: The scandal wrecked his once-brilliant career overnight. （议论文·声誉）
synonyms.usage: 强调造成严重、往往不可逆的破坏，常用于交通工具、事业、健康，语气偏口语；destroy 更中性正式

advancedExpressions.expression: destroy(v.) → destruction(n.) → destructive(adj.) → indestructible(adj.坚不可摧)
advancedExpressions.example: The war caused massive destruction; such destructive weapons make peace seem indestructible only in dreams. （动词/名词/形容词/反义全家桶）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·表'摧毁/破坏'(可替换)
advancedExpressions.expression: destroy = ruin / demolish / wreck / wipe out / lay waste to
advancedExpressions.example: The flood destroyed / wiped out the entire village. （wipe out 强调全部抹去，demolish 多用于建筑）

advancedExpressions.expression: destroy sth (及物必带宾语) / sth be destroyed by ...
advancedExpressions.example: Everything was destroyed by the fire, and nothing could be destroyed further. （destroy 为及物动词，常用被动 be destroyed by）

advancedExpressions.expression: in an instant, ... destroyed everything ...
advancedExpressions.example: In an instant, the avalanche roared down and destroyed everything in its path, leaving only a white silence where a village had stood. （瞬时状语 in an instant + 拟声动词 roared，营造灾难的猝然与震撼）

advancedExpressions.expression: if we do not act now, we risk destroying ...
advancedExpressions.example: If we do not act now, we risk destroying the fragile wetland that so many rare birds call home. （if条件句 + risk doing 警示后果，倡议信中制造紧迫感）

advancedExpressions.expression: far from destroying ..., ... actually strengthens ...
advancedExpressions.example: Far from destroying our creativity, technology, when used wisely, actually strengthens it by freeing us from tedious labour. （Far from doing 让步倒装 + actually 反转，先破后立地推进论点）

sentenceUpgrade.original: The fire destroyed the house.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Within minutes the greedy flames had devoured the timber walls and clawed at the roof, destroying in a single merciless night the home that three generations had built with love and sweat. （读后续写·灾难描写）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 拟人化动词(greedy flames devoured, clawed) + destroying分词状语 + 时间对比(a single night vs three generations)强化悲剧张力

translation: 击败，战胜 n. 失败，战败；击败
original_sentence: He is extremely good at describing the adventures of tough men who he believes "can be destroyed but not defeated".

definitionEn:
(1) vt. to win a victory over someone in a war, competition, game or argument
(2) vt. (of a problem or task) to prevent someone from achieving something; to be too difficult for someone
(3) n. failure to win or succeed; an occasion when someone is beaten or a plan does not work

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （问题、任务）难倒，使无法完成；使（努力）落空

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 使（目的、努力）无效，白费

collocations.example: In defeat he found a strange calm, as though the worst had already come. （读后续写·心理描写）

collocations.phrase: defeat the purpose / object of sth
collocations.translation: 使……的目的落空，事与愿违
collocations.example: Copying the answers may earn a higher mark, but it defeats the very purpose of learning. （议论文·诚信学习）

collocations.phrase: defeat sb in an election / a match
collocations.translation: 在选举／比赛中击败某人
collocations.example: She defeated her rival in the school election by a landslide. （应用文·校园选举）
He had tasted both victory and defeat, and defeat had taught him more. （议论文·人生历练）

collocations.phrase: can be destroyed but not defeated
collocations.translation: 可以被毁灭，但不能被打败【课文原句词块】
collocations.example: He describes tough men who "can be destroyed but not defeated". （课文原句节选）

synonyms.translation: 【课件】打败，战胜（口语，宾语接比赛的对手）
synonyms.example: No wonder their team beat us; they invited a professional player. （课件原句：难怪他们队赢了我们）
synonyms.usage: 【课件·辨析 defeat/beat/win】defeat 和 beat 都表'打败、战胜'，后接宾语通常是比赛的对手；beat 更口语化。win 表'获胜'，后接宾语通常是比赛/战斗的名词或赢得的奖品奖项，不能接对手。例：He defeated me in the election. / Morocco finally won the game.

synonyms.translation: 【课件】获胜，赢得（后接比赛/战斗/奖品，不接对手）
synonyms.example: Morocco finally won the game. （课件原句：摩洛哥最终赢得了比赛）
synonyms.usage: 【课件·辨析】win 后接的是比赛或战斗的名词、或赢得的奖品奖项(win the game / win a prize)，绝不接对手；想说'赢了某人'必须用 defeat/beat sb，不能 win sb

synonyms.example: It took her ten years to conquer her fear of the stage. （读后续写·战胜自我）
synonyms.usage: 四词辨析③：既可指征服敌人／土地，也可比喻'克服'困难、恐惧，含'彻底掌控'之意，气势更强；defeat 侧重竞赛/战争中战胜对手

synonyms.example: With her family's support, she overcame the illness. （读后续写·战胜逆境）
synonyms.usage: 四词辨析④：宾语多为困难、障碍、情绪(fear, difficulty)，而非具体对手，强调努力克服的过程；defeat 的宾语通常是人/对手/敌方

synonyms.example: Against every odd, the small charity triumphed over indifference. （议论文·信念的胜利）
synonyms.usage: 书面、庄重，带'历经艰难终获胜'的情感色彩，常搭配 over，适合升华段落

advancedExpressions.expression: admit/accept/concede defeat 认输 · suffer/taste defeat 尝败 · in defeat 失败中 · defeat the purpose 事与愿违
advancedExpressions.example: He refused to admit defeat even in defeat itself. （名词 defeat 高频短语群一并记）

advancedExpressions.expression: defeat(v./n.) → defeated(adj.被击败的) → undefeated(adj.不败的) → defeatism(n.失败主义)/defeatist(n.失败主义者)
advancedExpressions.example: Undefeated all season, the team refused any hint of defeatism. （形容词/名词派生一并掌握）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·表'击败/战胜'(可替换)
advancedExpressions.expression: defeat = beat / conquer / overcome / triumph over / get the better of
advancedExpressions.example: She defeated / beat her rival, then went on to conquer her own fear. （beat/defeat 接对手，overcome 接困难）

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·defeat vs win 宾语区别
advancedExpressions.expression: defeat/beat + 对手(sb) ; win + 比赛/奖(a match / a prize)
advancedExpressions.example: He defeated his opponent and thus won the final. （辨析核心：'赢了某人'用 defeat/beat sb，'赢得比赛'用 win the match）

advancedExpressions.expression: in defeat, sb. found ...
advancedExpressions.example: In defeat, she found a courage she had never known in victory — the quiet courage to try again. （介词短语前置 In defeat + 破折号补充解释，将失败重新定义为成长）

advancedExpressions.expression: a defeat is not the end but the beginning of ...
advancedExpressions.example: Please remember that this defeat is not the end but the beginning of a stronger, wiser you. （not...but... 平衡结构 + 比较级 stronger, wiser，在书信中传递鼓励）

advancedExpressions.expression: it is in defeat, not victory, that ...
advancedExpressions.example: It is in defeat, not victory, that a person's true character is forged. （It is...that 强调句 + not...插入对比，鲜明凸显论点，适合分论点句）

sentenceUpgrade.original: He lost the game but did not give up.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Though the scoreboard spelled out a bitter defeat, he lifted his chin, met his teammates' eyes, and vowed silently that this loss would be the fuel, not the end, of his journey. （读后续写·心理刻画）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: Though让步状语 + 三个连续动作(lifted, met, vowed)+ 隐喻(fuel, not the end)将失败转化为动力

sentenceUpgrade.original: We should not fear defeat.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Rather than dreading defeat as a mark of shame, we ought to embrace it as an honest teacher, for every stumble maps the very path toward eventual success. （议论文·辩证说理）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: Rather than doing 对比结构 + ought to embrace 提出主张 + for 引导原因 + 比喻(honest teacher, maps the path)使论证形象

classPractice.type: 反义词填空【课件·语境应用】
classPractice.question: Victory or ____, we shall fight to the bitter end.（填与划线词 victory 意义相反的词）
classPractice.note: 课件原题；victory 的反义词 defeat（失败）

classPractice.type: 用词填空【课件·语境应用】
classPractice.question: I knew we were going to win, but to my disappointment we ____ (defeat).
classPractice.note: 课件原题；we 是被击败的一方 → 被动 be defeated；此处用过去式 were defeated

classPractice.type: 用词填空【课件·语境应用】
classPractice.question: Stevenson gives an account of the advanced techniques that criminals use ____ (defeat) computer-based locking systems for cars.
classPractice.note: 课件原题；use ... techniques to do sth 表目的，用不定式 to defeat（此处 defeat=破解/使…失效）

classPractice.question: 从 defeat / beat / win 中选词：He ____ me in the election, and later our team ____ the game.
classPractice.answer: defeated / beat（第一空）; won（第二空）
classPractice.note: 课件辨析原句；击败对手用 defeat/beat sb，赢得比赛用 win the game

classPractice.question: 从 defeat / win 中选词：Our team ____ the final and ____ its strongest opponent.
classPractice.note: win 接'比赛'the final；defeat 接'对手'opponent——本单元核心辨析

classPractice.question: Even trapped in the storm, the old fisherman refused to ____ ____.
classPractice.note: admit/accept/concede defeat 认输；defeat 此处为名词

classPractice.question: A hero can be destroyed but never ____ (defeat).
classPractice.note: 课文原句结构；be defeated 被动，与 destroyed 并列

original_sentence: After coming in empty-handed for eighty-four days, Santiago attempts to catch a huge fish.
readingExamples: After coming in empty-handed for eighty-four days, Santiago attempts to catch a huge fish.
definitionEn:
(1) vt. to try to do something, especially something difficult
(2) n. an act of trying to do something, especially something difficult or something you may fail at
(3) n. an effort to achieve or gain something, or to attack or beat a record
(4) vt. to try to climb, reach or complete something challenging

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （对某人生命的）行凶，谋害图谋（an attempt on sb's life）
uncommonMeanings.example: Rumours spread through the palace that an attempt on the king's life had been foiled at the very last moment by a loyal servant. （读后续写·宫廷悬疑·惊险一刻）

posExamples.sentence: After coming in empty-handed for eighty-four days, the weathered old man attempted, against all reason and advice, to sail beyond the familiar shallows into waters where no fisherman dared to go. （读后续写·硬汉出海）
I am writing to share my heartfelt thanks for the countless attempts you made to help me overcome my fear of public speaking, none of which I will ever forget. （应用文·感谢信）
Every worthwhile achievement is built upon a mountain of failed attempts, and it is precisely the courage to try again that separates the successful from the ordinary. （议论文·坚持与成功）
Trembling yet determined, the little girl attempted to walk across the narrow log for the first time, her arms spread wide like the wings of a hesitant bird. （读后续写·初次尝试）

idioms.idiom: make an attempt (to do / at doing sth)
idioms.example: Summoning every ounce of courage, she made a final attempt to reach the summit before the storm closed in. （读后续写·登顶时刻）
To everyone's astonishment, he passed the notoriously difficult exam at the first attempt. （读后续写·意外惊喜）

idioms.idiom: in an attempt to do sth
idioms.example: He plunged into the icy river in a desperate attempt to save the drowning child. （读后续写·舍身救人）

collocations.phrase: attempt sth = attempt to do sth
collocations.translation: 【课件】试图做某事，努力尝试做某事（vt. to try to do sth, especially sth difficult）
collocations.example: The prisoners attempted an escape, but failed. (= attempted to escape) （课件原句：囚犯们企图逃跑，但失败了）
Weather conditions prevented them from attempting the jump. （课件原句：天气状况使他们无法尝试跳伞）

collocations.phrase: make an attempt to do sth / at (doing) sth
collocations.translation: 【课件】尝试做某事（attempt n. an act of trying to do sth）
collocations.example: They made no attempt to escape. （课件原句：他们没有企图逃跑）

collocations.phrase: in an attempt to do sth
collocations.example: Two factories were closed in an attempt to cut costs. （课件原句：为削减费用，关闭了两家工厂）
To everyone's astonishment, he passed the exam at his first attempt. （课件短语：at one's first attempt）

collocations.phrase: make no attempt to do sth
collocations.example: They made no attempt to escape. （课件原句：他们没有企图逃跑）

collocations.translation: 尝试／试图做某事【课文原句词块：attempts to catch a huge fish】
collocations.example: Santiago attempts to catch a huge fish. （课文原句节选）

collocations.phrase: make an attempt to do sth
collocations.example: Despite her broken leg, she made a brave attempt to finish the marathon. （读后续写·永不放弃）

collocations.phrase: in an attempt to do sth
collocations.example: The whole village worked through the night in an attempt to hold back the flood. （读后续写·众志成城）
To everyone's astonishment, he passed the difficult exam at the first attempt. （读后续写·意外惊喜）

collocations.translation: 大胆的／勇敢的／绝望的尝试
collocations.example: In a desperate attempt to warn the ship, the keeper set fire to his own coat. （读后续写·危急关头）
After several vain attempts to start a conversation, he fell into an awkward silence. （读后续写·社交尴尬）
Her successful attempt at the record inspired a generation of young swimmers. （议论文·榜样力量）
Great inventors are bold enough to attempt the impossible and patient enough to fail. （议论文·创新精神）

collocations.phrase: make no attempt to do sth
collocations.example: He made no attempt to hide his disappointment, and his silence spoke volumes. （读后续写·情绪外露）

collocations.phrase: an attempt on the record / summit
collocations.example: Their attempt on the summit was postponed when the weather turned. （读后续写·登山）

synonyms.translation: 【课件】尝试，试图（通俗用语，最普通、最口语）
synonyms.example: He tried again and again to light the damp match, his fingers shaking. （读后续写·求生）
synonyms.usage: 【课件·辨析 attempt/try/manage】attempt：正式用语，常指一次的而非持续的尝试，往往暗示尝试达不到目的、含'冒险'之意；try：通俗用语，指为成功做某事而付出努力，后接不定式 try to do 表'试图做'、后接 -ing 表'试着做'；manage：成功地做成某事(尤指困难的事)，强调结果。句法上 try to do 与 attempt to do 通用，但 attempt 另可作名词(make an attempt)

synonyms.translation: 【课件】（成功地）做成，设法做到（强调结果，尤指困难的事）
synonyms.example: After hours of struggle he finally managed to open the rusted lock. （课件辨析：manage 强调成功做成）
synonyms.usage: 【课件·辨析】manage 强调'成功地做成某事'的结果，manage to do = 设法做到；而 attempt 只表'尝试、试图'、往往暗示未必成功；try 居中，表付出努力

synonyms.example: We will endeavour to make every visitor feel at home during the festival. （应用文·活动承诺）
synonyms.usage: 极正式，多用于书面或郑重场合，强调持续而认真的努力，比 attempt 更庄重

synonyms.example: She strove tirelessly to master the piece before the concert. （读后续写·追求卓越）
synonyms.usage: 强调为达目标而'努力奋斗、拼搏'的持续过程，常搭配 strive to do / for，含奋进色彩

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·并列句省略（承前省去相同成分）
advancedExpressions.expression: 并列分句中，后一分句常省去与前一分句相同的主语、谓语或其他成分；分词短语可作伴随状语。课文：The fish was coming in on his circle now calm and beautiful looking and only his great tail (was) moving.
advancedExpressions.example: The fish was coming in now, calm and beautiful looking, and only its great tail (was) moving. （课件原句：calm and beautiful looking 为分词/形容词短语作伴随状语；and only its great tail (was) moving 为并列句省略 was；对照：He fell off the bike, but (he) was unhurt. / My sister likes painting and I (like) music.）

advancedExpressions.expression: make an attempt to do 尝试 · at the first attempt 第一次就 · in an attempt to do 为了 · make no attempt to do 根本不试
advancedExpressions.example: At the first attempt he made no attempt to hide his joy. （attempt 高频短语群一并记）

advancedExpressions.expression: attempt(v./n.) → attempted(adj. 未遂的：an attempted robbery 抢劫未遂)
advancedExpressions.example: Police described it as an attempted theft. （attempted 作定语表'未遂的'）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·表'尝试/努力'(可替换)
advancedExpressions.expression: attempt to do = try to do / endeavour to do / strive to do / make an effort to do / seek to do
advancedExpressions.example: She attempted / endeavoured / strove to reach the summit. （均可替换，attempt/try 中性，endeavour/strive 更庄重）

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·attempt 的双重词性
advancedExpressions.expression: attempt to do sth (动词) = make an attempt to do sth / at doing sth (名词)
advancedExpressions.example: He attempted to escape. = He made an attempt to escape / at escaping. （动词、名词两种句式互换）

advancedExpressions.expression: in a final / desperate attempt to ..., sb. ...
advancedExpressions.example: In a final attempt to save the sinking boat, he flung the last of the cargo overboard, his heart pounding like a drum. （in an attempt to 目的状语前置 + 具体动作 flung + 明喻 like a drum，渲染紧张）

advancedExpressions.expression: your every attempt to ... will always be remembered
advancedExpressions.example: Your every attempt to lift my spirits during that dark time will always be remembered with the deepest gratitude. （your every attempt 主语强调 + will always be remembered 承诺式结尾，用于感谢信收束）

advancedExpressions.expression: it is not the success but the attempt itself that ...
advancedExpressions.example: It is not the success but the attempt itself that reveals the measure of a person's courage. （It is...that 强调句 + not...but... 对比 + attempt itself 反身强调，突出'尝试的价值'）

sentenceUpgrade.original: He tried to catch the fish.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Summoning the last reserves of his ageing strength, the old man attempted to haul in the great fish, every muscle screaming, every heartbeat a silent prayer to the indifferent sea. （读后续写·搏斗场面）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: Summoning分词状语开头 + attempted正式动词 + 独立主格(every muscle screaming, every heartbeat a prayer)排比 + 拟人(indifferent sea)

sentenceUpgrade.original: We should keep trying even if we fail.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: We ought to regard each failed attempt not as a defeat but as a rehearsal for triumph, for the road to success is paved, stone by stone, with the courage to try once more. （议论文·坚持）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: ought to 表主张 + not as...but as... 重新定义 + for 引导原因 + 隐喻(paved stone by stone)使抽象道理具象

classPractice.type: 单句语法填空【课件·语境应用】
classPractice.question: It was one of his rare ____ (attempt) at humour.（那是他极不常见的想要表现幽默的一次）
classPractice.note: 课件原题；one of + 复数名词，attempt 用复数 attempts；attempt at (doing) sth

classPractice.type: 完成句子【课件·语境应用】
classPractice.question: On the road to success, he failed ____ ____ ____ ____ (第一次尝试) but he didn't give up.
classPractice.note: 课件原题；at one's/the first attempt 第一次尝试就……

classPractice.type: 一空多译【课件·语境应用】
classPractice.question: 我试图让她相信他是诚实的，但徒劳无果。I've ____ her of his honesty, but in vain.（用 attempt 的动词和名词两种写法）
classPractice.answer: attempted to convince / made an attempt to convince
classPractice.note: 课件原题；attempt to do = make an attempt to do；convince sb of sth

classPractice.question: After eighty-four empty days, Santiago attempts ____ (catch) a huge fish.
classPractice.note: 课文原句考点；attempt to do sth 试图做某事

classPractice.question: 令人惊讶的是，他第一次尝试就通过了考试。To our surprise, he passed the exam ____ ____ ____ ____.
classPractice.note: at the first attempt 第一次尝试就；本批核心短语

classPractice.question: He tried to save the drowning child. → He ____ ____ ____ ____ save the drowning child.
classPractice.note: make an attempt to do = try to do；attempt 作名词的句式转换

original_sentence: Then he straightened himself and began another circle.
readingExamples: Then he straightened himself and began another circle.
definitionEn:
(1) vt. & vi. to make something straight or to become straight
(2) vt. to make something tidy or put it in its correct position
(3) vt. to stand or sit up straight after bending; to make a bent part of your body straight (straighten up / straighten out)
(4) vt. to resolve a confused or difficult situation (straighten out)

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【课件】straight adj. 直的；坦率的 / straight adv. 挺直地；直接；坦率地
uncommonMeanings.example: long straight hair 直发；I don't think you are being straight with me.（坦率的）/ Can you stretch your arms out straighter?（挺直地）；Come straight home after school.（直接）；I told him straight that I didn't like him.（坦率地）（课件原句组）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 理清，解决（混乱、纠纷、误会）—— straighten out
uncommonMeanings.example: It took a long, honest conversation late into the night to straighten out the misunderstanding that had quietly poisoned their friendship for months. （读后续写·冰释前嫌·和解）

posExamples.sentence: Exhausted but unwilling to yield, the old fisherman straightened himself against the mast, drew a deep breath, and began yet another slow, aching circle around the boat. （读后续写·硬汉搏斗）
Before the guests arrive, could you please help me straighten the chairs and tidy the reading corner so that our charity book fair looks welcoming? （应用文·活动准备）
When we straighten our posture and lift our heads, we not only look more confident but often begin to feel more confident too — body and mind, it seems, move as one. （议论文·身心相连）
She knelt by the frightened child, gently straightened his crumpled collar, and whispered that everything was going to be all right. （读后续写·温情细节）

wordForms.adjective: straight (adj. 直的，笔直的), straightforward (adj. 直截了当的)
wordForms.adverb: straight (adv. 径直地), straightforwardly (adv. 坦率地)
wordForms.other: 构词法：straight(adj./adv.直) + -en(动词后缀'使变……') → straighten(使变直)。同类 -en 动词：wide→widen, short→shorten, deep→deepen, strength→strengthen。词族：straight / straighten / straightforward 一并记

idioms.example: Let us sit down calmly and straighten this out before small resentments grow into unbridgeable gulfs. （读后续写·化解矛盾）
The moment the headmaster entered, the whole class instinctively straightened up in their seats. （读后续写·课堂场景）

collocations.translation: 【课件】挺起肩膀／背（straighten sth v. 使变直，弄正）
collocations.example: He straightened his shoulders and walked toward the crowd. （课件搭配：straighten one's shoulders/back）
She straightened her tie, took a breath, and pushed open the door. （课件搭配：straighten one's tie/skirt）
Then he straightened himself and began another circle. （课文原句：straighten oneself 挺直身子）

collocations.translation: 【课件】清理，整顿；理清（问题、混乱）
collocations.example: Let's try to straighten out this confusion. （课件原句：咱们努力收拾这个混乱的局面吧）
A patient talk with his mentor finally straightened the troubled boy out. （课件搭配：straighten sb out）

collocations.translation: 挺直身子【课文原句词块：he straightened himself】
collocations.example: Then he straightened himself and began another circle. （课文原句）
The moment the headmaster entered, the class straightened up in their seats. （读后续写·课堂）
A single frank talk was enough to straighten out the misunderstanding. （读后续写·和解）
Aching all over, he straightened his back, refusing to let the mountain see him bend. （读后续写·不屈意志）
He straightened his tie, took a breath, and pushed open the interview door. （读后续写·紧张时刻）
He paused to straighten the crooked photo on the wall. （读后续写·睹物思人）
She spent an hour straightening her hair before the graduation ceremony. （读后续写·毕业典礼）

collocations.translation: 把（人与人之间的）事情理顺
collocations.example: The wise old teacher helped straighten things out between the two classmates. （读后续写·师者智慧）

synonyms.example: She tidied her desk before the exam, believing a clear space made for a clear mind. （读后续写·细节）
synonyms.usage: 指把东西收拾整齐、有条理，宾语多为房间、桌子；straighten 更强调'弄直、摆正'的动作

synonyms.example: The two nations finally resolved their long dispute through patient dialogue. （议论文·和平）
synonyms.usage: 正式，指彻底解决问题或争端，比 straighten out 更书面、更庄重

synonyms.example: Give me a moment to sort out these papers before the meeting begins. （应用文·工作场景）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·表'整理/理清'(可替换)
advancedExpressions.expression: straighten (out) = tidy / sort out / resolve / clear up / put ... in order

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·straighten 及物/不及物两用

advancedExpressions.expression: sb. straightened up, ... and ...

advancedExpressions.expression: would you kindly help straighten ...

advancedExpressions.expression: just as we straighten a bent branch, we can straighten ...

translation: 用劲，使力；压力，拉力；重负
original_sentence: He felt faint again now but he held on the great fish all the strain that he could.
readingExamples: He felt faint again now but he held on the great fish all the strain that he could.
definitionEn:
(1) n. a great effort of the body or mind; the force or pressure produced by pulling, stretching or bearing weight
(2) n. a worried and nervous feeling caused by pressure, worry or having too much to do; something that makes you feel this way
(3) n. an injury to a part of your body caused by using it too much or twisting it
(4) vt. & vi. to make a great effort to do something using all your strength; to injure a muscle by stretching it too far

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ①拉力，张力；用劲，使力（物理层面，课文义：the strain that he could 竭尽全力）
uncommonMeanings.example: He held on to the great fish with all the strain that he could. （课文原句义：使出所有力气）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ②压力，重负（精神/身心不堪重负：under strain 处于压力下）
uncommonMeanings.example: The constant strain of revision began to take a heavy toll on her health. （议论文·压力）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ③（肌肉的）拉伤，扭伤（a muscle strain 肌肉拉伤；eye strain 眼疲劳）
uncommonMeanings.example: The runner pulled up, grimacing at the sharp muscle strain in his calf. （读后续写·受伤）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ④拉紧，绷紧；竭力（strain to hear/see 竭力去听/看）；拉伤（肌肉）
uncommonMeanings.example: She strained her eyes against the fog, straining to catch a glimpse of the ship. （读后续写·翘首期盼）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ⑤过滤，滤去（strain the tea / strain off the water）
uncommonMeanings.example: She strained the soup carefully to remove every fishbone before feeding the child. （读后续写·生活细节）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ⑥（动植物、细菌、病毒的）品种，株系
uncommonMeanings.example: The scientists discovered a rare strain of wild rice, hardy enough to survive the salty coastal soil. （读后续写·科研发现）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: ⑦（性格、家族的）特质，倾向；（音乐的）曲调，旋律
uncommonMeanings.example: There ran through the whole family a stubborn strain of pride that no hardship had ever broken. （读后续写·家族性格）

posExamples.sentence: He felt faint again now, yet he held on to the great fish with all the strain his trembling arms could still bear, unwilling to surrender an inch of the line. （读后续写·极限搏斗）
I am writing to suggest that our school arrange regular breaks during exam week, for the constant strain of revision is taking a heavy toll on students' health. （应用文·建议信）
Modern life places enormous strain on young people, and unless we learn to manage this pressure wisely, our creativity and well-being will inevitably suffer. （议论文·压力与健康）
She strained her eyes against the fog, straining to catch even the faintest glimpse of the ship that was supposed to carry her father home. （读后续写·翘首期盼）

idioms.idiom: put a strain on sth / sb
idioms.example: The endless overtime put a heavy strain on his marriage, until one evening he finally chose family over work. （读后续写·抉择）

idioms.translation: 处于压力之下，承受重负
idioms.example: Under such strain, even the calmest of men might have broken, yet the old captain never once raised his voice. （读后续写·临危不乱）

idioms.translation: 显出疲惫／不堪重负的迹象
idioms.example: By midnight the young doctor was showing clear signs of strain, but she kept working, one patient after another. （读后续写·坚守岗位）

collocations.translation: 【课件】处于（巨大）压力之下（strain n. 压力，重负 = pressure on sb or the problems, worry or anxiety this produces）
collocations.example: Under considerable strain, even the calmest of men might have broken. （课件搭配：under (great) strain）

collocations.phrase: put a strain on sth / sb
collocations.example: The endless overtime put a heavy strain on his family life. （课件搭配：put a strain on sth/sb）
You will learn to cope with the stresses and strains of public life. （课件原句：应对公众生活的种种压力）

collocations.phrase: place too much strain on ...（物理拉力）
collocations.translation: 【课件】给……施加过大的拉力／压力（strain n. physical pressure 物理压力，拉力）
collocations.example: You should try not to place too much strain on muscles and joints. （课件原句：不要给肌肉和关节施加过大压力）

collocations.phrase: all the strain that sb could
collocations.translation: 某人所能使出的全部力气【课文原句词块】
collocations.example: He held on the great fish all the strain that he could. （课文原句）
Under great strain the rope creaked and groaned, yet somehow it held. （读后续写·危急）

collocations.phrase: put / place a strain on sth / sb
collocations.example: The sudden influx of tourists placed an unexpected strain on the town's resources. （议论文·旅游影响）

collocations.translation: 精神／情感／身体上的压力
collocations.example: Months of caring for her sick mother had worn her thin by emotional strain. （读后续写·亲情付出）
A short walk each evening did wonders to ease the strain of a hectic day. （应用文·减压建议）

collocations.phrase: a muscle strain / strain a muscle
collocations.example: He strained a muscle in his back while lifting the heavy box. （读后续写·受伤）
Staring at screens for hours causes serious eye strain and headaches. （应用文·健康建议）
The old bridge took the strain of the heavy lorry, though every plank shuddered. （读后续写·紧张时刻）

collocations.translation: 使出全身力气；竭尽全力
collocations.example: He strained every muscle to lift the fallen beam off the trapped boy. （读后续写·舍身相救）
In the darkness she strained to hear the faint cry of her lost dog. （读后续写·寻找）

synonyms.example: The pressure of the final examination weighed on every student in the room. （议论文·考试压力）
synonyms.usage: 最常用的'压力'一词，泛指外界或内心的压力；strain 更强调压力造成的紧张、劳损与不堪重负的状态

synonyms.example: Learning to breathe deeply can help you cope with the stress of a busy life. （应用文·健康建议）
synonyms.usage: 侧重心理层面的紧张与焦虑，医学、心理语境常用；strain 兼指身体与心理，且可指物理拉力

synonyms.example: A thick tension hung in the courtroom as the jury filed slowly back in. （读后续写·气氛渲染）
synonyms.usage: 既指肌肉、绳索的物理张力，也指气氛或人际关系的紧张；strain 更强调因用力或负重产生的实际压力

synonyms.example: He carried the burden of the family's debt on his young shoulders without a word of complaint. （读后续写·担当）
synonyms.usage: 多指沉重的责任或负担(可具体可抽象)，强调'背负'之重；strain 更强调因负担产生的紧绷与劳损

advancedExpressions.expression: under strain 压力下 · put a strain on 给…造成负担 · strain a muscle 拉伤肌肉 · eye strain 眼疲劳 · strain to do 竭力做
advancedExpressions.example: Under such strain he strained every nerve, risking a muscle strain, just to strain to hear her voice. （名词/动词、抽象/物理各义一并掌握）

advancedExpressions.expression: strain(n./v.) → strained(adj. 紧张的，勉强的：a strained smile 勉强的微笑 / strained relations 紧张关系)
advancedExpressions.example: A strained silence fell as their once-warm relations grew strained. （strained 作形容词表'紧张的、勉强的'）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·表'压力/重负'(可替换)
advancedExpressions.expression: strain = pressure / stress / tension / burden
advancedExpressions.example: The strain / pressure / stress of exams weighed on everyone. （strain 兼指身心与物理拉力，stress 偏心理，tension 偏张力/关系）

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·strain 名词/动词一词多类
advancedExpressions.expression: n. 压力/拉力/拉伤 · v. 拉紧/竭力/拉伤/过滤
advancedExpressions.example: The strain (n.) was too much; she strained (v.) to hold on, then strained (v.) the water off the rice. （同一词兼作名词与动词多义）

advancedExpressions.expression: with all the strain (that) sb. could ...
advancedExpressions.example: With all the strain his aching body could summon, he clung to the line, knowing that to let go was to lose everything. （with all the strain 状语 + could summon 定语 + knowing分词点明后果，渲染坚持的代价）

advancedExpressions.expression: to ease the strain of ..., I would suggest that ...
advancedExpressions.example: To ease the strain of endless revision, I would suggest that we set aside one hour each day purely for rest and exercise. （To ease...不定式目的状语 + I would suggest that 从句用虚拟，符合建议信委婉口吻）

advancedExpressions.expression: the strain of ... , if left unaddressed, will ...
advancedExpressions.example: The strain of relentless competition, if left unaddressed, will erode the very passion that once drove young people to learn. （The strain of 主语 + if left unaddressed 让步插入 + will erode 预示后果，构建严密因果链）

sentenceUpgrade.original: He held the fish with all his strength.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Though faintness washed over him in cold, dizzying waves, he held on to the great fish with all the strain his failing body could still muster, his knuckles white, his will unbroken. （读后续写·硬汉搏斗）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: Though让步状语 + 比喻(faintness washed over him in waves) + with all the strain...could muster 强调竭力 + 独立主格(his knuckles white, his will unbroken)对比收束

sentenceUpgrade.original: Students today feel a lot of pressure.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The relentless strain that today's students shoulder — from soaring expectations, endless assignments and the ceaseless comparison with others — is quietly draining the joy that learning ought to bring. （议论文·教育反思）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 破折号插入三项来源(soaring expectations...comparison)排比 + relentless/ceaseless 形容词强化 + 拟人(draining the joy)使论述有感染力

classPractice.note: 课文原句义；strain 此处作名词'用劲、力气'

classPractice.question: 从 strain / pressure 中选词：He ____ a muscle in his leg while training too hard.

classPractice.note: under strain 处于压力下；eye strain 眼疲劳——strain 一词多义

original_sentence: But when he put all of his effort on, starting it well out before the fish came alongside and pulling with all his strength, the fish pulled part way over and then righted himself and swam away.
readingExamples: But when he put all of his effort on, starting it well out before the fish came alongside and pulling with all his strength, the fish pulled part way over and then righted himself and swam away.
definitionEn:
(1) prep. next to or at the side of something or someone
(2) prep. together with someone, especially in working or fighting; in comparison with
(3) adv. along the side of something; close to the side of a ship, quay or other object
(4) prep. at the same time as something else; in addition to

uncommonMeanings.partOfSpeech: adv.（近义 right / part way，课文同段）
uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【课件】right v. 使……回正常位置，把……扶正（put sth, esp. a boat, back into its correct upright position）；part way adv. 半途，部分地（part of the way or partly）
uncommonMeanings.example: At last the plane righted itself and everyone was safe and sound.（飞机终于恢复平稳）/ They were part way through the meeting when she arrived.（她到达时会议已进行了一段时间）（课件原句：与 alongside 同段的 right / part way）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 与……并肩（工作、战斗、共事）
uncommonMeanings.example: For thirty long years she had worked alongside these same nurses, and in that shared exhaustion a bond stronger than any friendship had quietly taken root. （读后续写·并肩同行·患难情谊）

posExamples.sentence: He heaved on the line with all his remaining strength, and at last the great fish came alongside, its silver flank gleaming like a suit of armour in the dying light. （读后续写·搏斗高潮）
I am writing to invite you to volunteer alongside us this weekend, planting trees on the barren hillside and giving our community a greener, brighter future. （应用文·招募信）
True progress is achieved when ambition marches alongside responsibility, for talent without integrity is a ship without a rudder. （议论文·才与德）
The old photograph showed my grandfather standing proudly alongside his classmates, all of them young, hopeful and utterly unaware of the storms that lay ahead. （读后续写·睹物追忆）

collocations.translation: 【课件】（车、船等）在旁边靠拢停下（adv. next to or at the side of 在旁边）
collocations.example: A car pulled up alongside. （课件原句：一辆车在旁边靠拢停下）

collocations.translation: 【课件】与某人一起／并肩工作（adv. together with or along with 与……一起）
collocations.example: Most of the staff refused to work alongside the irresponsible ones. （课件原句：多数员工拒绝与不负责任的人共事）

collocations.translation: （船只/物体）靠拢到旁边来【课文原句词块：before the fish came alongside】
collocations.example: He pulled hard before the fish came alongside the boat. （课文原句节选）
To have fought alongside such brave companions was the proudest honour of his life. （读后续写·战友情）

collocations.translation: 与某人站在一起，支持某人
collocations.example: When the whole village turned against her, only her teacher dared to stand alongside her. （读后续写·雪中送炭）
For the last painful mile, her best friend ran alongside her, matching every step. （读后续写·陪伴）
The old and new buildings stood alongside each other, a quiet dialogue between past and present. （读后续写·古今对照）
Hard work, alongside a little luck, plays a decisive role in most success stories. （议论文·成功要素）
Learning alongside classmates from different countries broadened my view of the world. （应用文·交流感悟）

synonyms.example: She sat quietly beside the hospital bed all night. （读后续写·守护）
synonyms.usage: 四词辨析①：beside 单纯表'在……旁边'的空间位置；alongside 除位置外更强调'并肩、协同'(work alongside sb)，且可用于船只靠拢及'与此同时/相比'之意

synonyms.example: The little café sat next to the old bookshop. （读后续写·环境描写）
synonyms.usage: 四词辨析②：next to 口语常用，指紧挨着的位置；alongside 更书面，可延伸出'协同、相比'等抽象含义

synonyms.example: Together with her teammates, she poured her heart into the final performance. （读后续写·团队）
synonyms.usage: 四词辨析③：强调'连同、一起'，可放句首作插入语；alongside 更简洁，且带并排、并肩的画面感

synonyms.example: The reforms were carried out in parallel with a nationwide education campaign. （议论文·改革）
synonyms.usage: 四词辨析④：正式书面，强调两件事'并行、同步'进行；alongside 用法更灵活，既可具体位置也可抽象并行

advancedExpressions.expression: work/fight alongside sb 与…共事/并肩作战 · stand alongside sb 支持某人 · come alongside (船)靠拢 · alongside each other 并排
advancedExpressions.example: They fought alongside each other and, in peace, worked alongside old rivals. （介词/副词两种用法一并掌握）

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·alongside 介词/副词两用
advancedExpressions.expression: prep. alongside sb/sth (后接宾语) / adv. come alongside (单独作状语，后不接宾语)

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·表'与…一起/并肩'(可替换)
advancedExpressions.expression: work alongside sb = work with / work side by side with / work hand in hand with / work together with sb
advancedExpressions.example: She worked alongside / side by side with the volunteers all summer. （均表'并肩共事'，alongside 更简洁书面）

advancedExpressions.expression: to stand / fight / work alongside sb was ...

advancedExpressions.expression: we warmly invite you to join us and work alongside ...

advancedExpressions.expression: ..., alongside ..., forms the foundation of ...

sentenceUpgrade.original: The fish came near the boat.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Inch by hard-won inch the great fish drew closer, until at last it came alongside the battered skiff, its vast silver body rolling in the swell like a fallen god surrendering to the sea. （读后续写·搏斗高潮）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: Inch by inch 副词短语控制节奏 + until at last 时间推进 + came alongside 精准动词 + 明喻(like a fallen god)赋予史诗感

sentenceUpgrade.original: We should work with others to succeed.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Real achievement is rarely a solitary triumph; more often it is won by those humble enough to labour alongside others, pooling their strengths until the impossible slowly bends into the possible. （议论文·合作）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 分号连接两个对比分句 + labour alongside others 点题 + pooling分词状语 + 拟人(the impossible bends into the possible)增强说服力

classPractice.question: He pulled hard just before the great fish came ____, then it righted itself and swam away.
classPractice.note: 课文原句考点；come alongside （船/物）靠拢到旁边，此处 alongside 作副词

classPractice.question: For thirty years she had worked ____ the same nurses, and a deep bond had grown.
classPractice.note: work alongside sb 与某人并肩共事；此处 alongside 作介词接宾语

classPractice.question: 从 beside / alongside 中选词：Talent, ____ integrity, forms the foundation of true success.
classPractice.note: 此处表抽象'连同、并列'，用 alongside；beside 仅表具体空间位置

original_sentence: That way nothing is accomplished, he thought.
readingExamples: That way nothing is accomplished, he thought.
definitionEn:
(1) vt. to succeed in doing something, especially after trying hard or over a period of time
(2) vt. to finish a task, plan, or piece of work completely and successfully
(3) vt. (formal) to reach a goal or bring about a desired result

posExamples.sentence: Only when the last brick was laid did the old carpenter step back, his weathered face softening into a smile, for he had accomplished in a single winter what others had failed to finish in years. （读后续写·工匠精神·坚持）
I am writing to share what our volunteer team has accomplished over the past month, hoping our small efforts may inspire more classmates to join this meaningful cause. （应用文·倡议信）
History repeatedly proves that nothing worthwhile is ever accomplished without sacrifice; behind every triumph lies a story of quiet, relentless effort. （议论文·奋斗主题）
Trembling with exhaustion yet lit with pride, she realised she had accomplished the impossible: reaching the summit before dawn broke over the frozen ridge. （读后续写·登山·成就时刻）

collocations.translation: 【课件】完成 / 实现我们的目标（=achieve）
collocations.example: If we'd all work together, I think we could accomplish our goal. （课件原句）
A rather difficult task had been successfully accomplished. （课件原句·一项相当困难的任务被成功完成）

collocations.translation: 【课件】一项成就，一份成绩（accomplishment cn./un.）
collocations.example: For a novelist, that's quite an accomplishment. （课件原句·对小说家而言那是相当了不起的成就）

collocations.translation: 【课件】使命的完成（accomplishment 表'完成'时接 of）
collocations.example: His function is vital to the accomplishment of the mission. （课件原句·他的作用对完成使命至关重要）

collocations.phrase: the accomplishments of the past year
collocations.translation: 【课件】过去一年的成果（复数表具体成绩）
collocations.example: By any standards, the accomplishments of the past year are extraordinary. （课件原句·不管以哪种标准过去一年都成果斐然）

collocations.translation: 一事无成，什么也没做成（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: That way nothing is accomplished, he thought. （课文原句）
With everyone pulling together, we accomplished a task that had once seemed far beyond our reach. （读后续写·团队合作）
The rescue team accomplished their mission just as the storm closed in, carrying the injured hiker to safety. （读后续写·救援）
Endless complaining accomplishes nothing; real change begins the moment we take the first small step. （议论文·行动主题）
Despite her humble beginnings, she accomplished a great deal, proving that determination can outshine privilege. （议论文·励志）
We accomplished the fundraising target by combining an online campaign with a lively charity bazaar. （应用文·活动总结）

collocations.translation: 技艺娴熟的钢琴家 / 演说家 / 作家
collocations.example: Years of patient practice had turned the shy village boy into an accomplished pianist admired across the province. （读后续写·成长）
Crossing the finish line filled the young runners with a sense of accomplishment they would treasure for life. （读后续写·比赛）
Innovators are those who dare to accomplish what others dismiss as impossible. （议论文·创新）

synonyms.example: If we'd all work together, I think we could accomplish / achieve our goal. （课件明确 accomplish = achieve,均可接 goal）
synonyms.usage: 【课件】课件直接给出 accomplish = achieve(achieve or complete successfully);最通用,侧重通过努力'达到'目标或成绩,后接目标/水平/success/aim;accomplish 更强调'把一件具体的事彻底做完做成'

synonyms.example: He finished his homework before dinner and went out to play. （日常）
synonyms.usage: 最普通口语,只表'把一件事做到结束',不含'难度大/了不起'的褒义;accomplish 强调克服困难后'圆满做成',更正式且带成就感

synonyms.example: It is only through lifelong learning that one can attain true wisdom. （议论文·教育）
synonyms.usage: 偏书面正式,常接抽象的高度/境界(goals, heights, wisdom);accomplish 更侧重具体任务的完成

synonyms.example: She finally fulfilled her childhood dream of teaching in a mountain school. （读后续写·梦想）
synonyms.usage: 多接 dream/promise/duty/potential 等'愿望、承诺、职责',带情感色彩;accomplish 更中性,指完成工作

advancedExpressions.type: 构词法·accomplish 词族（课件拓展）
advancedExpressions.expression: accomplish(v. 完成=achieve) → accomplishment(cn./un. 成就,成绩;the accomplishment of 表'完成') → accomplished(adj. 有造诣的)
advancedExpressions.example: For a novelist, that's quite an accomplishment, and his function is vital to the accomplishment of the mission. （课件两句:名词'成就'an accomplishment + '完成'the accomplishment of）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·完成/做成(可替换)
advancedExpressions.expression: accomplish = achieve = carry out = pull off = bring ... to completion
advancedExpressions.example: Against all odds, the small team accomplished / achieved / pulled off what everyone had thought impossible. （四词可互换表'做成难事',pull off 更口语生动）

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·被动强调'事情被做成'
advancedExpressions.expression: nothing / much / a great deal is accomplished (by doing sth)
advancedExpressions.example: Little is accomplished by blaming others; much is accomplished by quietly doing the work. （被动句式对比,议论文强化观点,呼应课文 nothing is accomplished）

advancedExpressions.expression: not until ... did sb. realise what they had accomplished
advancedExpressions.example: Not until the applause thundered around her did she realise what she had accomplished — and how far a frightened girl had come. （倒装+对比,续写高潮段情感升华）

advancedExpressions.expression: what we have accomplished proves that ...
advancedExpressions.example: What we have accomplished this term proves that even the smallest hands, joined together, can move mountains. （倡议信结尾,以成果作证提出号召）

advancedExpressions.expression: great things are seldom accomplished without ...
advancedExpressions.example: Great things are seldom accomplished without a willingness to fail, learn, and try once more. （让步式论证,强调过程价值）

advancedExpressions.type: 构词法·-ment 抽象名词/-ed 形容词
advancedExpressions.expression: accomplish(v.) → accomplishment(n. 成就；才艺) → accomplished(adj. 有造诣的)
advancedExpressions.example: Her greatest accomplishment was raising three accomplished children who each mastered an instrument. （同根词一句串联:名词'成就'+形容词'有造诣的'）

sentenceUpgrade.original: He finished the job and felt happy.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: As the final piece slid into place, a quiet warmth spread through him: against every odd, he had accomplished the very thing everyone had told him could not be done. （读后续写·心理描写+对比）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: as 时间状语从句营造画面 + 冒号引出结果 + against every odd 对比强调 + accomplish 替换 finish 提升正式度

sentenceUpgrade.original: We did a lot this year.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Looking back, we are proud of all that our club has accomplished this year — from planting a hundred trees to raising funds for the local library. （应用文·正式文体+具体化）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: Looking back 引入回顾语气 + all that 强调从句 + 破折号列举具体成果使抽象成就落地

classPractice.question: That way nothing is ____ (accomplish), he thought, so he decided to change his strategy at once.
classPractice.note: 呼应课文原句;nothing 作主语用被动 is accomplished,注意过去分词拼写

classPractice.question: After years of hard work, she finally ____ (accomplished / finished) her lifelong goal of building a school in her village.
classPractice.note: 克服困难'圆满做成'重大目标(goal)用 accomplish;finished 只表一般'结束'不带成就感

classPractice.question: 回顾这一年，我们为自己所取得的一切感到自豪。Looking back, we are proud of ____ we have ____ this year.（用 accomplish 的正确形式）
classPractice.note: all that 引导定语从句作宾语;现在完成时 have accomplished 强调对现在的影响

translation: 贵族的，高贵的；崇高的；宏伟的
original_sentence: Never have I seen a greater, or more beautiful, or a calmer or more noble thing than you, brother.
readingExamples: Never have I seen a greater, or more beautiful, or a calmer or more noble thing than you, brother.
definitionEn:
(1) adj. having or showing fine personal qualities such as honesty, courage, and generosity; morally good
(2) adj. belonging to the nobility; of high social rank by birth
(3) adj. very impressive in size, quality, or appearance; grand and magnificent
(4) n. a person of noble rank; a member of the aristocracy

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 贵族（人）
uncommonMeanings.example: In the great hall the nobles gathered in silk and gold, yet it was the ragged shepherd at the door whose words would be remembered for centuries. （读后续写·历史·平凡与高贵的反差）

posExamples.sentence: Though dressed in tattered clothes, the old fisherman carried himself with such quiet dignity that the boy sensed something truly noble in his weathered, patient face. （读后续写·人物刻画·内在高贵）
Volunteering to teach in remote villages is a noble undertaking, and I sincerely hope more of us will answer this call. （应用文·倡议信）
It is a noble goal to pursue justice for others, yet true nobility lies not in grand declarations but in daily acts of kindness. （议论文·品德主题）
Before them rose the noble peaks of the Himalayas, their snow-crowned summits glowing pink in the first light of dawn. （读后续写·壮丽景物描写）

wordForms.other: nobleness

collocations.translation: 【课件】伟大的领袖 / 高尚的事业（noble 表'崇高的',having fine personal qualities）
collocations.example: Never have I seen a greater, or more beautiful, or a calmer or more noble thing than you. （课件·课文原句）

collocations.translation: 【课件】雄伟的大楼（noble 表'宏伟的、壮丽的',very impressive in size or quality）
collocations.example: They gazed up at the noble building, its grand pillars rising majestically against the sky. （课件义项·宏伟壮丽）

collocations.translation: 【课件】贵族家庭（noble 表'贵族的',belonging to a family of high social rank）
collocations.example: She was born into a noble family but chose to live simply among ordinary people. （课件义项·贵族的）

collocations.translation: 更高贵/更崇高的东西（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: Never have I seen a greater, or more beautiful, or a calmer or more noble thing than you, brother. （课文原句）
They devoted their youth to a noble cause: bringing clean water to drought-stricken villages. （读后续写·奉献）
His noble deed of diving into the icy river to save a stranger spread through the whole town by nightfall. （读后续写·见义勇为）
The teacher's noble spirit of selfless giving left a mark on generations of students. （议论文·师德）
Born into a noble family, she chose nonetheless to live simply among the poor she served. （读后续写·反差人物）
Youth should be nourished by noble ideals that lift us beyond the pursuit of mere comfort. （议论文·理想）

collocations.phrase: it is noble of sb to do sth
collocations.example: It was noble of him to give up his own seat and stand for hours so the exhausted mother could rest. （读后续写·善举）
Forgiving the boy who had wronged her was a noble gesture that silenced the whole classroom. （读后续写·宽恕）

synonyms.example: He made the honourable choice to admit his mistake, even though no one would ever have known. （读后续写·诚信）
synonyms.usage: 侧重'合乎道德准则、值得尊敬',强调行为的正当与信誉;noble 更强调品格的崇高与无私

synonyms.example: Her generous heart moved her to share her last loaf with the beggar at the gate. （读后续写·善良）
synonyms.usage: 侧重乐于给予、不计得失;noble 涵盖面更广,包含勇气、正直、无私等整体高尚品德

synonyms.example: The magnificent cathedral towered over the square, its spires piercing the morning mist. （读后续写·景物）
synonyms.usage: 只用于'宏伟壮丽'这一层义,不含道德色彩;noble 兼有'道德高尚'与'宏伟'两义

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·部分倒装（否定词前置 / only+状语 / so...that）（课件重点）
advancedExpressions.expression: ① 否定词或否定意义短语(never, seldom, hardly, little, at no time, by no means, in no way, on no account...)置于句首 → 助动词/情态动词提前实现部分倒装；② only + 介词短语/状语从句/副词 置于句首时倒装；③ so/such...that 结构中 so + adj./adv. 置于句首时倒装
advancedExpressions.example: Never have I seen a greater, or more beautiful, or a calmer or more noble thing than you. （课件课文原句·否定词 never 前置,助动词 have 提到主语前实现部分倒装）

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·部分倒装·否定词前置（课件例句）
advancedExpressions.expression: Seldom / Hardly / Never / Little / By no means + 助动词 + 主语 + 动词
advancedExpressions.example: By no means will this method be satisfactory. / Seldom had I read such an interesting book. （课件原句·by no means、seldom 置句首引发部分倒装）

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·部分倒装·only+状语置句首（课件例句）
advancedExpressions.expression: Only + 时间/介词短语/状语从句 + 助动词 + 主语 + 动词
advancedExpressions.example: Only yesterday did I know what had happened to him. / Only when he steps towards the table do I remember his face. （课件原句·only 引导状语置句首倒装）

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·部分倒装·so/such...that（课件例句）
advancedExpressions.expression: So + adj./adv. + 助动词 + 主语 + 动词 + that ...
advancedExpressions.example: So fast did he run that none of us could catch up with him. （课件原句·so...that 结构中 so fast 置句首引发部分倒装）

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·noble 的'崇高/宏伟/贵族'三义辨析（课件三义项）
advancedExpressions.expression: noble ①崇高的,品德高尚(a noble leader/cause) ②宏伟壮丽的(a noble building) ③贵族的(a noble family)
advancedExpressions.example: Before the noble building (宏伟) stood a man of noble character (崇高), though he came from no noble family (贵族). （课件三义项一句对照,识别语境选义）

advancedExpressions.expression: a noble cause / a noble deed / noble ideals / it is noble of sb to do sth / true nobility
advancedExpressions.example: It is noble of ordinary people to devote themselves to a noble cause without ever seeking reward. （一句串起'某人做某事高尚'+'崇高事业',课堂速记）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·高尚/崇高(可替换)
advancedExpressions.expression: noble = honourable = high-minded = admirable = worthy
advancedExpressions.example: His honourable / noble / high-minded refusal to cheat, even when no one was watching, won everyone's respect. （形容'品德高尚'三词可互换,注意 magnificent 只替'宏伟'一义）

advancedExpressions.expression: noble(adj.) → nobly(adv. 高尚地) → nobility(n. 高贵；贵族阶层) → ennoble(v. 使高尚) → nobleman(n. 贵族)
advancedExpressions.example: He behaved nobly, and his nobility of spirit seemed to ennoble everyone around him. （副词+名词+动词同根一句串联）

advancedExpressions.expression: there was something noble about sb, a ... that ...
advancedExpressions.example: There was something noble about the old man, a quiet strength that no hardship could ever bend or break. （抽象名词具象化,续写刻画人物气质）

advancedExpressions.expression: let us join this noble endeavour to ...
advancedExpressions.example: Let us join this noble endeavour to protect our shared home, for the earth we save today will shelter the generations of tomorrow. （倡议信结尾,以崇高使命动员）

advancedExpressions.expression: true nobility lies not in ... but in ...
advancedExpressions.example: True nobility lies not in the rank we are born to but in the kindness we choose to show. （对比句式,重新定义'高贵',深化论点）

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·noble 的'道德/宏伟/贵族'三义辨析
advancedExpressions.expression: noble ①品德高尚 ②宏伟壮丽 ③贵族的(=aristocratic)
advancedExpressions.example: Before the noble peaks (宏伟) stood a man of noble character (高尚), though he came from no noble family (贵族). （一句三义对照,识别语境选义）

sentenceUpgrade.original: He was a good and brave man.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Beneath his rough coat and calloused hands beat the heart of a truly noble man — one who feared no danger when a life was at stake. （读后续写·人物+对比反差）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: beneath 引导环境反差(外表粗糙 vs 内心高贵) + noble 替换 good 提升格调 + one who 定语从句补充说明

sentenceUpgrade.original: Helping others is a great thing to do.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Devoting oneself to the welfare of others is perhaps the noblest calling a person can answer, for in lifting others we ourselves are lifted. （议论文·正式文体+哲理）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 动名词作主语正式化 + noblest 最高级强化 + calling 隐喻'使命' + for 引导原因分句形成哲理收束

classPractice.type: 语境应用·部分倒装（课件语法点·仿造原句）
classPractice.question: 将 I have never seen a more noble thing than you. 改为强调否定词前置的部分倒装句：____ ____ ____ ____ a more noble thing than you.
classPractice.note: 【课件】否定词 never 置句首,助动词 have 提到主语 I 之前实现部分倒装(呼应课文原句)

classPractice.type: 语境应用·部分倒装 only 置句首（课件语法点）
classPractice.question: Only when he steps towards the table ____ ____ ____ his face.（remember,注意 only+状语从句置句首的倒装）
classPractice.note: 【课件】only + 状语从句置句首,主句用部分倒装 do I remember(课件原句)

classPractice.question: Never have I seen a greater, or more beautiful, or a calmer or more ____ (noble) thing than you, brother.
classPractice.note: 课文原句;more...more...more 并列比较级,noble 保持原级由 more 构成比较级

classPractice.question: It was very ____ (noble) of the young doctor to work in the remote village for free, and his ____ (noble) of spirit moved us all.
classPractice.note: 第一空 it is noble of sb 用形容词;第二空 of spirit 前需名词 nobility

classPractice.question: 真正的高贵不在于出身，而在于我们选择去行善。（用 true nobility lies not in ... but in ...）
classPractice.answer: True nobility lies not in one's birth but in the good we choose to do. / True nobility lies not in where we are born but in choosing to do good.
classPractice.note: not in ... but in ... 对比结构,in 后接名词或动名词,议论文点睛句

translation: 糊涂的，迷惑的；不清楚的，混乱的
original_sentence: Now you are getting confused in the head, he thought.
readingExamples: Now you are getting confused in the head, he thought.
definitionEn:
(1) adj. unable to think clearly or understand what is happening; bewildered
(2) adj. not clear or easy to understand; muddled or disordered
(3) adj. feeling uncertain about what to do or believe

posExamples.sentence: The boy stood at the crossroads, confused and trembling, as a maze of unfamiliar streets stretched endlessly before him under the darkening sky. （读后续写·迷路·心理与环境）
If any part of the schedule leaves you confused, please do not hesitate to contact us so that we can clear things up in advance. （应用文·通知）
Bombarded by conflicting information online, many young people feel confused about whom to trust, which makes media literacy more vital than ever. （议论文·信息时代）
Her mind grew confused as exhaustion set in, the letters on the page swimming together until she could no longer tell one word from the next. （读后续写·疲惫·感官描写）

collocations.example: A survey showed people were confused about what they should eat to stay healthy. （课件原句·对该吃什么感到困惑）
I was rather confused by his question. （课件原句·被他的问题搞糊涂）
Now you are getting confused in the head, he thought. （课件·课文原句）
In confusion I lost my bag and wasn't able to find it. （课件填空原句）

collocations.translation: 【课件】把 A 和 B 相混淆
collocations.example: I always confuse you with your sister — you look so alike. （课件原句·把你和你妹妹搞混）

collocations.translation: 【课件】使某人迷惑；使难于理解
collocations.example: Different instructions confused the student, which left him wondering what to do. （课件原句·让学生很困惑）
Some of the questions he asked were very confusing. （课件填空原句）
There was a confused look on his face when he met with confusing problems. （课件原句·遇令人困惑的问题露出困惑表情）

collocations.translation: 【课件】混乱的情况 / 混乱的思想（confused 表'不清楚的、混乱的'）
collocations.example: Your essay gets a bit confused halfway through when you introduce too many ideas at once. （课件·文章显得混乱）

collocations.translation: （头脑）犯糊涂，变迷糊（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: Now you are getting confused in the head, he thought. （课文原句）

collocations.translation: 看起来 / 感到 / 似乎很困惑
collocations.example: The tourist looked confused, so I stepped forward and offered to walk him to the station myself. （读后续写·助人）
Standing before two equally tempting choices, she felt hopelessly confused about what to do. （读后续写·抉择）
A confused expression crossed his face, then slowly gave way to a smile of understanding. （读后续写·神态描写）
At first I was completely confused about the rules, but a patient classmate soon explained them to me. （读后续写·校园）
People often confuse confidence with arrogance, though the two could hardly be more different. （议论文·辨析）
After hours in the blazing sun, he began to get confused in the head, mistaking shadows for approaching help. （读后续写·困境）

synonyms.example: The detective frowned, puzzled by the single clue that made no sense at all. （读后续写·悬疑）
synonyms.usage: 侧重'对某个具体谜题想不通',程度较轻,常与好奇相伴;confused 更强调整体思绪混乱、不知所措

synonyms.translation: 迷惘的，不知所措的（程度更深）
synonyms.example: Bewildered by the roaring crowd and flashing lights, the child clung tightly to his mother's hand. （读后续写·陌生环境）
synonyms.usage: 语气最强,指被复杂或突发情况彻底搞懵;confused 更常用、程度居中

synonyms.example: His muddled explanation only made the situation harder to grasp. （议论文·表达清晰）

original_sentence: "Clear up, head," he said in a voice he could hardly hear.
readingExamples: "Clear up, head," he said in a voice he could hardly hear.
definitionEn:
(1) phr. v. to make a place tidy by removing things or putting them away
(2) phr. v. to explain or solve something that is difficult to understand; to remove doubt or confusion
(3) phr. v. (of weather) to become bright and sunny after rain or clouds
(4) phr. v. (of an illness or problem) to disappear or be cured

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （头脑）变清醒（课文用法）
uncommonMeanings.example: "Clear up, head," he said in a voice he could hardly hear. （课文原句,老人命令自己头脑清醒）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 整理，收拾（使整洁）
uncommonMeanings.example: Long after the guests had gone, she quietly cleared up the scattered plates. （聚会后收拾）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 澄清，消除（误会、疑问）
uncommonMeanings.example: A single honest conversation was enough to clear up the misunderstanding. （消除误会）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （天气）转晴
uncommonMeanings.example: By the time they reached the harbour the storm had cleared up, and a shy sun was already gilding the wet rooftops with gold. （读后续写·雨过天晴·希望象征）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （疾病、问题）消失，痊愈
uncommonMeanings.example: The doctor assured her that with rest the fever would clear up within days — and so, to everyone's relief, it did. （读后续写·康复）

posExamples.sentence: Long after the guests had gone, she quietly cleared up the scattered plates, humming a tune that carried the warmth of the evening into the silent kitchen. （读后续写·聚会后·温情）
To clear up any misunderstanding, I am writing to explain exactly what happened during the class trip last Friday. （应用文·道歉信 / 说明信）
Honest, open dialogue is often the surest way to clear up the misunderstandings that quietly poison human relationships. （议论文·沟通主题）
"Clear up, head," he murmured, pressing his palms against his temples, willing his exhausted mind to sharpen for the struggle ahead. （读后续写·意志力·自我激励）

idioms.translation: 清除，收走（把东西搬走清空）
idioms.example: After lunch the students cleared away the plates and wiped every table until it shone. （clear 短语群·把桌面东西收走）
We spent the whole afternoon clearing out the dusty storeroom before the new books arrived. （clear 短语群·把某处腾空）
By noon the morning fog had cleared off, revealing the green valley below. （clear 短语群·雾/云散去）

collocations.example: "Clear up, head," he said in a voice he could hardly ever hear. "Clear up." （课件·课文原句·老人命令自己头脑清醒）

collocations.phrase: clear sth ↔ up（= make sth clean and neat）
collocations.translation: 【课件】使整洁，清理，把杂乱的东西整理好
collocations.example: Clear up the mess before your mother comes home. （课件·清理杂乱）
One overlooked footprint finally helped the detective clear up a mystery that had baffled the town for years. （课件义项·揭开疑团）
A patient teacher can clear up a difficulty in minutes that has puzzled a student for days. （课件义项·解决困难）
A single honest conversation was enough to clear up the misunderstanding between the two old friends. （课件义项·消除误会）

collocations.phrase: clear up（= become fine and bright / to solve or explain sth）
collocations.example: I said I would fix the roof when the weather clears up. （课件原句·天气转晴）

collocations.translation: （头脑）清醒过来（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: "Clear up, head," he said in a voice he could hardly hear. （课文原句）
Everyone stayed behind to clear up the mess, turning a tiring chore into a moment of shared laughter. （读后续写·集体活动）
The teacher's patient explanation cleared up every doubt lingering in our minds. （读后续写·课堂）

collocations.translation: 解开谜团 / 解决问题
collocations.example: One overlooked footprint finally cleared up the mystery that had baffled the village for years. （读后续写·悬疑）
We waited anxiously, hoping the weather would clear up before the outdoor ceremony began. （应用文·活动安排）
She was always the one left to clear up after the careless roommates. （读后续写·日常）

collocations.translation: 把事情弄清楚 / 澄清
collocations.example: Let us meet face to face and clear things up once and for all. （应用文·沟通）

synonyms.example: Before the guests arrived, we hurried to tidy up the living room until it gleamed. （读后续写·迎客）
synonyms.usage: 只表'整理使整洁'这一层义;clear up 除整理外还可指'澄清、放晴、痊愈',含义更广

synonyms.example: Both sides finally agreed to sit down and resolve their differences peacefully. （议论文·冲突化解）
synonyms.usage: 书面正式,多接 dispute/conflict/issue 等'纠纷、问题';clear up 更口语,常接 misunderstanding/doubt

synonyms.example: Allow me to clarify the two points that seem to have caused some confusion. （应用文·说明信）
synonyms.usage: 侧重'把话说清楚、把概念阐明',对象是信息或观点;clear up 侧重'消除已存在的误会或疑惑'

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·clear up 的多义靠宾语/语境判断（课件多义汇总）
advancedExpressions.expression: clear up + 头脑(清醒) / + 房间垃圾 the mess(收拾整理) / + a mystery/difficulty/misunderstanding(揭开疑团/解决困难/消除误会) / + 天气(转晴)
advancedExpressions.example: "Clear up, head" — as soon as the weather cleared up, he cleared up the mess and then cleared up the misunderstanding. （课件四义同短语靠搭配区分,识别练习）

advancedExpressions.type: 短语群·clear + 副词一网打尽
advancedExpressions.expression: clear up(澄清/收拾/放晴) / clear away(清走) / clear out(腾空) / clear off(散去)
advancedExpressions.example: Once the volunteers had cleared away the rubbish and cleared out the shed, they waited for the sky to clear up. （三个 clear 短语连用,课堂对比记忆）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·澄清/消除误会(可替换)

advancedExpressions.expression: as the sky cleared up, so did ...

advancedExpressions.expression: only honest communication can clear up ...

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·clear up 的多义靠宾语/语境判断
advancedExpressions.expression: clear up + 天气(放晴) / + 房间垃圾(收拾) / + 误会疑问(澄清) / + 疾病(痊愈)
advancedExpressions.example: As soon as the weather cleared up, she cleared up her desk and then cleared up the last doubt in her mind. （同一短语三义靠搭配区分,识别练习）

sentenceUpgrade.original: The rain stopped and the sky became clear.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: As if nature itself had chosen to forgive, the rain relented and the sky cleared up, spilling a river of golden light across the drenched valley. （读后续写·景物描写+象征）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: As if 拟人比喻(nature forgive) + relented 拟人化替换 stopped + clear up 短语动词 + spilling 现在分词伴随景物延展

sentenceUpgrade.original: We should talk to solve the misunderstanding.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Rather than letting resentment fester in silence, we ought to sit down together and clear up the misunderstanding before it hardens into lasting estrangement. （议论文·正式建议+因果）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: Rather than 让步对比 + fester in silence 隐喻 + clear up 短语动词 + before 引导后果警示,论证有层次

classPractice.answer: cleared away; cleared out; clear up

classPractice.note: clear up any confusion 消除困惑;regarding/about 引出所涉事项,应用文开头得体句

word: be on the point of doing sth
original_sentence: He had been on the point of feeling himself go each time.
readingExamples: He had been on the point of feeling himself go each time.
definitionEn:
(1) phr. to be just about to do something; to be at the very moment before an action happens
(2) phr. used to describe an action that is imminent but often interrupted or prevented by another event

posExamples.sentence: He was on the point of giving up when, out of the corner of his eye, he caught a faint flicker of light dancing across the distant hillside. （读后续写·绝望中转机·画面感）
I was on the point of writing to thank you when your kind letter arrived, filling our whole family with warmth. （应用文·感谢信）
Just as society seems on the point of forgetting the value of patience, a quiet movement toward slow, mindful living reminds us what truly matters. （议论文·社会现象）
She was on the point of tears, her lips quivering, when her grandmother's gentle hand settled warmly upon her shoulder. （读后续写·情感·被安慰）

idioms.idiom: be on the point of doing sth
idioms.translation: 正要做某事，即将做某事（就在动作发生前一瞬间）
idioms.example: He had been on the point of feeling himself go each time. （课文原句,每次都几乎要昏过去）

idioms.idiom: be on the point of doing sth when ...
idioms.example: He was on the point of turning back when a small voice called his name from the shadows. （'正要…忽然'续写经典转折）
Even at the point of death, the old soldier's grip on the flag never loosened. （相关变体,on 换 at 表'处于…边缘'）

collocations.phrase: be on / at the point of doing sth
collocations.translation: 【课件】正要做某事（= be about to do sth）
collocations.example: He had been on the point of feeling himself go each time. （课件·课文原句·每次都几乎要垮了）

collocations.phrase: be on / at the point of tears
collocations.example: When he fell off the tree, he was on/at the point of tears. （课件原句·几乎要哭了）

collocations.translation: 【课件·拓展】在某个阶段 / 时刻
collocations.example: We're all going to die at some point. （课件原句·在某个时刻）

collocations.translation: 【课件·拓展】不切正题，无关紧要
collocations.example: Mark received low marks for his essay, as much of it was off the point. （课件原句·文章大部分内容不切正题）
Her answer was short and to the point, and the interviewer nodded in approval. （课件义项·简明恰当）
Stop wandering around and get to the point — what exactly do you need? （课件义项·切入正题）
She made a good point about the risks we had all overlooked. （课件义项·提出观点）
I take your point, but I still think we should wait a little longer. （课件义项·赞同观点）

collocations.phrase: be on the point of doing sth (each time)
collocations.example: He had been on the point of feeling himself go each time. （课文原句）

collocations.phrase: be on the point of leaving
collocations.example: I was on the point of leaving the classroom when the teacher called my name and handed me a sealed envelope. （读后续写·意外）

collocations.phrase: be on the point of giving up
collocations.example: On the point of giving up, the young climber suddenly remembered his father's words and tightened his grip. （读后续写·坚持）

collocations.phrase: be on the point of tears / collapse
collocations.example: Exhausted and on the point of collapse, the marathon runner staggered the final metres toward the roaring crowd. （读后续写·极限）

collocations.phrase: be on the point of speaking / saying sth
collocations.example: He was on the point of speaking when a sudden knock at the door froze every word in his throat. （读后续写·悬念）

collocations.phrase: be on the point of doing sth when ...
collocations.example: We were on the point of setting off when a heavy downpour forced us back indoors. （读后续写·突发天气）

synonyms.example: She was about to knock when the door swung open on its own. （读后续写·悬疑）
synonyms.usage: 最常用、最口语,与 be on the point of 意思几乎相同;后者后接动名词(doing),前者接动词原形(do),语气略正式、更强调'就在那一瞬间'

synonyms.synonym: be on the verge of (doing) sth
synonyms.translation: 濒临，即将（尤指情绪或重大变化）
synonyms.example: The company was on the verge of bankruptcy before a bold new plan saved it. （议论文·转机）
synonyms.usage: 常接情绪或重大转折(tears, collapse, success, war),情感张力更强;be on the point of 更侧重具体动作即将发生

synonyms.example: With his bags packed, he was ready to leave at a moment's notice. （读后续写·出发）
synonyms.usage: 强调'已做好准备'的状态,不必立即发生;be on the point of 强调动作迫在眉睫、就要开始

advancedExpressions.type: 短语群·point 高频搭配辨析（课件拓展）
advancedExpressions.expression: be on/at the point of doing(正要做) vs at some point(在某时刻) / to the point(简明恰当) / off the point(离题) / get to the point(切入正题) / make a point(提出观点) / take one's point(赞同观点)
advancedExpressions.example: He was on the point of leaving, but at that point I asked him to get to the point instead of wandering off the point. （课件多个 point 短语同句对照,课堂速记）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·正要做…(可替换)

advancedExpressions.example: She was on the point of / about to / on the verge of leaving when the phone rang. （四式表'正要…',注意 point/verge 后接 doing,about 后接 do）

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·on the point of + doing(动名词)
advancedExpressions.expression: on the point of 后接名词或动名词(V-ing),不接动词原形；对比 be about to + do
advancedExpressions.example: He was on the point of giving up (√ doing) — not 'on the point of give up'. Compare: He was about to give up (√ 原形). （介词 of 后必须用动名词,高考易错点）

advancedExpressions.expression: sb was on the point of ... when ...
advancedExpressions.example: He was on the point of turning back when a small, trembling voice called his name from the shadows. （'正要…忽然'经典续写转折句,制造悬念）

advancedExpressions.expression: I was on the point of ... when ...

advancedExpressions.expression: just as ... seems on the point of ..., ...
advancedExpressions.example: Just as traditional crafts seem on the point of vanishing, a new generation is breathing life back into them. （对比转折,展现事物的转机与希望）

sentenceUpgrade.original: He was going to give up, but then he saw the light.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: He was on the point of giving up when a distant light pierced the darkness, rekindling in his weary heart a stubborn flame of hope. （读后续写·转折+心理描写）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: be on the point of 替换 going to 提升张力 + when 引导突转 + pierced the darkness 动词生动 + rekindling 现在分词收束心理

sentenceUpgrade.original: I wanted to thank you, and then your letter came.

definitionEn:

(2) vt. to make cloth, a carpet, a basket, etc. by crossing threads or strips under and over one another
(3) vt. to create a story, plan, or pattern by combining different parts or elements skilfully
