One month has flashed past/by. （课件原句·一个月飞逝而过）

collocations.translation: 【课件】（念头）突然想到，闪过脑海
collocations.example: A terrible thought flashed through/into my mind. （课件原句·一个可怕的想法闪过脑海）

collocations.phrase: flash on sb / flash on sth
collocations.translation: 【课件】使……猛然醒悟 / 猛然想到某事（= suddenly realize）
collocations.example: It flashed on me that he was the man I'd seen in the hotel. / I flashed on an argument I had with my sister when we were kids. （课件原句·猛然醒悟 / 猛然回想起）

collocations.translation: 断断续续地看得清（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: He could only see well in flashes. （课文原句）

collocations.phrase: a flash of anger / hope / recognition
collocations.translation: 一阵怒火 / 希望 / 认出的神情
collocations.example: A flash of recognition crossed the old woman's face, and her tired eyes suddenly brimmed with tears. （读后续写·重逢·神态描写）

collocations.phrase: flash a smile / look at sb
collocations.translation: 对某人绽放笑容 / 瞥一眼
collocations.example: As she crossed the finish line, she flashed a triumphant smile at her coach, who was punching the air with both fists. （读后续写·夺冠时刻）
The stranded hikers flashed their torch toward the distant helicopter, spelling out S-O-S with desperate, hopeful hands. （读后续写·山野遇险·求救）
A news flash interrupted the broadcast, announcing that the missing fishing boat had at last been found safe. （应用文/记叙·突发消息）

collocations.phrase: in a flash of insight / inspiration
collocations.example: In a flash of insight, she realised that the answer to the puzzle had been hidden in plain sight all along. （读后续写·顿悟）
A flash of lightning lit the abandoned house for a heartbeat, and in that split second she glimpsed a shadow move behind the curtain. （读后续写·悬疑·气氛营造）

collocations.phrase: in a flash / like a flash
collocations.example: The years of hardship seemed to vanish in a flash the moment she held her university acceptance letter in trembling hands. （读后续写·苦尽甘来）
A dozen excuses flashed through his mind, yet standing before his disappointed father, he found he could not utter a single one. （读后续写·愧疚·心理挣扎）

synonyms.example: Through the parting crowd she caught a fleeting glimpse of the friend she had not seen in ten long years. （读后续写·重逢·瞬间捕捉）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析:glimpse 指‘匆匆看到某物’(视觉动作，常搭 catch a glimpse of);flash 作名词指‘光的闪烁’或‘瞬间/念头的闪现’，两者都含‘短暂’但侧重不同

synonyms.example: Anger flared in his chest like a struck match, but he clenched his fists and forced the words back down. （读后续写·情绪爆发·隐忍）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析:flare 指火光突然变亮或情绪突然高涨(强调‘燃起、加剧’的持续过程);flash 强调一闪即逝的瞬时性，来去更快

synonyms.example: For one breathless instant the whole stadium fell silent, as forty thousand hearts waited for the final whistle. （读后续写·比赛·凝固时刻）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析:instant 是中性名词，纯指‘一刹那的时间’;flash 作‘瞬间’解时更形象生动，常与光/念头的突现联系，情感色彩更强

advancedExpressions.type: 短语群·flash 动词高频搭配（课件汇总）
advancedExpressions.expression: flash across sth(神色掠过) / flash back to sth(闪回) / flash past/by(飞逝) / flash through/into one's mind(念头闪过) / flash on sb/sth(猛然醒悟)
advancedExpressions.example: As the years flashed by, a look of longing flashed across his face and the whole scene flashed back into his mind. （课件多个 flash 动词短语同句对照,课堂速记）

advancedExpressions.type: 短语群·flash 名词高频搭配（课件汇总）
advancedExpressions.expression: a flash of lightning(一道闪电) / a flash of anger(怒上心头) / a flash of inspiration(灵感闪现) / in a flash(很快) / quick as a flash(敏捷地)
advancedExpressions.example: Quick as a flash, in a flash of inspiration, she solved it just as a flash of lightning lit the room. （课件多个 flash 名词短语同句,课堂速记）

advancedExpressions.expression: flash(n./v.) → flashy(adj. 浮华的) → flashback(n. 闪回,倒叙) → flashlight(n. 手电筒) → flasher(n.)
advancedExpressions.example: In a sudden flashback the survivor relived that flash of lightning, then reached for the flashlight beside his bed. （flashback 倒叙 + flashlight 手电筒 同根,写作与阅读高频）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·一瞬间(可替换)
advancedExpressions.expression: in a flash = in an instant = in the blink of an eye = in no time = all at once
advancedExpressions.example: In a flash / in the blink of an eye / all at once, the calm sea turned into a wall of white foam. （'转眼间'多式可互换,读后续写加速节奏）

advancedExpressions.expression: in a flash (of insight), sb suddenly realised / saw that ...
advancedExpressions.example: In a flash of insight, he suddenly saw that the courage he had been chasing had lived quietly inside him all along. （灵光一闪+顿悟,续写高潮点题）

advancedExpressions.expression: in a flash, it all became clear: ...
advancedExpressions.example: In a flash, it all became clear: the stranger who had saved her was none other than the boy she had once turned away. （in a flash前置制造顿悟停顿 + 冒号揭示真相 + none other than强化戏剧性反转）

advancedExpressions.expression: please be advised that a ... light will flash ... as a signal to ...
advancedExpressions.example: Please be advised that a green light will flash twice at the entrance as a signal for participants to enter the hall in an orderly manner. （Please be advised that正式提示句型 + as a signal to do明确指令功能）

advancedExpressions.expression: what dazzles us in a flash seldom endures; true value lies in ...
advancedExpressions.example: What dazzles us in a flash seldom endures; true value lies not in fleeting fame but in the patient accumulation of genuine skill. （前后分句对比 + not in...but in...结构提炼观点）

advancedExpressions.expression: in a flash(一瞬间) / a flash of lightning(一道闪电) / a flash of anger/hope(一阵怒/喜) / flash through one's mind(掠过脑海) / a news flash(快讯)
advancedExpressions.example: In a flash, a flash of hope lit her eyes as the answer flashed through her mind. （'一瞬间'+'一阵希望'+'掠过脑海'三义同句,课堂速记）

sentenceUpgrade.original: Lightning appeared and she saw a figure in the dark.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: A jagged flash of lightning ripped across the sky, and in that single blinding instant she saw it — a lone figure standing motionless at the far end of the corridor, watching. （读后续写·惊悚·悬念）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: jagged...ripped across动态强动词 + in that single blinding instant时间定格 + 破折号+现在分词watching留白制造悬念

sentenceUpgrade.original: He suddenly understood the answer.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: In a flash of understanding that left him almost breathless, the solution he had chased for weeks unfolded in his mind, elegant and complete, as though it had been waiting there all along. （读后续写/记叙·顿悟）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: In a flash of understanding状语前置 + that定语从句渲染冲击力 + as though虚拟比喻收束，赋予顿悟以‘一直在等待’的诗意

classPractice.question: His hands were mushy now and he could only see well ____ flashes.
classPractice.note: 课文原句;in flashes = 断断续续地、时清时糊,固定介词 in

classPractice.question: 刹那间，多年的艰辛似乎都烟消云散了。____ ____ ____, the years of hardship seemed to vanish.（用 flash 的固定短语，表'一瞬间'）
classPractice.note: in a flash = 转眼间、一瞬间,句首状语,首字母大写

classPractice.question: 从 flashy / flashing 中选词：The salesman's ____, over-decorated suit made everyone doubt whether his promises were genuine.
classPractice.note: flashy 意为'浮华的、华而不实的'(贬义),修饰 suit;flashing 意为'闪光的',不合语境
